2tnV0My0s36a5ctC.name: 放贷人 Credshark
2tnV0My0s36a5ctC.publicNotes:
放贷人在食物链的较高端运作。

帮派分子

犯罪行会、犯罪家族、收取保护费的团伙和高利贷者，只是艾巴萨罗姆空间站众多帮派类型中的一小部分。帮派有强烈的地域性，惯于掠夺他人，且极其重视地盘。成员因不同原因加入，但大多数人都发现，一旦入帮，就很难轻易脱身。

帮派分子总有自己的生财之道，也就是用来赚钱的犯罪生意，但大多数帮派也惯常收取保护费。在帮派地盘内做生意的人——更糟的是，生意位于多个帮派地盘的交界处——通常都得定期交钱，否则就可能面临严重后果。

items.name: 脉冲手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这把威武的手枪从枪管射出一束麻痹电流。剩余充能以沿枪身延伸的发光能量线显示。赏金猎人和执法人员往往需要活捉目标，因此常用脉冲投射手枪。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This imposing pistol fires a jolt of paralyzing electricity from its barrel. Its remaining charges are visible as glowing lines of energy radiating down its body. Pulsecaster pistols are often used by bounty hunters and law enforcement who need to keep their targets alive.

items.name: 阿巴达尔集团旅行服装
items.description:
强化： 2

阿巴达尔集团的高管让这些装甲商务套装在会议室和战场上都流行起来。应急力场护盾和隐藏甲片会在危险情境下保护穿戴者。更高品质的差旅套装能提供更多防护，同时还带有设计师品牌标识。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 2

AbadarCorp executives popularized these armored business suits for boardrooms and battle. Contingent force fields and concealed plating protect the wearer in hostile situations. Higher grades of travel suits offer more protection—along with a designer label.

items.expectedName: Datapad (Loaded with financial and bookkeeping apps)
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

5OYZcNFkfTO8lGca.name: 炸弹藤 String-of-Bombs
5OYZcNFkfTO8lGca.publicNotes:
炸弹藤是一种美丽但具有爆炸性的多肉植物，在协约世界的许多星舰上作为危险的乘客被发现。原产于卡斯卓韦的热带雨林，炸弹藤的爆炸性名称来源于其藤蔓上悬挂的微微发光的橙色豆荚。这些豆荚是为了防御卡斯卓韦的巨型掠食者而进化出来的防御机制，因为刺和藤蔓被证明是不够的威慑。由于植物的爆炸性豆荚直到完全成熟才会发育，炸弹藤看起来像其他无害的多肉植物（包括与之密切相关且无害的太阳藤），可能会被误认为是低维护的飞船绿化植物。许多园丁在它真正在他们面前爆炸之前，都没有意识到他们正在培育的危险。

炸弹藤要到完全成熟才会长出爆炸豆荚，因此看上去与其他无害多肉植物相似，包括与其亲缘相近且无害的太阳藤（string-of-suns），有时会被当作无需太多照料的船上绿植。许多园丁一直没意识到自己养的是何等危险之物，直到它真的在自己面前炸开。

侵扰生物

入侵生物困扰着艾巴萨罗姆空间站，就算投入最专注的清剿行动，也难以将其消灭。无论是藏身于幽灵层，还是偷渡上星舰，这些顽强的侵扰生物始终是这座庞大而多元的空间站面临的问题。

A creature that critically fails this save is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

The ground within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] of the string-of-bombs is difficult terrain while the string-of-bombs is rooted.

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.

items.name: 决斗拼装刃
items.description:
强化： 1

这把卡萨斯人（kasathan）的剑可以拆分成相互咬合的部件，便于存储和运输。传统主义者以仪式性地组装拼图刃为一门技艺，其各个部件分别象征卡萨斯人的信念、奉献、节制和传统等美德。罪犯和走私者则看重拼图刃不引人注意的设计。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This kasathan sword breaks down into interlocking pieces for storage and transport. Traditionalists practice the art of ritually assembling puzzleblades, with different pieces symbolizing the kasathan virtues of conviction, dedication, moderation, and tradition. Criminals and smugglers value the puzzleblade for its discreet design.

items.name: 悬浮
items.description: 处于地面形态的利爪突击艇，始终悬浮在地面、水面等表面上方6英寸。如果驶离高处，除非使用再配置，否则突击艇每轮降低20尺高度；落地时，艇体与乘客均不受伤害。
items.expectedDescription: A talon strike craft in its land-based form maintains an altitude of 6 inches above other surfaces, such as the ground or water. If driven off a high surface, the strike craft loses 20 feet of altitude per round unless it Reconfigures, landing without harm to the skiff or its passengers.

items.name: 倾侧
items.description: 处于空中形态时，利爪突击艇的驾驶员可以为驾驶动作添加鲁莽特征；若该动作已经具有鲁莽特征，则可在驾驶检定上承受–1环境减值。如此便可在移动过程中的任意时点，将载具向任一侧平移5尺，而不改变航向。
items.expectedDescription: In its aerial form, the pilot of a talon strike craft can add the reckless trait to a Drive action, or attempt the Piloting check with a –1 circumstance penalty if it was already reckless, to shift the vehicle 5 feet to either side at any point during the movement without changing its heading.

items.name: 制导射击
items.description: 利爪突击艇向60尺内的一个生物或物体发射追踪导弹，造成@Damage[3d8[bludgeoning],(3[splash])[fire]]{3d8钝击伤害和3点火焰溅射伤害}（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription: The talon strike craft fires homing missiles at a creature or object within 60 feet, dealing @Damage[3d8[bludgeoning],(3[splash])[fire]]{3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3 fire splash damage } (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).

items.name: 激光炮
items.description: 利爪突击艇发射搭载的激光炮，造成@Damage[5d8[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，作用于@Template[type:line|distance:30]内的生物和物体（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。除了驾驶员，船员也可以使用此能力。
items.expectedDescription: The talon strike craft fires its mounted laser cannon, dealing @Damage[5d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures and objects in a @Template[type:line|distance:30] (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). This ability can be used by the crew in addition to the pilot.

items.name: 再配置
items.description: 利爪突击艇重新配置机翼，在空中形态与地面形态之间切换。
items.expectedDescription: The talon strike craft reconfigures its wings, switching between its aerial form and land-based form.

While trapped, the starship can't Change Heading or take any actions to move any number of zones except toward the hazard until someone disables the hazard each round. The hazard rolls initiative.

(1 action) The hazard pulls the starship 1 zone toward it and continues to trap the starship. The starship experiences additional effects depending on how close it is to the hazard. A starship's speed cannot be reduced below 1 from this hazard.

Event Horizon (hazard's zone): The starship's battle stations are malfunctioning. The starship takes @Damage[(3d12+17)[bludgeoning]] damage each round from crushing gravity with a @Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic] save. If the starship is destroyed, all creatures and objects inside take damage instead.

CdetzaXWMajYsFaM.name: 败蚁猎蚁 Terminite Hunter
CdetzaXWMajYsFaM.publicNotes:
当败蚁的故事开始流传时，它们最初被视作阴森鬼祟的食腐者。待到寻求刺激的人开始为了取乐或研究而猎杀这些生物时，一种新型败蚁几乎在一夜之间出现了：败蚁猎蚁。与败蚁一群中体型较小的工蚁构件相比，猎蚁远为嗜血。它们不会从物件和地形中采撷微粒，而是强到足以从活物身上撕裂下大块的现实。

侵扰生物

入侵生物困扰着艾巴萨罗姆空间站，就算投入最专注的清剿行动，也难以将其消灭。无论是藏身于幽灵层，还是偷渡上星舰，这些顽强的侵扰生物始终是这座庞大而多元的空间站面临的问题。

items.name: 撕扯精粹
items.description:
需求败蚁的上一个动作是对一个生物进行且命中的颚咬打击

效果败蚁那能切开现实的大颚，从目标身上撬下一小块。目标受到@Damage[2d8[slashing]]伤害，进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免。

大成功目标不受伤害。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全额伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。如果败蚁没有微粒（见下文），它便取得一粒目标的精粹微粒；该微粒在24小时后消失。败蚁持有此微粒时，知道目标的距离和方向。

大失败如同失败，但伤害翻倍；如果目标原本已处于流失状态，其流失值增加1。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The terminite's last action was a successful jaws Strike against a creature

Effect The terminite's reality-shearing mandibles pry free a piece of the target. The target takes @Damage[2d8[slashing]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. If the terminite doesn't have a mote (see below), it gains a mote of the target's essence that vanishes after 24 hours. While the terminite has this mote, it knows the distance and direction to the target.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage and the target's drained value increases by 1 if it was already drained.

items.name: 吞噬微粒

频率每天一次

Frequency once per day

Effect The terminite consumes the mote. The target reduces its drained value by 1 and the terminite regains @Damage[2d10[healing]] Hit Points.

items.description:
超大机枪（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|traits:analog]豁免）（非电子，@Template[type:cone|distance:45]），伤害@Damage[(2d8+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage]

你试图命中锥形内的每个生物，该锥形长度等于武器射程增量的一半，不进行攻击检定。区域内的任何生物受到武器伤害，进行一次DC 25基础反射豁免。此伤害是区域伤害。豁免大失败的生物，会受到该武器重击时发生的效果，包括武器的重击专精效果。自动射击的耗弹等于区域内目标数量×2。
items.expectedDescription:
Oversized machine gun (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|traits:analog] save) (analog, @Template[type:cone|distance:45]), Damage @Damage[(2d8+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage]

You attempt to hit each creature in a cone with a range equal to half the weapon's range increment without making an attack roll. Any creature in the area takes weapon damage (Basic DC 25 reflex save). This damage is area damage. Creatures that critically fail this save are subject to effects that occur on a critical hit with this weapon, including the weapon's critical specialization effect. Auto-Fire has an expend equal to the number of targets in the area × 2.

items.name: 开火
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至炮塔30尺内，或攻击炮塔

效果炮塔对触发生物进行一次远程打击；随后，陷阱掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the turret or attacks the turret

Effect The turret makes a ranged Strike against the triggering creature; the trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A mechanized turret attacks intruders.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一座机械炮塔攻击入侵者。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:20] (trained) to reprogram the turret, or @Check[crafting|dc:19] (trained) to cut power to the turret, or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to disable the turret
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:20]（受训）以重编炮塔；或@Check[crafting|dc:19]（受训）以切断炮塔电源；或@Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）以解除炮塔

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap makes three oversized machine gun Strikes against a creature in range, or the trap makes an Auto-Fire attack followed by one Strike against a creature in range.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱对射程内的一个生物进行三次超大机枪打击，或先进行一次自动射击，再对射程内的一个生物打击一次。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets after 1 minute.

items.name: 场景重现
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入危害所在区域

效果该危害将星舰送入时间循环。受影响星舰上过去10分钟发生的事件与当前事件相互重叠，使现实扭曲。生物能听到并看到这些循环发生的事件。然后，该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the hazard's zone

Effect The hazard sends the starship into a time loop. The events of the last 10 minutes on board the affected starship overlap with ongoing events, causing reality to distort. Creatures can hear and see the looping events. The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: 扭曲现实
items.description: 循环与现实的叠加开始使时空不堪重负。受影响星舰上的每个生物受到@Damage[(3d10+18)[force]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic]豁免。该危害每使用五次扭曲现实，星舰上的生物便受到@Damage[(6d10+36)[mental]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}状态，持续1天。
items.expectedDescription: The loop's superposition with reality starts to strain space and time. Each creature on the affected starship takes @Damage[(3d10+18)[force]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic] save. Every five times the hazard uses Distort Reality, creatures on board the starship take @Damage[(6d10+36)[mental]] damage and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 day.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Stuck in an endless time loop, the same scene plays out over and over again in redundant detail.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 同一场景困在无尽的时间循环中，一再重演，连细枝末节也不断重复。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[occultism|dc:38] (expert; magic conduit, scanners) or Religion (expert; magic conduit, scanners) to find the right timeline, @Check[arcana|dc:40] (expert; any battle station) or Society (expert; any battle station) to introduce enough paradoxes to shut down the loop; four successes are required to disable the hazard
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[occultism|dc:38]（专家；魔法导管、扫描仪）或宗教（专家；魔法导管、扫描仪），以找到正确的时间线；@Check[arcana|dc:40]（专家；任意作战站位）或社群（专家；任意作战站位），以引入足够的悖论来终止循环；解除危害需要四次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The hazard uses Distort Reality on its turn every round until someone disables it.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）危害在每轮自己的回合使用扭曲现实，直到有人将其解除。

items.name: 纳米
items.description: 不应用多重攻击减值
items.expectedDescription: No multiple attack penalty

items.name: 释放纳米机器人
items.description:
触发一个生物进入房间或在房间内结束其回合

效果陷阱对触发生物进行纳米机器人打击，然后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters the room or ends its turn in the room

Effect The trap makes a nanite Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

items.name: 纳米机器人集群
items.description:
触发房间内的一个生物结束其回合

效果陷阱对触发生物进行纳米机器人打击。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within the room ends its turn

Effect The trap makes a nanite Strike against the triggering creature.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: When sensors detect movement in the trapped room, the doors seal shut, and four wall apertures open, releasing disintegrating nanites into the room.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 传感器侦测到陷阱房间内的移动时，房门密封，墙上四个开孔打开，向房内释放解离纳米机器。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:22] (trained) or Thievery (trained) on the control panel to deactivate the trap, or @Check[computers|dc:24] (trained) to reprogram the control panel
cnText_system_details_disable.text: 在控制面板进行@Check[crafting|dc:22]（受训）或贼活（受训），以停用陷阱；或@Check[computers|dc:24]（受训）以重编控制面板

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The trap launches nanites against every creature in the room as 1 action. Because it launches nanites continuously, the trap can also use the Nanite Swarm free action (see below) to launch nanites at each creature during that creature's turn.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）陷阱用一个动作向房间内每个生物发射纳米机器。由于持续发射，它还可以在每个生物的回合中使用纳米集群自由动作，向该生物发射纳米机器，见下文。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.expected: (expert) or DC 31 (expert) to notice the control panel
cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.text: （专家），或DC 31（专家）以发现控制面板

items.name: 潜水能力
items.description: 鱼雷迷你潜艇能在水下航行，其储气罐可供2个中型生物维持至多24小时。鱼雷迷你潜艇能安全下潜至1里深处。如果破损，鱼雷迷你潜艇的储气罐便会漏气，每轮使储存的空气减少10分钟的用量。破损鱼雷迷你潜艇的最大下潜深度减半（如有必要，在破损时上浮至该深度）。
items.expectedDescription: The torpedo minisub can travel beneath the surface of the water, carrying an air reservoir suitable to sustain 2 Medium creatures for up to 24 hours. The torpedo minisub can safely reach depths of up to 1 mile. If broken, the torpedo minisub loses air from its reservoir, reducing the stored air by 10 minutes per round. A broken torpedo minisub has its maximum depth reduced by half (and rises to that depth when broken, if necessary).

QNhmxvooLTWI8U51.name: 星石哨兵 Starstone Sentry

items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你可以向居住在电脑中的精魂提问，并从他们那里得到答案。这些合成灵魂会在计算机代码中显现，通常会因设备的性质、状态、应用和个性化设置而具有不同的个性。计算机的视角、感官和知识使它的世界观与人类的世界观大相径庭，以至于它认为某些细节并不重要。计算机能回答的大多数问题都与过去曾与它们互动的生物有关，还有它们的文件中隐藏的信息。

升阶（6环）持续时间8小时。
items.name: 与计算机交谈（恒定）
分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

items.name: 治疗术
items.description:
你引导命能来治疗活物或伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿的活物，便为其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，便对其造成等量命能伤害，且其可以进行基础强韧豁免。施放本法术时花费的动作数，决定目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）法术射程为30尺。如果治疗活物，恢复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能，以爆发范围内所有活物与不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1）治疗量或伤害增加1d8，且两动作版本的额外治疗量增加8。
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

items.name: 修复术
items.description:
你修复目标物品。每有一环法术环阶，便为目标恢复5生命值；如果修复后超过物品的破损阈值，可能移除@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}状态。你无法补回遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环）你能以负载不超过1的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环）你能以负载不超过2的非魔法物体，或负载不超过1的魔法物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.description:
最简单的魔法听从你的指令。只要持续维持法术，你就能产生简单的魔法效应。每次维持时，你可以选择以下四个选项之一。

  • 烹饪冷却、加热或调味1磅非活体材料。
  • 抬升将一件无人持有、负载为轻型或更低的物体缓缓抬离地面1尺。
  • 制造以凝结的魔法物质创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计。该物体外观粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱，不能用作工具、武器、施法载体或法术开销。
  • 整理为一件负载为轻型或更低的物体染色、清洁或弄脏。专注10轮可以影响一个1负载的物体；对于更大的物体，每负载需要1分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（上述说明以外的改变），都只在你持续维持法术期间存在。
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

items.name: 受祝通讯
items.expectedDescription: Special comms allow the Starstone sentry to speak over any distance with any other Starstone construct, as long as both they and their target are on Absalom Station.
items.description: 特殊的通讯器允许星石哨兵与任何其他星石构装体进行任意距离的通话，只要它们和其通话目标都位于艾巴萨罗姆空间站上。

items.name: 稳定灵光
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. Any creatures or objects within the aura, chosen by the Starstone sentry, reduce the DC the flat check for the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd] condition by 2.
items.description: （灵光，神术） 30尺。灵光范围内任何被星石哨兵选定的生物或物体，其@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]状态的纯骰检定DC降低2。

items.name: 维护规程
items.expectedDescription: The Starstone sentry forms an integrated tool from its crystalline arms: a hacking tool, maker's toolkit, or repair toolkit. The item lasts for 24 hours, until the Starstone sentry chooses to end it as a free action, or until it uses Maintenance Catechism again.
items.description: （神术，操作） 星石哨兵的水晶手臂形成一件集成工具：一件黑客工具，创客工具包，或修理工具包。物品持续24小时，直到星石哨兵选择以一个自由动作结束它，或直到其再次使用维护规程。

items.name: 艾巴萨罗姆空间站学识

QNhmxvooLTWI8U51.publicNotes:
星石哨兵维护星石反应堆，并守卫通往反应堆的道路，防止入侵者进入。每个星石哨兵都由一个星石守卫创造，身上带有该守护者的魔法电路图案，但哨兵的电路既非原样复制，也非完美映照。人们不清楚星石守卫为何创造这些哨兵，甚至不知道具体的创造过程；然而，每当星石面临重大危险或艾巴萨罗姆空间站即将发生动荡时，总会出现更多崭新而闪耀的星石哨兵。

星石哨兵比创造它们的守护者略小，也更为脆弱，但在保护艾巴萨罗姆空间站核心、由星石供能的反应堆时，它们同样尽职尽责。星石哨兵的举止与言语呈现出令人不安的对称性，尤其是彼此靠近时。虽然每个星石哨兵的外表都更像某个特定的守护者，而非其他守护者，但它们始终会遵从任何守护者的指示。

星石构装体

星石构装体是古老的魔法科技构装体，负责保护和维护星石反应堆。反应堆由传说中的星石驱动，是空间站的能量来源。它们沉默寡言、态度疏离，只关心反应堆及其持续运作。星石构装体警觉而虔诚，履行职责时流露着显而易见的敬意。人们几乎从未在尖峰区以外见过它们，即使在星石反应堆周围的舱室以外也极少见到。当任务使它们离开主要职责所在之处时，它们会力求迅速而高效地完成任务。

星石构装体是高大、宽肩、闪耀着铂金光泽的机器人形生物，纤细的四肢由半透明的蓝色水晶构成。它们的面孔如同面具，除了三个圆形眼孔之外几乎没有其他特征。眼孔内的发光球体会眨动、睁大、眯起，并如生物的眼睛般活动。每个星石构装体的水晶肢体及金属躯干两侧都蚀刻着精巧的魔法电路图案。

星石构装体具有人形，却不遵循大多数类人生物的习俗与习惯，唯独会用布料披饰装点自身，如同类人生物穿戴衣物一般。星石披肩上绣着施加过法术的丝线，据说蕴含着巨大的魔法能量。

QVdhSITToMwObJHR.name: 暴徒 Tough
QVdhSITToMwObJHR.publicNotes:
暴徒是低级帮派成员，充当更强大罪犯的望风者、信使或打手。哪里有一个暴徒，附近肯定还有更多。

帮派分子

犯罪行会、犯罪家族、收取保护费的团伙和高利贷者，只是艾巴萨罗姆空间站众多帮派类型中的一小部分。帮派有强烈的地域性，惯于掠夺他人，且极其重视地盘。成员因不同原因加入，但大多数人都发现，一旦入帮，就很难轻易脱身。

帮派分子总有自己的生财之道，也就是用来赚钱的犯罪生意，但大多数帮派也惯常收取保护费。在帮派地盘内做生意的人——更糟的是，生意位于多个帮派地盘的交界处——通常都得定期交钱，否则就可能面临严重后果。

TdLUj5eeEJ6MtZNl.publicNotes:
利亚瓦拉富含气体的大气中，经魔法增大的浮游生物构成了这颗行星食物链的最底层。许多浮游生物物种起初只是简单的滤食者，却因梦者无言歌声的振动而发生转变。奇术胞便是其中之一：它们在奇气充盈的区域演化，并因异能力量的干涉而长得远比典型的微生物巨大。

奇术胞看上去如同不断变形的囊袋，内含虹彩液体与色彩鲜艳的细胞器。经过魔法强化的法术外膜使这些漂浮的变形虫状生物能在各种环境中生存。一些奇特的单细胞生物偷乘不受监管的奇气采矿船后，已扩散至整个协约世界。强大魔法——例如星石——对它们有着特别的吸引力，因此许多奇术胞潜伏在艾巴萨罗姆空间站中。

大多数奇术胞能长至约3尺宽，通常呈半透明状，略带暖色。这种体色有利于它们隐匿在利亚瓦拉的大气中，却让它们在艾巴萨罗姆空间站的大部分地方显得怪异而醒目。

UoHLshDZHt3RacNq.name: 赏金猎人 Bounty Hunter
UoHLshDZHt3RacNq.publicNotes:
无论是追捕逃犯、逃跑的债务人还是浪子继承人，赏金猎人只要钱到位就会无情地追逐猎物。虽然许多目标被通缉“不论死活”，或者干脆就是“死”，但下方的猎人擅长使用其磁力绳球和电击武器将目标活捉回来。

雇佣兵

只要万能的信用点能买到权力、安全和舒适，它就同样能从走投无路、不讲道理、冷酷无情的人那里买到暴力。艾巴萨罗姆空间站中有数不清的佣兵公司和自由雇佣兵，他们都热切地向出价最高者提供服务。

有些佣兵拥有道德准则或荣誉感，限制了他们能够接受的合同，而艾巴萨罗姆的法律也严格限制准军事公司可以向成员分派的工作。当然，如果知道该去哪里寻找，仍能在空间站阴暗的角落发现滋生的暗杀勾当，以及更恶劣的行径。

雇佣兵并非总是特工或士兵。有时，他们是狡猾的施法者、强大的恒星武士或阴险的使节。赏金猎人是在空间站出没的最常见佣兵类别之一。下方的赏金猎人是追捕危险亡命徒的菁英敌人示例，而帮派分子的数据也能用来代表较低等级的佣兵。

items.expectedDescription: A hoverbike maintains an altitude of 6 inches above other surfaces, such as the ground or water. If driven off a high surface, the hoverbike loses 20 feet of altitude per round, landing without harm to the hoverbike or its pilot.

items.name: 边车
items.description: 悬浮摩托配有一个流线型边车，可在载具未使用时通过一个10分钟的活动装上或拆下。装上边车时，悬浮摩托除驾驶员外还能搭载一名乘客，但其速度受到–5尺状态减值。
items.expectedDescription: A hoverbike comes with a sleek sidecar that can be attached or detached as a 10-minute activity while the vehicle isn't in use. While attached, the hoverbike can carry one passenger in addition to its pilot but takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speed.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Famed for its sleek knifelike design and matte black coating, the hoverbike is the go-to vehicle for enterprising couriers and street racers alike, owing to its quick acceleration capability and high cruising speeds. It's also especially popular among low-level biker gangs due to the included sidecar, which allows them to transport more people to and from confrontations with other gangs.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 悬浮摩托以流畅的刀锋造型和哑光黑涂层闻名，凭借迅捷加速与高速巡航能力，成为进取的快递员和街头赛车手的首选。它还配有边斗，能运载更多人在帮派冲突间往返，因此也格外受基层飞车党欢迎。

WzwN4v7h1ea2pLsr.name: 监视法师 Surveillance Mage
WzwN4v7h1ea2pLsr.publicNotes:
监视法师是一名隐秘操作者，能让任何企业外勤团队或安全团队成为令人生畏的力量。

企业资产

企业雇用并训练专门的“资产”，也就是警卫，来保护自己的利益。

items.name: 次元封固
items.description: 你创造一道可见的魔法屏障，尝试反制进出区域的传送效应和位面旅行，包括能进入异次元空间的物品。次元封固会尝试反制任何将生物召唤至区域内的行为，但不会阻止生物在召唤结束时离开。
items.expectedDescription: You create a visible magical barrier that attempts to counteract teleportation effects and planar travel into or out of the area, including items that allow access to extradimensional spaces. Planar seal tries to counteract any attempt to summon a creature into the area but doesn't stop the creature from departing when the summoning ends.

items.name: 回溯过去
items.description:
你向心灵回响敞开心智，获得当前位置过去所发生事件的印象。回溯过去在持续时间的第一分钟内揭示过去一天所发生事件的心灵印象，第二分钟揭示再往前一天的印象，以此类推。这些回响不会如影像般展现，而是通过情绪与隐喻的印象，提供关于过去的隐晦线索和细节。如果你通过印象目睹创伤性或动荡的事件，法术便会结束，除非你成功通过意志豁免；DC至少为30，视事件严重程度可能高达50。GM决定事件是否具有创伤性，并选择DC。

升阶（8环）你每专注1分钟，获得的印象涵盖之前1年发生的事件，而非之前1天；但细节会减少，除最重大的事件之外，其他事件的印象更难分辨。

升阶（9环）你每专注1分钟，获得的印象涵盖之前1个世纪发生的事件，而非之前1天；但细节会减少，除最重大的事件之外，其他事件的印象几乎无法分辨。
items.expectedDescription:
Opening your mind to mental echoes, you gain impressions from past events that occurred in your current location. Retrocognition reveals psychic impressions from events that occurred over the course of the last day throughout the first minute of the duration, followed by impressions from the next day back the next minute, and so on. These echoes don't play out like a vision but instead reveal impressions of emotions and metaphors that provide cryptic clues and details of the past. If you witness a traumatic or turbulent event through an impression, the spell ends unless you succeed at a Will save with a DC of at least 30 and possibly as much as 50, depending on the severity of the event. The GM determines whether an event is traumatic and chooses the DC.

Heightened (8th) You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous year for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it harder to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.

Heightened (9th) You gain impressions of events that occurred over the previous century for each minute you concentrate, instead of the previous day, though the details diminish, making it almost impossible to distinguish impressions from all but the most major events.

items.name: 洞烛机先
items.description:
你深入探查未来数秒的可能性，了解敌人可能避免伤害的各种方式，并将未来的影像投向周围的人。指定一个生物。洞烛机先持续时间内，每个目标首次对该生物进行攻击检定时，攻击者掷两次并采用较好结果。攻击者还会忽略攻击检定的环境减值，以及因指定生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态而需要进行的任何纯骰检定。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HuvucQ5nfpuVWNrw]{法术效果：洞烛机先}
items.expectedDescription:
You delve into the possible futures of the next few seconds to understand all the ways your foe might avoid harm, then cast out a vision of that future to those around you. Designate a creature. The first time each target makes an attack roll against that creature during true target's duration, the attacker rolls twice and uses the better result. The attacker also ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the designated creature being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HuvucQ5nfpuVWNrw]{Spell Effect: True Target}

items.name: 真景术
items.description: 你看见60尺内事物的真实面貌。GM对抗区域内任何幻术、形变或变形效应，进行秘密反制检定，但仅用于判断你能否看穿该效应（例如，对抗变形法术的检定成功时，你能看见生物的真实形态，却不会结束该变形法术）。
items.expectedDescription: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

items.name: 控制机器
items.expectedDescription:
You take control of a technological creature or object and command it telepathically. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order to a sapient target, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the controlled condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if it's sapient and you give it a new order that's against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你可以控制一个科技特征的生物或物体，并以心灵感应的方式命令它。如果你向有生命的目标发出明显的自毁命令，该目标在你发出新命令之前不会行动。效果取决于其意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标因为要抵抗你的命令而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

失败你控制了目标。目标将获得被控制状态，但可以在每个回合结束时尝试意志豁免。成功后，法术结束。

大失败与失败相同，但只有智慧目标，并且你给它下达了违背其本性的新命令（例如杀死它的盟友）时，才能进行新的意志豁免。

升阶（10阶）持续时间不受限制。

items.name: 虚假景象
items.description: 你创造虚假的影像，欺骗任何针对区域的探知尝试。任何探知法术看到、听到、闻到或以其他方式侦测到的，都是你希望区域内呈现的事物，而非真实情况。你可以每轮维持法术，随意改变幻象，包括演绎复杂的场景。如果探知法术的环阶高于虚假景象，探知者可以尝试察觉检定识破幻象，但即使成功，也无法得知区域内真正发生的情况。
items.expectedDescription: You create a false image that fools any attempts to scry on an area. Any scrying spell sees, hears, smells, and otherwise detects whatever you wish within the area, rather than what is actually in the area. You can Sustain the spell each round to change the illusion as you desire, including playing out a complex scene. If the scrying spell is of a higher rank than false vision, the scryer can attempt a Perception check to disbelieve the illusion, though even if they're successful, they can't learn what's truly going on in the area.

items.name: 幻象场景
items.description:
你创造一个虚构场景，包含至多10个大小各异、彼此独立的生物或物体，全部都必须位于法术区域内。这些元素会产生适当的声音和气味，触感也十分真实。幻象场景中的元素无法说话。与你使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻象生物}法术时不同，场景中的生物没有战斗能力或数据。场景不会改变周围环境，但你可以将场景放置在其他幻术法术创造的虚幻环境中。

创造场景时，你可以选择让其保持静态，或按照预设程序变化。静态场景虽然不移动，却包含基本的自然动作，例如风吹过一张幻象纸时，纸会沙沙作响。程序至多持续1分钟，结束后重复。例如，你可以创造两个兽人互相打斗的场景，每次重复时，战斗都会以相同方式进行。如果创造循环，两名战士在场景开始和结束时都会位于相同位置；但你可以使程序衔接顺畅，让人难以察觉循环何时结束、何时开始。任何观察场景超过几分钟的人，几乎总会注意到它在循环。创造幻象后，你无法改变程序。

任何触碰影像任一部分，或以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作检查它的生物，都可以尝试识破幻象。如果生物只与幻象的一部分互动，便只会识破该部分。只有大成功时，才能识破整个场景。

升阶（6环）场景中的生物或物体可以说话。创造程序时，你必须说出每个角色的具体台词。法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

升阶（8环）如同6环版本，且持续时间无限。
items.expectedDescription:
You craft an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of other illusion spells.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

items.name: 探视魔眼
items.description:
你在500尺内一个能看见的位置，创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮眼睛，直径1英寸。它以你通常的视觉感官看向各个方向，并持续将所见传递给你。

每轮首次维持法术时，你可以将眼睛移动至多30尺，只看见眼睛前方的事物；或移动至多10尺，看见周围各个方向的一切。眼睛与你之间的距离没有上限，但如果你与眼睛不再处于同一位面，法术立即结束。如果想以眼睛进行察觉检定，你可以通过它进行搜索动作。眼睛受到任何伤害都会被摧毁，并使法术结束。
items.expectedDescription:
You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, floating eye, 1 inch in diameter, at a location you can see within 500 feet. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses and continuously transmits what it sees to you.

The first time you Sustain the spell each round, you can either move the eye up to 30 feet, seeing only things in front of the eye, or move it up to 10 feet, seeing everything in all directions around it. There is no limit to how far from you the eye can move, but the spell ends immediately if you and the eye ever cease to be on the same plane of existence. You can attempt Seek actions through the eye if you want to attempt Perception checks with it. Any damage dealt to the eye destroys it and ends the spell.

items.name: 鹰眼术
items.description: 你在射程内一个位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮眼睛（即使该位置在你的视线或效应线之外）。眼睛不能移动，但你能如同使用正常视觉感官般，从该处看向所有方向。
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

items.name: 次元拴绳
items.description:
你将目标缝合在当前位面上。目标受次元拴绳影响期间，法术会尝试反制任何将目标移动的传送效应，或将其送往其他位面的效应。次元拴绳的持续时间取决于目标的意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功效应持续1分钟。

失败效应持续10分钟。

大失败效应持续1小时。
items.expectedDescription:
You stitch the target to its current plane. While the target is affected by planar tether, the spell attempts to counteract any teleportation effect that would move the target, or any effect that would transport it to a different plane. Planar tether's duration is determined by the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The effect's duration is 1 minute.

Failure The effect's duration is 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The effect's duration is 1 hour.

items.name: 计算机交谈
items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你可以向居住在电脑中的精魂提问，并从他们那里得到答案。这些合成灵魂会在计算机代码中显现，通常会因设备的性质、状态、应用和个性化设置而具有不同的个性。计算机的视角、感官和知识使它的世界观与人类的世界观大相径庭，以至于它认为某些细节并不重要。计算机能回答的大多数问题都与过去曾与它们互动的生物有关，还有它们的文件中隐藏的信息。

升阶（6环）持续时间8小时。

items.name: 心灵感应
items.description:
你能与30尺内的生物以心灵感应交流。与一个生物交流并建立连接后，通讯便是双向的。你只能与具有共同语言的生物交流。

升阶（6环）即使没有共同语言，你也能以共享心象与生物进行心灵感应交流；心灵感应失去语言特征。
items.expectedDescription:
You can communicate telepathically with creatures within 30 feet. Once you establish a connection by communicating with a creature, the communication is two-way. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you.

Heightened (6th) You can communicate telepathically with creatures using shared mental imagery even if you don't share a language; telepathy loses the linguistic trait.

items.name: 次元移位
items.description:
你将自己以及穿戴和持握的物品，立即从当前空间传送至射程内一个能看见的未占据空间。如果这会带着另一个生物同行，即使该生物被装在异次元容器中，法术也会失效。

升阶（5环）射程提高至1里。你不必看见目的地，只要曾经到过那里，并知道其与你的相对位置和距离。之后，你暂时免疫1小时。
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

items.name: 目盲术
items.description:
你使目标目盲，效应取决于目标的强韧豁免。之后，目标暂时免疫1分钟。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}状态，持续至其下一回合开始。

失败目标目盲1分钟。

大失败目标永久目盲。
items.expectedDescription:
You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

items.name: 锐耳术
items.description: 你在射程内一个位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}的悬浮耳朵（即使在你的视线或效应线之外）。它不能移动，但你能如同使用正常听觉感官般，通过耳朵听见声音。
items.expectedDescription: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

items.name: 选择性隐形
items.expectedDescription:
A willing creature you touch becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} to everyone except a second target within the spell's range. If the invisible creature uses a hostile action against anyone who isn't the target that can see them, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (5th) You can make up to 6 willing creatures within 30 feet invisible, but they all must have the same target.
items.description:
一个你接触的自愿生物对除射程内第二目标以外的人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]。如果隐形生物对目标以外的任何人使用敌对行动，该敌对行动结束后，法术也随之结束。

升阶（5环）你可以让30尺内最多6个自愿生物隐形，但他们的目标必须是同一人。

items.name: 缓慢术
items.description:
你拉长目标周围的时间流，使其行动变慢。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态，持续1轮。

失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态，持续1分钟。

大失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢2}状态，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环）你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: 回避帷幕
items.description: 你建立防护结界，使目标难以被魔法侦测。持续时间内，回避帷幕尝试反制所有用于对付目标或其装备的侦测、揭示和探知效应，此时将戏法视为1环法术。成功反制以区域或多个目标为目标的法术时，仅为回避帷幕的目标免除效应。
items.expectedDescription: You erect protective wards that make the target difficult to detect via magic. Veil of privacy attempts to counteract all detection, revelation, and scrying effects used against the target or the target's gear throughout the duration, counting cantrips as 1st-rank spells for this purpose. Successfully counteracting a spell that targets an area or multiple targets negates the effects for only veil of privacy's target.

items.name: 朦胧术
items.description: 目标的形体变得模糊，处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。但此效应仍使目标的位置显而易见，因此目标不能利用这种隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。
items.expectedDescription: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

items.name: 敲击术
items.description:
你使目标更容易打开。任何生物以运动或贼活检定尝试打开目标门、锁或容器时，敲击术都赋予其+4状态加值。施放敲击术时，你能作为施法的一部分尝试贼活检定打开目标，即使未受训，也将自己的等级加入检定。

敲击术反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{固锁术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.OSapCU8heNHst21y]{法术效果：敲击术}
items.expectedDescription:
You make the target easier to open. Knock grants a +4 status bonus to any creature that tries to open the target door, lock, or container with an Athletics or a Thievery check. You can attempt a Thievery check to open the target as part of casting knock, and you add your level even if you're untrained.

Knock counteracts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.OSapCU8heNHst21y]{Spell Effect: Knock}

items.name: 显光尘
items.description:
一波魔法光亮扫过区域。你选择光的外观，例如色彩斑斓、没有热量的火焰，或闪烁的光点。受显光尘影响的生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态。如果该生物原本处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态，便改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。如果该生物原本因任何其他原因而隐蔽，则不再隐蔽。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功光亮影响该生物2轮。

失败光亮影响该生物1分钟。

大失败光亮影响该生物10分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. If the creature was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.

items.name: 警报术
items.description:
你为一片区域设防，使生物未经许可进入时向你报警。施放警报术时，选择一个口令。每当小型或更大的实体生物进入法术区域，却未说出口令时，警报术便按你的选择发送心灵警讯（此时法术获得心灵特征），或发出声音和音量如同手铃的警报（此时法术获得听觉特征）。两种方式都会自动唤醒你，铃声还允许区域内每个生物尝试@Check[perception|dc:15]检定醒来。知道警报存在的生物，进入区域时必须成功通过对抗法术DC的隐秘检定，否则触发法术。

升阶（3环）你能指定哪些类型的生物会触发警报术。
items.expectedDescription:
You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast alarm, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the mental trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the auditory trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a @Check[perception|dc:15] check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a Stealth check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.

Heightened (3rd) You can specify a trigger for which types of creatures sound the alarm spell.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

items.name: 电弧击
items.description:
一道闪电弧从一个目标跃向另一个目标。每个目标受到2d4电击伤害，进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。
items.expectedDescription:
An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

items.name: 快速移动
items.description:
你的速度获得+30尺状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{法术效果：快速移动}
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a +30-foot status bonus to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{Spell Effect: Fleet Step}

items.name: 幻象伪装
items.description:
你创造幻象，使目标看起来像另一个体态相同，身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近的生物。伪装通常足以掩盖目标的身份，却不能冒充特定个体。法术改变目标的外观与声音，却不改变举止。你能改变其衣物及穿戴物品的外观，例如使护甲看起来像裙子。持握物品不受影响，任何穿戴物品从生物身上取下后，都会恢复真实外观。

施放幻象伪装，视为为欺骗技能的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装}用途准备伪装；它忽略目标因伪装成与自身不同的生物而可能承受的环境减值，赋予其防止他人看破伪装的欺骗检定+4状态加值，并让目标即使未受训也能将等级加入此类欺骗检定。你可以解除此法术。

升阶（3环）目标能呈现为任何相同体型的生物，甚至特定个体。你必须见过该个体，才能复制其外观；听过其声音，才能复制其声音。

升阶（4环）你能以至多10个自愿生物为目标。如果以多个生物为目标，你可以为每个目标选择不同伪装，但均不能冒充特定个体。你可以分别解除每个伪装，也可以全部一起解除。

升阶（7环）如同4环，但你可以选择冒充特定个体的伪装。你必须见过该个体，才能复制其外观；听过其声音，才能复制其声音。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{法术效果：幻象伪装}
items.expectedDescription:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 讯息传递
items.description: 你将心智与目标的心智连接，瞬间向其传递通常需要10分钟才能交流完的信息。
items.expectedDescription: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

items.name: 阅读灵光
items.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心智感知魔法灵光。施法完成时，你得知该物品是否具有魔法。你以及从你处获知此灵光情况的任何人，在对该物品进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法}时获得+2环境加值。如果物体是幻象，只有该效应的环阶低于你的阅读灵光法术环阶时，你才能发现这一点。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{法术效果：阅读灵光}

升阶（3环）你能以至多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环）你能以任意数量的物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

items.name: 料敌机先
items.description:
在本回合结束前，你下次进行攻击检定时掷两次，并采用较好结果。此次攻击忽略攻击检定的环境减值，以及因目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态而需要进行的任何纯骰检定。之后，你暂时免疫料敌机先10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：料敌机先}
items.expectedDescription:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

items.name: 激光手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这把紧凑的手枪因可靠、耐用且价格实惠，成为协约世界（Pact Worlds）最受欢迎的随身武器。大多数普通激光手枪有轻质聚碳枪身，末端连着细长的枪管。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.

items.name: 纳米锋刃刺剑
items.description:
强化： 1

这把精工刺剑的刃口被磨至单原子厚度，并用再生纳米机器人在无数次打击后维持锋利。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

The edge of this precision-crafted foil is sharpened to the thickness of a single atom, using regenerating nanites to maintain itself after countless strikes.

items.name: 保温织服
items.description:
强化： 1

温控编织服以保温面料和散热导线织成，是一种经过加固的兜帽服饰，前往卡斯卓韦或普洛尼斯（Pulonis）的丛林等潮湿气候地区旅行时，穿戴它很流行。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.

items.name: 战术型黑视电容义眼
items.expectedDescription:
These replacement cybernetic eyes grant you darkvision. Darkvision capacitors operate by emitting low-powered ultraviolet lasers that receptors in the capacitors can detect. These lasers are visible to creatures that can see on the ultraviolet light spectrum.

These upgraded capacitors include a wide-spectrum ocular implant that allows you to see infrared and ultraviolet light, including the lasers from other darkvision capacitors. You gain darkvision and a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} if they involve sight.
items.description:
这种替换的机械眼能给予你黑暗视觉。黑视电容型义眼的运作原理是发射低功率的紫外光激光，并透过义眼中的感受器来侦测这些雷射。能看见紫外光的生物可以侦测到这些激光。

这些经过升级的电容器配有广谱眼部植入物，让你能看见红外光与紫外光，包括其他黑暗视觉电容器发出的激光。你获得黑暗视觉，且在用于以下用途的察觉检定上获得+2物品加值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索} ，若涉及视觉。

items.name: 先进型黑客工具包
items.description: 骇入计算机的计算机检定需要黑客工具包。你可以用黑客工具包绕过用户界面访问计算机，但必须与计算机进行物理接触，或通过信息圈或类似的连接网络接触它。先进型黑客工具包在用它进行的检定上提供+1物品加值，并让你能够访问30尺内的计算机，除非你处于辐射环境中。
items.expectedDescription: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network. An advanced hacking toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks made with it and allows you to access computers at a range of 30 feet, unless you're in a radioactive environment.

items.name: 纳米光学节点
items.expectedDescription:
A crystalline nanocarbon node implanted in your occipital lobe connects to optic nerves by microscopic fibers. You can activate the node to overlay your normal vision with X-ray data. You can deactivate the overlay as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Activate—X-Ray Overlay 1 (concentrate)

Effect Your nano-optics node relays collected X-ray data directly to your eyes, overlaying your normal vision. You can see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white. Due to the distracting amount of visual information, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks while the overlay is active.
items.description:
植入枕叶中的纳米碳结晶节点透过极细的光学纤维与你的视神经相连。你可以启动此节点，用X光数据覆盖你的正常视觉。你可以用单动作解除此视觉覆盖，此动作带有专注特征。

启动—X光覆盖 1 （专注）

效果 你的纳米视觉节点将收集到的X射线数据直接传送至双眼，叠加在你的通常视觉上。你可以看穿60尺内的大多数材料和墙壁。2尺厚的木材或塑料、1尺厚的石材、2英寸厚的普通金属，以及任意厚度的铅或星金属都会阻挡你的视线，而且你只能看见黑白影像。由于大量视觉信息令人分心，此叠加视觉激活期间，你在察觉检定上承受–2环境减值。

items.name: 莫测射击
items.description: 监视法师进行打击，然后行走。如果此次行走结束时具有掩蔽，便能尝试[[/act hide]]。
items.expectedDescription: The surveillance mage Strikes, then Strides. If they have cover at the end of the Stride, they can attempt to [[/act hide]].

items.name: 盯上你了
items.description:

items.name: 探知术
items.description:
你以魔法窥探一个自选生物。探知如同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{鹰眼术}，但接收到的影像较不精确，不足以用于传送术及类似法术。你不在500尺内的固定位置创造眼睛，而是使眼睛直接出现在目标上方。你可以按名字选择目标，或通过触碰其所有物或身体的一部分选定目标。如果你未曾亲自见过目标，探知的DC降低2；如果你不知道目标的身份（例如在犯罪现场找到一颗不明生物的獠牙），DC则改为降低10。

探知的效应取决于目标的意志豁免。

大成功法术失败，目标暂时免疫1周。目标还会瞥见你，得知与你的大致距离和方向。

成功法术失败，目标暂时免疫1天。

失败法术成功。

大失败法术成功，且目标移动时，眼睛会跟随其移动，每轮至多60尺。
items.expectedDescription:
You magically spy on a creature of your choice. Scrying works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}, except that the image you receive is less precise, insufficient for teleport and similar spells. Instead of creating an eye in a set location within 500 feet, you instead create an eye that manifests just above the target. You can choose a target either by name or by touching one of its possessions or a piece of its body. If you haven't met the target in person, scrying's DC is 2 lower, and if you are unaware of the target's identity (perhaps because you found an unknown creature's fang at a crime scene), the DC is instead 10 lower.

The effect of scrying depends on the target's Will save.

Critical Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 week. The target also gains a glimpse of you and learns its rough distance and direction from you.

Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Failure The spell succeeds.

Critical Failure The spell succeeds, and the eye follows the target if it moves, traveling up to 60 feet per round.

items.name: 黑暗术
items.description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，使光线无法穿透，也无法在区域内发出。光线不能进入该区域，且区域内任何非魔法光源，例如火把或提灯，都不会发光，即使其光照半径本能延伸至黑暗区域之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗术环阶相等或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法通过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，这是一颗纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环）即使具有黑暗视觉（但不是高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。
items.expectedDescription:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

items.expectedDescription: The patrol dirigible can only be steered using its motorized propulsion, otherwise relying on favorable wind currents to carry it in the right direction. If the pilot fails to maintain control of the dirigible using its wind propulsion, the dirigible drifts whichever way the wind carries it, moving up to four times its Speed each round as determined by the GM.

items.expectedDescription: The patrol dirigible provides a place for up to two Huge or smaller vehicles to be docked.

aCYxSC8ddmzyivVl.name: 引力子刺客 Graviton Assassin
aCYxSC8ddmzyivVl.publicNotes:
有人说当你凝视虚空时，虚空也凝视着你。但那些引导虚空的人呢？

受雇行刺的刺客通常是冷酷的实用主义者，只要价钱合适，什么都肯做；但许多人有着自己独特的哲学，或属于鲜为人知的邪教与宗派。职业杀手中受欢迎的神祇包括虚无主义的吞噬者和狡诈的老鼠婆（Lao Shu Po）。一些恒星武士——例如下方这位——认为行刺是维持宇宙平衡所必需的循环的一部分，以此为自己的行为辩护。

雇佣兵

只要万能的信用点能买到权力、安全和舒适，它就同样能从走投无路、不讲道理、冷酷无情的人那里买到暴力。艾巴萨罗姆空间站中有数不清的佣兵公司和自由雇佣兵，他们都热切地向出价最高者提供服务。

有些佣兵拥有道德准则或荣誉感，限制了他们能够接受的合同，而艾巴萨罗姆的法律也严格限制准军事公司可以向成员分派的工作。当然，如果知道该去哪里寻找，仍能在空间站阴暗的角落发现滋生的暗杀勾当，以及更恶劣的行径。

雇佣兵并非总是特工或士兵。有时，他们是狡猾的施法者、强大的恒星武士或阴险的使节。赏金猎人是在空间站出没的最常见佣兵类别之一。下方的赏金猎人是追捕危险亡命徒的菁英敌人示例，而帮派分子的数据也能用来代表较低等级的佣兵。

items.name: 念力巨蜥护甲
items.description:
强化： 1

这种由柔韧而坚固的甲片层叠制成的传统护甲，由卡斯卓韦（Castrovel）的拉申塔人（Lashunta）骑兵穿戴。过去，念力巨蜥骑兵（shotalashu cavalry）会用坐骑蜕下的皮，或更少见地用阵亡坐骑的皮制作护甲，以便在今后的战斗中纪念它们。合成仿制品在卡斯卓韦的某些地区颇为流行。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.

items.name: 黑洞
items.description:
频率每10分钟一次

效果刺客模拟黑洞，从30尺内选择任意数量的生物。每个选定生物受到@Damage[9d8[bludgeoning]]伤害，并必须进行@Check[fortitude|dc:30]豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害，并被拉向刺客5尺。

失败该生物受到完整伤害，被拉向刺客15尺，并在对抗刺客于其回合结束前进行的下一次近战攻击时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态。

大失败该生物受到双倍伤害，被拉向刺客30尺，并被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The assassin emulates a black hole, selecting any number of creatures within 30 feet. Each chosen creature takes @Damage[9d8[bludgeoning]] damage and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pulled 5 feet towards the assassin.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is pulled 15 feet towards the assassin, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next melee attack the assassin makes before the end of the assassin's turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pulled 30 feet towards the assassin, and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

On a critical hit, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} as long as it is immobilized.

c2rqhARro9iIj8up.name: 太空地精垃圾佬 Space Goblin Junker
c2rqhARro9iIj8up.publicNotes:
太空地精垃圾佬潜伏在废铁场（Botscrap）的垃圾场、火花街（Sparks）的工程舱或管道镇（Pipetown）的蜿蜒迷宫中。他们对创造的热爱，与他们对毁灭的造诣不相上下，其中一些地精组成垃圾强盗帮，偷走大而闪亮的科技部件。这些被盗科技随后成为他们谋划建造的下一个科技奇迹的核心部件。

太空地精

地精在艾巴萨罗姆空间站各处都相当常见。它们喜爱狭窄、阴暗的地方，因此空间站的小巷和管道对它们格外有吸引力。许多地精乐于与其他居民共同生活，成为商人、工匠和漫画家（越来越多的地精出版社正在出版无字而富有个性的“地精漫画”），但其他地精则往往会惹是生非。其中一些狡猾的捣蛋鬼在艾巴萨罗姆空间站各处造成停电、火灾，乃至更严重的问题。

items.name: 屠狗刀
items.description:
强化： 1

地精珍视被称为砍狗刀和斩马刀的祖传近战武器，尽管大多数人并不理解原因。地精武器容易制造，却容易损坏。
items.expectedDescription:

Goblins cherish ancestral melee weapons called dogslicers and horsechoppers, but most people don't understand why. Goblin weapons are easy to make but prone to breakage.

items.name: 破障枪

这把短枪管霰弹枪常被用来轰开门和墙壁。它比反应破门枪更小，却以猛烈的反冲而臭名昭著。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This snub-nosed scattergun is commonly used to blast through doors and walls. Smaller than a reaction breacher, this scattergun is infamous for its mighty recoil.
