eUalXSohKGtlHvKr.name: 星石守卫 Starstone Guardian

items.name: 短讯术
items.description: 你向该生物发送不超过25词的心灵信息，它可以立即用自己编写的一段不超过25词的信息回复。
items.expectedDescription: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.

You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你可以向居住在电脑中的精魂提问，并从他们那里得到答案。这些合成灵魂会在计算机代码中显现，通常会因设备的性质、状态、应用和个性化设置而具有不同的个性。计算机的视角、感官和知识使它的世界观与人类的世界观大相径庭，以至于它认为某些细节并不重要。计算机能回答的大多数问题都与过去曾与它们互动的生物有关，还有它们的文件中隐藏的信息。

升阶（6环）持续时间8小时。
items.name: 与计算机交谈（恒定）
分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

items.name: 治疗术
items.description:
你引导命能来治疗活物或伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿的活物，便为其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，便对其造成等量命能伤害，且其可以进行基础强韧豁免。施放本法术时花费的动作数，决定目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）法术射程为30尺。如果治疗活物，恢复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能，以爆发范围内所有活物与不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1）治疗量或伤害增加1d8，且两动作版本的额外治疗量增加8。
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

items.name: 修复术
items.description:
你修复目标物品。每有一环法术环阶，便为目标恢复5生命值；如果修复后超过物品的破损阈值，可能移除@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}状态。你无法补回遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环）你能以负载不超过1的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环）你能以负载不超过2的非魔法物体，或负载不超过1的魔法物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.description:
最简单的魔法听从你的指令。只要持续维持法术，你就能产生简单的魔法效应。每次维持时，你可以选择以下四个选项之一。

  • 烹饪冷却、加热或调味1磅非活体材料。
  • 抬升将一件无人持有、负载为轻型或更低的物体缓缓抬离地面1尺。
  • 制造以凝结的魔法物质创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计。该物体外观粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱，不能用作工具、武器、施法载体或法术开销。
  • 整理为一件负载为轻型或更低的物体染色、清洁或弄脏。专注10轮可以影响一个1负载的物体；对于更大的物体，每负载需要1分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（上述说明以外的改变），都只在你持续维持法术期间存在。
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Riot shields are constructed from sheets of transparent aluminum reinforced with nanocarbon panels layered over polymers or resins. These sleek but sturdy shields are designed to protect most of the wielder's body when raised while allowing them to march in tight tactical formations. Sometimes they're transparent to allow inexperienced wielders to see the other side while the shield is raised, but most experienced warriors have no problem seeing around these shields, and the transparent material quickly becomes too scuffed to see through after a few hits.
items.description: 镇暴盾用透明铝板制成，以分层的纳米碳纤维板进行加固，在其间填充有聚合物和树脂。这些流线型而坚固的盾牌在举起时能保护持用者大部分身体，同时允许其在密集战术队形中行进。有时候它们透明的盾身便于新手在举盾时观察前方，但资深战士通常无需这样做，而且透明材质被几次命中后便会过度磨损难以看透。
items.name: 集成先进型防暴盾
受祝通讯
items.description: 特殊的通讯器允许星石哨兵与任何其他星石构装体进行任意距离的通话，只要它们和其通话目标都位于艾巴萨罗姆空间站上。
items.expectedDescription: Special comms allow the Starstone sentry to speak over any distance with any other Starstone construct, as long as both they and their target are on Absalom Station.

items.name: 稳定灵光
items.expectedDescription: 60 feet. Any creatures or objects within the aura, chosen by the Starstone sentry, reduce the DC the flat check for the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd] condition by 4.
items.description: （灵光，神术）60尺。同星石哨兵，但@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]纯骰检定DC降低4。

items.name: 远步突袭
items.expectedDescription: The Starstone guardian teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet. It can make a projected blade or crystal laser Strike before or after teleporting.
items.description: （传送） 星石守卫传送至60尺内一处未被占据的空间。它在传送前或传送后进行一次投射刀刃或水晶激光打击。

items.name: 艾巴萨罗姆空间站学识

eUalXSohKGtlHvKr.publicNotes:
每个星石守卫体表蚀刻的魔法电路图案都独一无二，述说着各自创造仪式的故事。虽然星石守卫无比古老，但维持其存在的魔法会随着时间流逝不断更新、修复它们，令它们实质上长生不朽。如果被当作独立个体对待，这些构装体往往会感到不自在。当被问及如何称呼时，它们都坚持只需称其为“守护者”。

为了保护反应堆的设施网络，人们创造了更强大的守护者型号，研究它们的工程师和历史学家称之为原初美德。除了少数例外，普通人很少能遇见原初美德。它们各有独特的特征与个性，使相遇的经历令人难忘，有时甚至十分危险。也正因如此，人们对原初美德的特点和能力所知甚少。

星石守卫负责保护使整个空间站运转的反应堆网络，未执行这一任务时，它们态度平和；但它们的防御并非无懈可击。遭腐化或控制的星石守卫更有可能发起攻击。

星石构装体

星石构装体是古老的魔法科技构装体，负责保护和维护星石反应堆。反应堆由传说中的星石驱动，是空间站的能量来源。它们沉默寡言、态度疏离，只关心反应堆及其持续运作。星石构装体警觉而虔诚，履行职责时流露着显而易见的敬意。人们几乎从未在尖峰区以外见过它们，即使在星石反应堆周围的舱室以外也极少见到。当任务使它们离开主要职责所在之处时，它们会力求迅速而高效地完成任务。

星石构装体是高大、宽肩、闪耀着铂金光泽的机器人形生物，纤细的四肢由半透明的蓝色水晶构成。它们的面孔如同面具，除了三个圆形眼孔之外几乎没有其他特征。眼孔内的发光球体会眨动、睁大、眯起，并如生物的眼睛般活动。每个星石构装体的水晶肢体及金属躯干两侧都蚀刻着精巧的魔法电路图案。

星石构装体具有人形，却不遵循大多数类人生物的习俗与习惯，唯独会用布料披饰装点自身，如同类人生物穿戴衣物一般。星石披肩上绣着施加过法术的丝线，据说蕴含着巨大的魔法能量。

epV8z1LMMwqgW7bz.name: 太空地精喷子 Space Goblin Griefcaster
epV8z1LMMwqgW7bz.publicNotes:
一些精通科技的施法者喜欢“刷屏”：使用他们的魔法在信息圈上惹恼人们直至暴怒。一些人也学会了在现实生活中喷人。

太空地精

地精在艾巴萨罗姆空间站各处都相当常见。它们喜爱狭窄、阴暗的地方，因此空间站的小巷和管道对它们格外有吸引力。许多地精乐于与其他居民共同生活，成为商人、工匠和漫画家（越来越多的地精出版社正在出版无字而富有个性的“地精漫画”），但其他地精则往往会惹是生非。其中一些狡猾的捣蛋鬼在艾巴萨罗姆空间站各处造成停电、火灾，乃至更严重的问题。

items.name: 计算机交谈
items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你可以向居住在电脑中的精魂提问，并从他们那里得到答案。这些合成灵魂会在计算机代码中显现，通常会因设备的性质、状态、应用和个性化设置而具有不同的个性。计算机的视角、感官和知识使它的世界观与人类的世界观大相径庭，以至于它认为某些细节并不重要。计算机能回答的大多数问题都与过去曾与它们互动的生物有关，还有它们的文件中隐藏的信息。

升阶（6环）持续时间8小时。

items.name: 断电术
items.description:
你引发一道突如其来的电火花，涌入一个科技生物或物体。你耗尽一件具有科技特征物品的能量，或扰乱一个具有科技特征的生物，具体效应取决于目标是生物还是物体。

  • 生物如果目标是具有科技特征的生物，它进行意志豁免。失败时，该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}状态；大失败时，该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障2}状态。
  • 物体如果你以有人持有的物体为目标，持有该物体的生物进行意志豁免。成功时，物体失去其最大充能的一半。失败时，或你以无人持有的物体为目标时，物体失去其所有剩余充能。
items.expectedDescription:
You ignite a sudden spark of electricity that surges into a technological creature or object. You de-energize an item with the tech trait or disrupt a creature with the tech trait, with effects based on the target being a creature or object.

  • Creature If your target is a creature with the tech trait, it attempts a Will save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}; on a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.
  • Object If you target an attended object, the creature with the object attempts a Will save. On a success, the object loses half of its maximum charges. On a failure, or if you target an unattended object, the object loses all its remaining charges.

items.name: 闪电枷锁
items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 火球术
items.description:
咆哮的火焰在你指定的位置爆炸，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加2d6。
items.expectedDescription:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

items.name: 闪电束
items.description:
一道闪电从你手中向外射出，造成4d12电击伤害。

升阶 （+1） 伤害增加1d12。
items.expectedDescription:
A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing 4d12 electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

items.name: 缓慢术
items.description:
你拉长目标周围的时间流，使其行动变慢。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态，持续1轮。

失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态，持续1分钟。

大失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢2}状态，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环）你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: 瞬效病毒
items.expectedDescription:
Your touch installs a dangerous self-replicating virus that disrupts a technological creature's programming. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}.

Failure The target is glitching 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.
items.description:
你通过接触安装一种危险的自增殖病毒，会扰乱科技生物的程序。目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]。

失败目标陷入故障1和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

大失败目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑2}。

items.name: 隐形术
items.description:
幻术使光线绕过目标，令其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}状态。因此，目标对所有生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}状态，但生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对自己改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}状态。如果目标使用敌对动作，法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环）法术持续1分钟，但目标使用敌对动作时不会结束。
items.expectedDescription:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.description:
元素能量护盾保护一个生物，使其抵御一种能量伤害。选择强酸、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波伤害。目标及其装备获得对所选伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环）抗力提高至10，且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环）抗力提高至15，且你能以至多五个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.

items.name: 浏览数据
items.description:
你触碰一件物体，专注于其中的一组数据，例如故事、讯息、文件、信息圈网站、录音或视频。你理解这组数据的大意，并且能迅速定位与搜索内容最相关的页面或章节。如果数据以你不懂的语言书写或传达，或你试图从无权访问的计算机中获取信息（例如一台你不知道密码的计算机），法术失败。

如果你将施放此法术作为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{研究}活动的一部分，你将大失败改为视作失败。
items.expectedDescription:
You touch one object and concentrate on a dataset contained within it, such as a story, message, file, infosphere site, audio recording, or video. You understand the gist of the dataset and can quickly locate the most relevant pages or sections to your search. If the dataset is written or otherwise communicated in a language you don't know, or you attempt to gain information from a computer you don't have access to (such as one with a password you don't know), the spell fails.

If you Cast this Spell as part of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.t5nBkpjroaq7QBGK]{Research} activity, you treat a critical failure as a failure instead.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 快速移动
items.description:
你的速度获得+30尺状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{法术效果：快速移动}
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a +30-foot status bonus to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{Spell Effect: Fleet Step}

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 修复术
items.description:
你修复目标物品。每有一环法术环阶，便为目标恢复5生命值；如果修复后超过物品的破损阈值，可能移除@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{破损}状态。你无法补回遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环）你能以负载不超过1的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环）你能以负载不超过2的非魔法物体，或负载不超过1的魔法物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

items.name: 念动之手
items.description:
你创造一只悬浮的魔法手掌，它可以隐形或呈幽灵状，抓住目标物体，使其缓缓向任意方向浮动至多20尺。维持法术时，你能将物体再移动20尺。如果法术结束时物体仍在空中，它便会坠落。

升阶（3环）你能以一件无人持有且负载不超过1的物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程提高至60尺，且你能以一件无人持有、负载不超过1的物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程提高至60尺，且你能以一件无人持有、负载不超过2的物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

items.name: 念动射弹
items.description:
你将射程内一件未固定、无人持有且负载不超过1的物体掷向目标。对目标进行法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害，取决于所掷物体。被掷物品的任何特殊特征或魔法属性，都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功你造成双倍伤害。

成功你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 音爆手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

轰鸣手枪形似带扳机的扩音器，能发出突如其来的强烈声响，足以震碎防弹玻璃或震破内脏。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

A boom pistol resembles a megaphone with a trigger, emitting sudden bursts of sound capable of shattering bulletproof glass or rupturing organs.

items.name: 聚合手套
items.description:
强化： 1

这只手套配有数十种用于制造或修理计算机和其他科技物品的精巧工具，需要用整只手或合适的附肢操作。将多用手套的组件超频后，会在持用者的指尖之间产生电压。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This glove features dozens of delicate tools for building or repairing computers and other technological items, requiring an entire hand (or suitable appendage) to manipulate. Overclocking the polyglove's components generates voltage between a wielder's fingertips.

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 网络恶名
items.description:
喷子拥有声名狼藉的网络喷人身份，使它们在自己的小圈子里成为名人。计算机熟练度达到专家或更高，且知道喷子网络身份名称的生物，在有关该喷子的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}检定中获得+2环境加值，但对抗喷子的法术和你气不气？效应时，豁免受到–1环境减值。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.UAk8nekzRLoGeEmW]

Griefcasters have notorious online gobbing personas that make them celebrities within their own niche. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.UAk8nekzRLoGeEmW]

items.name: 史诗黑客
items.description:

效果喷子将骇入手段编织进魔法，造成灾难性后果。喷子选择目标穿戴或持握的一件物品，使其陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}状态。
items.expectedDescription:

items.name: 你气不气？
items.description:
喷子大声狂笑，用晦涩的信息圈知识嘲讽30尺内的一个生物。目标必须进行@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。

大成功该生物毫无反应，伤害了喷子的自尊。喷子陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}状态，持续1分钟，或直到它使用一个互动动作在信息圈发帖宣泄怒火。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败该生物处于呆滞1状态，持续1轮。

大失败该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}状态，持续1轮。
items.expectedDescription:
The griefcaster cackles and taunts a creature within 30 feet with obscure infosphere lore. The target must make a @Check[will|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The creature's lack of reaction hurts the griefcaster's pride. The griefcaster becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute, or until they use an Interact action to post their ire to the infosphere.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

items.name: 恐惧术
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须进行意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}状态。

失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态。

大失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态1轮。

升阶（3环）你能以至多五个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

items.name: 召唤元素
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入危害所在区域

效果该危害在触发星舰上召唤一个特定的6级生物，其种类在创建危害时决定。然后，该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the hazard's zone

Effect The hazard summons a specific 6th-level creature on board the triggering starship, determined when the hazard is created. The hazard then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A planar breach oozes energy and spawns monsters.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一道位面裂口渗出能量，孳生怪物。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:24] (expert; generator) to disrupt the rift with an electromagnetic pulse, or @Check[nature|dc:22] (expert; magic conduit) or Occultism (expert; magic conduit) to seal the breach, or Counter Magic (magic conduit; 3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the breach
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:24]（专家；发电机）以电磁脉冲扰乱裂隙；或@Check[nature|dc:22]（专家；魔法导管）或神秘（专家；魔法导管），以封闭裂口；或反制魔法（魔法导管；3环；反制DC 24）以反制裂口

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) Energy flows through the planar breach to fuel the elemental. The elemental immediately takes its turn, using 3 actions, and can use reactions unlike most summoned creatures.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）能量流经位面裂口，为元素生物供能。元素生物立即进行自己的回合，使用3个动作，并且与大多数召唤生物不同，可以使用反应。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard resets in 10 minutes unless the planar breach is sealed permanently by counteracting it.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 除非通过反制永久封闭位面裂口，否则危害在10分钟后重置。

guvzUoQGY5N8upTm.name: 安保奥术科技特工 Security Arcanotech Agent
guvzUoQGY5N8upTm.publicNotes:
最稀有且最多才多艺的私人安保警卫类别是奥术科技特工。

安保人员

空间站内的每家企业、教会和高档社区都有自己的安保力量。

items.name: 短讯术
items.description: 你向该生物发送不超过25词的心灵信息，它可以立即用自己编写的一段不超过25词的信息回复。
items.expectedDescription: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.

items.name: 念动移物
items.description: 你将目标移动至多20尺，可以使其悬在空中。维持法术时，你能再次如此移动目标，或将念动力转向射程内另一个符合条件的目标，改为移动它。
items.expectedDescription: You move the target up to 20 feet, potentially suspending it in midair. When you Sustain the Spell, you can do so again, or you can shift your telekinetic focus to a different eligible target within range, moving it instead.

items.name: 计算机交谈
items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你可以向居住在电脑中的精魂提问，并从他们那里得到答案。这些合成灵魂会在计算机代码中显现，通常会因设备的性质、状态、应用和个性化设置而具有不同的个性。计算机的视角、感官和知识使它的世界观与人类的世界观大相径庭，以至于它认为某些细节并不重要。计算机能回答的大多数问题都与过去曾与它们互动的生物有关，还有它们的文件中隐藏的信息。

升阶（6环）持续时间8小时。

items.name: 次元移位
items.description:
你将自己以及穿戴和持握的物品，立即从当前空间传送至射程内一个能看见的未占据空间。如果这会带着另一个生物同行，即使该生物被装在异次元容器中，法术也会失效。

升阶（5环）射程提高至1里。你不必看见目的地，只要曾经到过那里，并知道其与你的相对位置和距离。之后，你暂时免疫1小时。
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

items.name: 断电术
items.description:
你引发一道突如其来的电火花，涌入一个科技生物或物体。你耗尽一件具有科技特征物品的能量，或扰乱一个具有科技特征的生物，具体效应取决于目标是生物还是物体。

  • 生物如果目标是具有科技特征的生物，它进行意志豁免。失败时，该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}状态；大失败时，该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障2}状态。
  • 物体如果你以有人持有的物体为目标，持有该物体的生物进行意志豁免。成功时，物体失去其最大充能的一半。失败时，或你以无人持有的物体为目标时，物体失去其所有剩余充能。
items.expectedDescription:
You ignite a sudden spark of electricity that surges into a technological creature or object. You de-energize an item with the tech trait or disrupt a creature with the tech trait, with effects based on the target being a creature or object.

  • Creature If your target is a creature with the tech trait, it attempts a Will save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1}; on a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2}.
  • Object If you target an attended object, the creature with the object attempts a Will save. On a success, the object loses half of its maximum charges. On a failure, or if you target an unattended object, the object loses all its remaining charges.

items.name: 麻痹术
items.description:
你在目标的运动指令离开心智之前将其阻断，可能使目标僵在原地。目标必须进行意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}状态。

失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}状态，持续1轮。

大失败目标麻痹4轮。在自己每回合结束时，它可以再次尝试意志豁免，成功时将剩余持续时间缩短1轮，大成功时则完全结束。

升阶（7环）你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: 念动战技
items.description: 你以一股猛烈的念动力，移动一个敌人或其携带的物品。你能以法术攻击检定代替运动检定，尝试对目标进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{摔绊}。
items.expectedDescription: With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

items.name: 警报术
items.description:
你为一片区域设防，使生物未经许可进入时向你报警。施放警报术时，选择一个口令。每当小型或更大的实体生物进入法术区域，却未说出口令时，警报术便按你的选择发送心灵警讯（此时法术获得心灵特征），或发出声音和音量如同手铃的警报（此时法术获得听觉特征）。两种方式都会自动唤醒你，铃声还允许区域内每个生物尝试@Check[perception|dc:15]检定醒来。知道警报存在的生物，进入区域时必须成功通过对抗法术DC的隐秘检定，否则触发法术。

升阶（3环）你能指定哪些类型的生物会触发警报术。
items.expectedDescription:
You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast alarm, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the mental trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the auditory trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a @Check[perception|dc:15] check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a Stealth check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.

Heightened (3rd) You can specify a trigger for which types of creatures sound the alarm spell.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 柔落术
items.description:
触发射程内一个生物正在坠落

你唤起魔法上升气流，减缓坠落。目标的坠落速度降为每轮60尺，且法术持续时间内坠落的那段距离，不计入坠落伤害计算。如果目标在法术生效期间落地，则不受坠落伤害。目标一旦落地，法术便结束。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger a creature within range is falling

You raise a magical updraft to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

items.name: 传讯术
items.description:
你轻轻动嘴低语，言语却不从嘴中传出，而直接送入目标耳中。其他人不会比你平常动嘴低语时听得更清楚，但目标听起来如同站在你身旁。目标可以用反应简短回复，也可以选择在其下一回合用自由动作回复，但必须能看见你且位于射程内。回复会直接送入你的耳中，如同最初的信息。

升阶（3环）法术射程提高至500尺。
items.expectedDescription:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

items.name: 念动之手
items.description:
你创造一只悬浮的魔法手掌，它可以隐形或呈幽灵状，抓住目标物体，使其缓缓向任意方向浮动至多20尺。维持法术时，你能将物体再移动20尺。如果法术结束时物体仍在空中，它便会坠落。

升阶（3环）你能以一件无人持有且负载不超过1的物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程提高至60尺，且你能以一件无人持有、负载不超过1的物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程提高至60尺，且你能以一件无人持有、负载不超过2的物体为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

items.name: 电击警棍
items.description:
强化： 1

这种伸缩警棍深受安保人员欢迎，每次打击都会放电。握把内的旋转装置产生电压，充满电时会发出宛如一群昆虫嗡鸣的声音。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Popular among security forces, this retractable baton discharges electricity with each Strike. A whirring device inside the grip generates voltage, creating a sound like a swarm of buzzing insects when it's fully charged.

items.name: 零度炮
items.description:
强化： 1

这门三管炮的发生器快速运转，循环输送冷却剂，形成吸热能量爆发。供能时，武器的炮管与枪托会结霜，因此经验丰富的持用者都会佩戴保温手套。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This triple-barreled cannon's generator churns rapidly, circulating coolant into a blast of endothermic energy. While powered, frost rimes the barrel and stock of this weapon, causing experienced wielders to wear thermal gloves.

items.name: 薄板甲
items.description:
强化： 1

这套光滑但坚硬的板甲常用半透明材料制成，展示穿戴者的真皮回路，通常穿在宽松衣物之下。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This sleek but rigid plate armor is often constructed from translucent materials to show off a wearer's dermal circuitry and worn under baggy clothing.

extraFields.text: 商用型过滤式循环呼吸器

extraFields.expected: This armor upgrade supplements your armor's environmental protections and filters out common contaminants, including protection from most toxic atmospheres.
extraFields.text: 此护甲强化模块提升了护甲的环境防护和过滤常见有害物质的能力，包括对多数有毒大气层的防护。

extraFields.expected: This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.
extraFields.text: 此面罩覆盖你的视觉器官，强化你的天生感官。你获得黑暗视觉。

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 奥术科技数据平板
items.expectedDescription: The agent can cast spells only so long as their datapad is intact, not glitching, and on the agent's person.
items.description: 特工只有在数据板完好，未处于故障状态且在身上时才能施放法术。

items.name: 奥术充能打击
items.description:
需求该特工的上一个动作是施放法术，或自其上一回合结束以来，曾对抗一个魔法效应进行豁免

效果特工将周围的魔法能量吸入一次打击中。特工进行的下一次攻击检定获得+2环境加值。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The agent's last action was to Cast a Spell or they attempted a saving throw against a magical effect since the end of their last turn

Effect The agent siphons ambient magical energy into a strike. The next attack roll the agent makes gains a +2 circumstance bonus.

items.name: 白盔协议
items.expectedDescription: The glitching values of all items worn or held by the agent are reduced by 1.
items.description: 特工穿戴或持握的所有物品的故障值减少1。

items.name: 黑暗术
items.description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，使光线无法穿透，也无法在区域内发出。光线不能进入该区域，且区域内任何非魔法光源，例如火把或提灯，都不会发光，即使其光照半径本能延伸至黑暗区域之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗术环阶相等或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法通过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，这是一颗纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环）即使具有黑暗视觉（但不是高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。
items.expectedDescription:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

items.expectedName: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
items.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值

nppecukdT37pGuMA.name: 安保狙击手 Security Sharpshooter
nppecukdT37pGuMA.publicNotes:
一名手术般精准、目光警觉的狙击手可以在客户意识到危险之前就进行干预。

安保人员

空间站内的每家企业、教会和高档社区都有自己的安保力量。

items.name: 短刀
items.description:
强化： 1

刀兼具武器和工具价值，有各种形状和样式，材料则从星金到陶瓷不一而足。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from starmetals to ceramics.

items.name: 激光步枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这些可靠的量产步枪从方形枪管射出集中的能量束。协约世界（Pact Worlds）的通用标准型号便于大幅改装，可搭配多种配件与强化模块使用；持用者能依自己的偏好调整激光步枪，甚至混装零件，将其改得几乎面目全非。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.

items.name: 埃斯特克斯服装
items.description:
强化： 1

这件厚重的飞行服，在多层战术织物之间缝入薄聚碳板以加强防护。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This bulky flight suit is reinforced with thin polycarbon panels sewn between layers of tactical fabric.

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 变色龙合金
items.description:
触发狙击手受到伤害

效果狙击手隐形，持续至其下一回合开始，并行走。狙击手在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Chameleon Alloy]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用变色龙合金。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The sharpshooter takes damage

Effect The sharpshooter becomes invisible until the start of their next turn and Strides. The sharpshooter can't use Chameleon Alloy again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Chameleon Alloy]]{1d4 rounds}.

items.name: 部署无人机
items.description:
需求狙击手没有已启动的无人机，且其数据板完好、未陷入故障状态，并由其随身携带

效果狙击手打印一架硬光无人机，并将其抛向30尺内一个能看见的位置。无人机是具有构装体、无心智、机器人和科技特征的小型生物。它有@Damage[15[healing]]生命值，并使用狙击手的AC和豁免调整值。它悬停在原地，除非接受狙击手指示，否则不能移动或行动。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The sharpshooter doesn't have an active drone and their datapad is intact, isn't glitching, and is on their person

Effect The sharpshooter prints and throws a hardlight drone to a point they can see within 30 feet. The drone is a Small creature with the construct, mindless, robot, and tech traits. It has @Damage[15[healing]] Hit Points and shares the sharpshooter's AC and saving throw modifiers. It hovers in place and can't move or act except as directed by the sharpshooter.

items.name: 散布气体
items.description:
需求狙击手的无人机位于60尺内

效果无人机向@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]喷洒气体。区域内的生物必须进行@Check[fortitude|dc:22]豁免。狙击手在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dispersal Gas]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用散布气体。

大成功该生物在接下来24小时内免疫此效应。

成功该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}状态。

失败该生物处于恶心1状态，并在恶心期间处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态。

大失败如同失败，但该生物改为处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}状态。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The sharpshooter's drone is within 60 feet

Effect The drone sprays gas in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save. The sharpshooter can't use Dispersal Gas again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dispersal Gas]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature is sickened 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for as long as it's sickened.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} instead.

items.name: 移动无人机
items.expectedDescription: The drone flies 30 feet.
items.description: （操作） 无人机飞行30尺。

items.name: 诡计射击
items.description:
需求无人机位于狙击手的视线内，且位于狙击手周围60尺内

效果狙击手借无人机反射激光步枪的射击，使光束散开，对所有生物造成@Damage[3d8[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为以无人机为起点的@Template[type:line|distance:30]（@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The drone is within the sharpshooter's line of sight and within 60 feet of the sharpshooter

Effect The sharpshooter reflects a laser rifle shot from the drone to scatter the shot, dealing @Damage[3d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:line|distance:30] from the drone (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

ocANFgNSYPmoROSM.name: 败蚁蚁后 Terminite Queen

items.name: 支配术
items.description:
你掌控目标，强迫其服从命令。如果下达明显会自毁的命令，目标便不行动，直到你下达新命令。效应取决于其意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标因抵抗你的命令而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}状态。

失败你控制目标。目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{被控制}状态，但可以在自己每回合结束时进行意志豁免。成功时，法术结束。

大失败如同失败，但目标只有在你下达违背其天性的新命令时，才获得新的豁免，例如杀死其盟友。

升阶（10环）持续时间无限。
items.expectedDescription:
You take command of the target, forcing it to obey your orders. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order. The effect depends on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as it fights off your commands.

Failure You control the target. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature, such as killing its allies.

Heightened (10th) The duration is unlimited.

items.name: 切割现实
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。

items.name: 传送术
items.description:
你及目标立即传送至射程内任意地点，但必须能根据该地点相对于起点的位置，以及其外观（或其他识别特征），精确辨认该地点。关于地点外观的错误信息通常会使法术失败，但也可能导致传送至不想去的地点，或发生GM决定的其他异常事故。传送术在长距离时并不精确。目标出现的位置与预定目的地相距约总行程的1%，方向由GM决定。短途旅行中，这种误差无关紧要；但长途旅行中，误差可能达到1里。

升阶（7环）你及其他目标能前往1000里内的任何地点。

升阶（8环）你及其他目标能前往同一行星上的任何地点。如果行程超过1000里，抵达时只会偏离目标10里。

升阶（9环）你及其他目标能前往同一恒星系中另一颗行星上的任何地点。假定你准确知道地点的位置与外观，抵达新行星时会偏离目标100里。

升阶（10环）如同9环版本，但你及其他目标能前往同一星系内的任何行星。
items.expectedDescription:
You and the targets are instantly transported to any location within range, as long as you can identify the location precisely both by its position relative to your starting position and by its appearance (or other identifying features). Incorrect knowledge of the location's appearance usually causes the spell to fail, but it could instead lead to teleporting to an unwanted location or some other unusual mishap determined by the GM. Teleport is not precise over great distances. The targets appear at a distance from the intended destination equal to roughly 1 percent of the total distance traveled, in a direction determined by the GM. For short journeys, this lack of precision is irrelevant, but for long distances this could be up to 1 mile.

Heightened (7th) You and the other targets can travel to any location within 1,000 miles.

Heightened (8th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on the same planet. If you travel more than 1,000 miles, you arrive only 10 miles off target.

Heightened (9th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on another planet within the same solar system. Assuming you have accurate knowledge of the location's position and appearance, you arrive on the new planet 100 miles off target.

Heightened (10th) As the 9th-rank version, but you and the other targets can travel to any planet within the same galaxy.

items.name: 幻象场景
items.description:
你创造一个虚构场景，包含至多10个大小各异、彼此独立的生物或物体，全部都必须位于法术区域内。这些元素会产生适当的声音和气味，触感也十分真实。幻象场景中的元素无法说话。与你使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{幻象生物}法术时不同，场景中的生物没有战斗能力或数据。场景不会改变周围环境，但你可以将场景放置在其他幻术法术创造的虚幻环境中。

创造场景时，你可以选择让其保持静态，或按照预设程序变化。静态场景虽然不移动，却包含基本的自然动作，例如风吹过一张幻象纸时，纸会沙沙作响。程序至多持续1分钟，结束后重复。例如，你可以创造两个兽人互相打斗的场景，每次重复时，战斗都会以相同方式进行。如果创造循环，两名战士在场景开始和结束时都会位于相同位置；但你可以使程序衔接顺畅，让人难以察觉循环何时结束、何时开始。任何观察场景超过几分钟的人，几乎总会注意到它在循环。创造幻象后，你无法改变程序。

任何触碰影像任一部分，或以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{搜索}动作检查它的生物，都可以尝试识破幻象。如果生物只与幻象的一部分互动，便只会识破该部分。只有大成功时，才能识破整个场景。

升阶（6环）场景中的生物或物体可以说话。创造程序时，你必须说出每个角色的具体台词。法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

升阶（8环）如同6环版本，且持续时间无限。
items.expectedDescription:
You craft an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of other illusion spells.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

items.name: 念动移物
items.description: 你将目标移动至多20尺，可以使其悬在空中。维持法术时，你能再次如此移动目标，或将念动力转向射程内另一个符合条件的目标，改为移动它。
items.expectedDescription: You move the target up to 20 feet, potentially suspending it in midair. When you Sustain the Spell, you can do so again, or you can shift your telekinetic focus to a different eligible target within range, moving it instead.

items.name: 极潮绝望
items.description:
你使区域内的生物陷入绝望。每个生物受到的效应取决于其意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功1轮内，该生物不能使用反应，并且必须在自己回合开始时再次进行豁免；失败时，它因无法控制的啜泣，在该回合内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态。

失败如同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大失败如同失败，且该生物自动陷入缓慢1，持续1分钟。

升阶（7环）区域扩大至60尺锥形。
items.expectedDescription:
You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

items.name: 修订记忆
items.description:
你改变目标的记忆，可以抹除一段记忆、使一段记忆更加清晰、修改一段记忆，或添加一段虚假记忆。目标可以进行意志豁免抵抗法术。

大成功目标不受影响，并意识到你尝试改变其记忆。

成功目标不受影响，却认为你的法术是无害的其他法术，而非修订记忆，除非它辨识出该法术。

失败在法术持续时间的最初5分钟内，你可以通过维持该法术，每轮修改一次记忆。每次如此做时，你想象出至多6秒的记忆并加以修改，最多可修改连续5分钟的记忆。

只要法术仍在生效，你修改过的记忆就会保持改变后的样子。如果目标在5分钟结束前移出射程，你就无法继续修改记忆。

升阶（6环）你可以对一个自愿目标施放该法术，压制其关于某个特定主题的全部记忆；该主题须以不超过50个词描述。此效果永久持续，并用一片模糊的迷雾填补被抹去的记忆。
items.expectedDescription:
You alter the target's memories by erasing a memory, enhancing a memory's clarity, altering a memory, or adding a false memory. The target can attempt a Will save to resist the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to alter its memory.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of rewrite memory, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure During the first 5 minutes of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to modify a memory once each round. When you do, you imagine up to 6 seconds of memory to modify, to a maximum of 5 continuous minutes of memory.

Any memories you've altered remain changed as long as the spell is active. If the target moves out of range before the 5 minutes is up, you can't alter any further memories.

Heightened (6th) You can Cast the Spell on a willing target to suppress all memory of a particular topic, detailed in 50 words or fewer. The effect is permanent, and it patches these omissions with an indistinct haze.

items.name: 注目术
items.description:
你的话语使目标迷魂。在整个施法过程和持续时间内，你不间断地说话或歌唱。注意到你的话语或歌声的目标可能会全神贯注地聆听；每个目标都必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果目标与你的宗教、族裔或政治立场对立，或由于其他原因不太可能赞同你的话，GM可以给予其环境加值，至多为+4。

当你维持该法术时，每个进入射程的生物都必须尝试豁免。如果你在说话，注目术获得语言特征。

大成功目标不受影响，并注意到你试图使用魔法。

成功目标不必专心聆听，但也没有注意到你试图使用魔法（它可能会注意到其他生物受到注目术影响）。

失败目标对你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}。如果它目睹自己不赞同的行为或话语，就可以再次尝试意志豁免。若成功，它不再迷魂，并暂时免疫此效果1小时。如果目标遭到敌对行为，或另一个生物对它进行的交涉或威吓检定成功，迷魂便立即结束。

大失败如同失败，但目标不能因不赞同你而尝试豁免以结束迷魂。
items.expectedDescription:
Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一束熵射线，迅速且无差别地分解物质。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；如果目标具有科技特征，则改为受到2d6持续强酸伤害，并陷入故障1。重击时，伤害翻倍；如果该生物具有科技特征，还会陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶 （+1）增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 关照术
items.description:
只要你和目标处于同一位面且都还活着，你就会持续知晓它当前的状况。你知晓目标相对你的方向、与你的距离，以及影响它的任何状态。

升阶（4环）该法术的射程增至30尺，且你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
As long as you and the target are on the same plane of existence and both alive, you remain aware of its present state. You know the target's direction from you, distance from you, and any conditions affecting it.

Heightened (4th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: 念动战技
items.description: 你以一股猛烈的念动力，移动一个敌人或其携带的物品。你能以法术攻击检定代替运动检定，尝试对目标进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{摔绊}。
items.expectedDescription: With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

items.name: 命令术
items.description:
你高声发出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你、逃跑（如同处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态）、放开所持物品、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或站在原地。在服从你的命令之前，它不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{延迟}，也不能使用任何反应。具体效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败该生物必须在其下一回合，以第一个动作花费一个单动作服从你的命令。

大失败目标必须用其下一回合的全部动作服从你的命令。

升阶（5环）你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: 晕眩术
items.description:
你侵入目标的心智，以精神冲击使其晕眩。这道冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，目标进行基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+2）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

items.name: 虚构幻术
items.description:
你创造出一道简单的幻音或幻象。幻音使法术获得听觉特征，且不能包含可理解的言辞或复杂的音乐。幻象使法术获得视觉特征，大小不能超过边长5尺的立方体；在15尺内观察时，其粗糙而缺乏细节的构造十分明显。当你施放或维持该法术时，可以尝试利用幻术@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}，此次欺骗检定获得+2环境加值。如果对某个生物的尝试失败，该生物便会识破虚构幻术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚构幻术}
items.expectedDescription:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

items.name: 讯息传递
items.description: 你将心智与目标的心智连接，瞬间向其传递通常需要10分钟才能交流完的信息。
items.expectedDescription: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

items.name: 念动射弹
items.description:
你将射程内一件未固定、无人持有且负载不超过1的物体掷向目标。对目标进行法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害，取决于所掷物体。被掷物品的任何特殊特征或魔法属性，都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功你造成双倍伤害。

成功你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 皇家税收
items.description:
触发败蚁蚁后将要受到重击造成的伤害，或将要降至0生命值

频率每天一次

效果败蚁蚁后号召忠诚的臣民做出最终牺牲。蚁后选择30尺内的一只败蚁，由它代为承受伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The terminite queen would take damage from a critical hit or be reduced to 0 Hit Points

Frequency once per day

Effect The terminite queen calls upon a loyal subject to make the ultimate sacrifice. A terminite within 30 feet chosen by the queen takes the damage instead.

items.name: 蚁后的牺牲
items.description:
败蚁蚁后牺牲自己的血肉来滋养蚁群。败蚁蚁后死亡，30尺内的所有败蚁获得快速治疗15并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，均持续1分钟。它们只能用额外动作进行攻击。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.97keYapBgpIlaoNI]
items.expectedDescription:
The terminite queen sacrifices her flesh to nourish the colony. The terminite queen dies and all terminites within 30 feet gain fast healing 15 and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute. They can use the extra action only to attack.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.bestiary-effects.Item.97keYapBgpIlaoNI]

items.name: 次元移位（随意）
items.description:
你将自己以及穿戴和持握的物品，立即从当前空间传送至射程内一个能看见的未占据空间。如果这会带着另一个生物同行，即使该生物被装在异次元容器中，法术也会失效。

升阶（5环）射程提高至1里。你不必看见目的地，只要曾经到过那里，并知道其与你的相对位置和距离。之后，你暂时免疫1小时。
items.expectedDescription:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

ocANFgNSYPmoROSM.publicNotes:
败蚁蚁后像操纵木偶一样控制自己的蚁群和大多数其他“低等”生物。繁殖时，蚁后会牺牲自身的一部分，克隆出蚁群的其他成员。下属败蚁收集的微粒则反过来滋养蚁后。受到威胁时，蚁后会从微粒中吸收异能能量，将其塑造成幻象场景，以及能撕裂现实的能量冲击。

蚁后所到之处，必有蚁群随行。

侵扰生物

入侵生物困扰着艾巴萨罗姆空间站，就算投入最专注的清剿行动，也难以将其消灭。无论是藏身于幽灵层，还是偷渡上星舰，这些顽强的侵扰生物始终是这座庞大而多元的空间站面临的问题。

p2FidtuGWhxZoLQM.name: 太空地精恶棍 Space Goblin Miscreant
p2FidtuGWhxZoLQM.publicNotes:
年轻或不明智的太空地精令人沮丧地容易被说服参与盗窃或暴力。这些小家伙在事情出错时逃跑的速度与投入战斗的速度一样快，他们困扰着任何愚蠢到敢在艾巴萨罗姆空间站粗野街区旅行的外来者。

太空地精

地精在艾巴萨罗姆空间站各处都相当常见。它们喜爱狭窄、阴暗的地方，因此空间站的小巷和管道对它们格外有吸引力。许多地精乐于与其他居民共同生活，成为商人、工匠和漫画家（越来越多的地精出版社正在出版无字而富有个性的“地精漫画”），但其他地精则往往会惹是生非。其中一些狡猾的捣蛋鬼在艾巴萨罗姆空间站各处造成停电、火灾，乃至更严重的问题。

items.name: 屠狗刀
items.description:
强化： 1

地精珍视被称为砍狗刀和斩马刀的祖传近战武器，尽管大多数人并不理解原因。地精武器容易制造，却容易损坏。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Goblins cherish ancestral melee weapons called dogslicers and horsechoppers, but most people don't understand why. Goblin weapons are easy to make but prone to breakage.

items.name: 地精疾走
items.description:
触发一名地精盟友在与该恶徒相邻的位置结束一个移动动作

效果恶棍快步。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A goblin ally ends a move action adjacent to the miscreant

Effect The miscreant Steps.

items.name: 定制“大爆响”手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

轰鸣手枪形似带扳机的扩音器，能发出突如其来的强烈声响，足以震碎防弹玻璃或震破内脏。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

A boom pistol resembles a megaphone with a trigger, emitting sudden bursts of sound capable of shattering bulletproof glass or rupturing organs.

items.name: 自由动作
items.description: 叉车以前方的货叉承载货物，能运载至多1000负载。
items.expectedDescription: A forklift carries its cargo on its front forks and can carry up to 1,000 Bulk.

items.name: 升降
items.description: 驾驶员将叉车的货叉升至至多15尺高，或将货叉降至地面。
items.expectedDescription: The pilot raises the forklift's forks up to 15 feet in the air, or lowers the forklift's forks down to the ground.

sFTw0auUZJKhGz3F.name: 败蚁工蚁 Terminite Worker

items.name: 消化现实
items.description:
频率每轮一次

效果败蚁撬下一块周围环境并将其吸收。败蚁恢复@Damage[1d6[healing]]生命值，其占据的方格对所有非败蚁生物变为困难地形。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Effect The terminite pries loose a piece of the environment and absorbs it. The terminite regains @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points, and the square it occupies becomes difficult terrain to all non-terminites.

items.name: 现实隧穿
items.description:
频率每小时一次

效果败蚁可以花费1分钟在现实中挖掘一条通往或离开其异次元巢穴的隧道。非败蚁生物将这条“隧道”看作一颗闪烁着色彩、占据10尺球形空间的光球。球内的生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，球外的所有生物对球内生物也处于隐蔽状态。败蚁可以穿过光球进入巢穴；对其他生物而言，光球是困难地形，却不通往任何地方。隧道在1分钟后关闭。解除魔法能自动摧毁现实隧道，也能通过互动动作操纵隧道并成功通过@Check[occultism|dc:16]检定将其摧毁。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The terminite can spend 1 minute to dig a tunnel in reality to or from its extradimensional nest. Non-terminites see this "tunnel" as a shimmering sphere of color that occupies a 10-foot sphere. Creatures in the sphere are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the sphere are concealed from creatures within it. Terminites can pass through the sphere to the nest; for other creatures, the sphere is difficult terrain but doesn't lead anywhere. The tunnel closes after 1 minute. A reality tunnel can be destroyed by dispel magic automatically or by manipulating it with an Interact action and a successful @Check[occultism|dc:16] check.

sFTw0auUZJKhGz3F.publicNotes:
在艾巴萨罗姆的城市探险者之间流传的都市传说和恐怖故事里，几乎没有哪个能像“虚空虫”那样无处不在。具体的外形描述众说纷纭，甚至连摄影机拍到的画面都彼此矛盾，但所有故事都提到从不可能存在的空间中探出的细长附肢、机器上仿佛被完美切割后消失的部件，以及沿着视野外的走廊如怪异瘦长波浪般涌动的多足暗影。一些幽灵信使特意对这些被他们称作“败蚁”的生物做了更多了解。

败蚁之所以难以研究，是因为它们的巢穴建在宇宙背后奇异空间的褶皱之中，只能经由幽灵层进入。一些幽灵信使将败蚁比作某种真社会性昆虫；毕竟，这些异常存在就像凡俗建筑里的普通害虫侵扰墙壁一样，侵扰着现实之墙。然而，用自然主义的语言来描述它们，反倒是小看了这些生物。败蚁是受蚁后奴役的映象：那位隐秘的集体意识永久安居在幽灵层中现实背后的巢穴里。只有极少数探险者曾进入这片巢穴现实，且至今无人生还，仅留下支离破碎的录音或旅行日志。蚁后在巢穴中似乎无所不在；在其中，她的后代呈现出无穷无尽的梦魇般特化形态。幸运的是，至少就目前而言，蚁后似乎还满足于等待时机。

最常见到的败蚁是工蚁，它们是蚁后意志的碎片，充当斥候与回收者的角色。败蚁工蚁专注于分解物体，通常是那些带有晦涩异能共振的物体，并将其带回巢穴，供蚁后用于难以揣测的目的。

侵扰生物

入侵生物困扰着艾巴萨罗姆空间站，就算投入最专注的清剿行动，也难以将其消灭。无论是藏身于幽灵层，还是偷渡上星舰，这些顽强的侵扰生物始终是这座庞大而多元的空间站面临的问题。

items.name: 便携
items.description: 一个中型生物可以利用能量摩托的车轮沿地面拖行它。该生物处于超载状态。
items.expectedDescription: The enercycle can be pulled along the ground on its wheel by a Medium creature. The creature is encumbered.

items.name: 火焰吐息
items.description: 戴莫力图斯之龙嘴中内置的巨型火焰炮点燃，对生物和物体造成@Damage[12d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:40]或@Template[type:line|distance:80]（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic]豁免）。除驾驶员外，船员或乘客也能使用此能力。火焰吐息需要[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}冷却后才能再次使用。
items.expectedDescription: The massive flame cannon built into the dragon of Damoritosh's mouth ignites, dealing @Damage[12d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures and objects in a @Template[type:cone|distance:40] or an @Template[type:line|distance:80] (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save). This ability can be used by crew or passengers, in addition to the pilot. Fire Breath requires [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} to cool down before it can be used again.

items.name: 双武器架
items.description: 戴莫力图斯之龙具有两个武器架，龙的每只手上各一个；每个武器架均能以两个互动动作安装或移除任意远程武器。龙的任何船员或乘客都能使用以此方式安装的武器进行打击。以这种方式安装且需要电池的武器能直接从飞船引擎供能，因此开火时不消耗任何充能。
items.expectedDescription: A dragon of Damoritosh has two weapon mounts, one in each of the dragon's hands, which can each have any ranged weapon installed or removed with two Interact actions. Any of the dragon's crew or passengers can make Strikes with weapons installed this way. Weapons installed this way that require batteries don't consume any charges when fired, as they can draw power directly from the ship's engine.

items.name: 可怖外观
items.description:
戴莫力图斯之龙威慑性的设计得到魔法强化，模拟出真正巨龙的恐怖威仪。@Template[type:emanation|distance:60]内除船员和乘客外的生物必须进行@Check[will|dc:32]豁免。除驾驶员外，船员或乘客也能使用此能力。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}状态。

失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态。

大失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧4}状态。
items.expectedDescription:
The dragon of Damoritosh's intimidating design is magically enhanced to simulate the terrifying presence of an actual dragon. Creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60], except the crew and passengers, must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32] save. This ability can be used by crew or passengers, in addition to the pilot.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

tziikrgm9Cwe6POs.name: 戴莫力图斯之龙 Dragon of Damoritosh

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A dragon of Damoritosh resembles a huge dragon formed from interlocking metal plates with enormous, magically enhanced wings, making it a terrifying sight to behold. The incredibly detailed dragon's head, which doubles as a flamethrower, was designed by talented artists to appear lifelike. The dragon has become a favorite vehicle for crowd suppression and intimidation campaigns—for those who can afford one.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 戴莫力图斯之龙形似一头由相扣金属板构成的巨龙，配有魔法强化的巨大双翼，令人望而生畏。其精细无比的龙头兼作火焰喷射器，由才华横溢的艺术家设计，栩栩如生。对负担得起的人而言，这种龙已成为镇压人群和恐吓行动的热门载具。

xZf2UldYXXvVZe3p.name: 帮派头目 Ganglord
xZf2UldYXXvVZe3p.publicNotes:
只有最无情的人才能爬上顶端成为帮派头目。

帮派分子

犯罪行会、犯罪家族、收取保护费的团伙和高利贷者，只是艾巴萨罗姆空间站众多帮派类型中的一小部分。帮派有强烈的地域性，惯于掠夺他人，且极其重视地盘。成员因不同原因加入，但大多数人都发现，一旦入帮，就很难轻易脱身。

帮派分子总有自己的生财之道，也就是用来赚钱的犯罪生意，但大多数帮派也惯常收取保护费。在帮派地盘内做生意的人——更糟的是，生意位于多个帮派地盘的交界处——通常都得定期交钱，否则就可能面临严重后果。

items.name: 破障枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这把短枪管霰弹枪常被用来轰开门和墙壁。它比反应破门枪更小，却以猛烈的反冲而臭名昭著。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This snub-nosed scattergun is commonly used to blast through doors and walls. Smaller than a reaction breacher, this scattergun is infamous for its mighty recoil.

items.name: 偏斜力场
items.expectedDescription: This shield isn't held—instead, it's installed as an armor or weapon upgrade. A deflecting field appears as a translucent panel integrated into the upgraded item and creates a temporary protective hardlight barrier when activated.
items.description: 这种盾牌并非需要持握——它会作为升级模块被安装在护甲或武器内。偏斜力场看起来如同一个集成到被升级的物品中的半透明面板，并在激活时创造出一个临时的保护性光盾。

items.name: 衬甲外套
items.description:
强化： 1

这件外套以真皮或合成皮革制成，并以装甲板加固。装甲外套通常会按穿戴者的个人风格量身定制。标准款式则作为制服的一部分配发给军官。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This overcoat is made of real or synthetic leather and reinforced with armored plates. Armored coats are often tailor-made to match the wearer's personal style. Standard versions are issued to military officers as part of their uniforms.

items.name: 以威慑众
items.expectedDescription: 100 feet. Each allied gang member in the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Will DC and on Will saves against fear effects, unless those effects come from the ganglord.
items.description: （灵光，情绪）100尺。灵光内每个友方帮派成员在对抗恐惧效应的意志DC和意志豁免上获得+2环境加值，除非这些效应来自帮派头目。

items.name: 举起盾牌
items.description:
需求你持用一面盾牌。

你摆好盾牌保护自己。举盾后，你获得盾牌所列的AC环境加值。盾牌会保持举起，直到你的下一回合开始。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You are wielding a shield.
