You position your shield to protect yourself. When you have Raised a Shield, you gain its listed circumstance bonus to AC. Your shield remains raised until the start of your next turn.

items.name: 加入火拼
items.description:
频率每轮一次，

效果帮派头目举盾并行走。帮派头目周围20尺内的帮派成员可以使用一个反应进行行走。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round,

Effect The ganglord Raises a Shield and Strides. Gang members within 20 feet of the ganglord can use a reaction to Stride.

items.name: 碎膝者
items.description:
频率每轮一次，

效果帮派头目对5尺内的一个生物进行破障枪打击。命中时，目标必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:29]豁免，否则受到@Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]]伤害。受到此持续伤害期间，目标的所有速度受到–10尺状态减值。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round,

Effect The ganglord makes a breaching gun Strike against a creature within 5 feet. On a hit, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:29] save or take @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. The target has a −10-foot status penalty to all Speeds while taking this persistent damage.

items.name: 霰弹外科医生
items.expectedDescription: Creatures within 5 feet of the ganglord are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the ganglord's breaching gun Strikes.
items.description: 位于帮派头目5尺内的生物对该帮派头目的破障枪打击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

items.name: 偷袭
items.expectedDescription: The ganglord's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.
items.description: 帮派头目对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]的生物的打击额外造成2d6精准伤害。

items.name: 艾巴萨罗姆空间站学识

2Dn37i1JTL2bIGms.name: 全地形运输车 All-Terrain Hauler

items.name: 全地形履带
items.description: 全地形运输车忽略非魔法困难地形和非魔法高等困难地形。
items.expectedDescription: An all-terrain hauler ignores non-magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

items.name: 安全货舱
items.description: 全地形运输车的货舱可安全存放至多200负载的货物，除非运输车完全被摧毁，否则货物不会受到伤害。此货舱可重新配置为额外搭载六名乘客。
items.expectedDescription: An all-terrain hauler's cargo compartment can securely hold up to 200 Bulk of cargo, which takes no damage unless the hauler is fully destroyed. This compartment can be reconfigured to carry six additional passengers.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The all-terrain hauler is a bulky treaded transport for when a shipment must be absolutely secure. Arcane enhancements allow the hauler to deploy wards onto its treads to crawl over the surface of mud, snow, or waves.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 全地形运输车是一种庞大的履带运输工具，适用于必须确保货物绝对安全的运输任务。奥术强化使运输车能在履带上展开防护，爬过泥地、雪地或水浪表面。

items.name: 威胁信息
items.description:
触发一个携带通讯器的生物进入作祟区域

效果作祟通过触发的通讯器发出威胁，对通讯器20尺内的生物造成@Damage[(1d6+4)[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:19|basic]豁免）。豁免失败时，该生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature with a comm unit enters the haunt's area

Effect The haunt utters threats through the triggering comm unit, dealing @Damage[(1d6+4)[mental]] damage to creatures within 20 feet of the comm unit (@Check[will|dc:19|basic] save). On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Angry spirits utter haunting threats and condemnations through a nearby comm unit.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 愤怒的精魂通过附近的通讯装置，说出令人毛骨悚然的威胁和谴责。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[religion|dc:15] (trained) to banish the spirits, or @Check[performance|dc:18] to drown out the spirits' voices, or @Check[computers|dc:16] (trained) to disperse the ghostly signal
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[religion|dc:15]（受训）以驱逐精魂，或@Check[performance|dc:18]以盖过精魂的声音，或@Check[computers|dc:16]（受训）以驱散幽灵信号

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: 1 hour

items.name: 小调和弦
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入危害所在区域

效果星环发出强烈的不和谐振动。处于危害所在区域的所有星舰，以及星舰上的生物，都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:25]豁免。随后，危害掷先攻。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

失败该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧4}。

大失败该生物陷入惊惧4并受到@Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]]伤害，直到有人解除危害，或该生物距离危害至少20个区域。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the hazard's zone

Effect The rings emit powerful dissonant vibrations. All starships and creatures on board starships in the hazard's zone must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

Critical Failure The creature is frightened 4 and takes @Damage[1d10[persistent,mental]] damage until someone disables the hazard or until the creature is at least 20 zones away from the hazard.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Glimmering rings of compressed ice and dust encircling a nearby planet emit a dreadful sound.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 附近行星周围环绕的闪亮星环由压缩的冰与尘埃组成，发出可怕的声音。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected:
@Check[arcana|dc:30] (expert; magic conduit), Nature (expert; magic conduit) or Occultism (expert; magic conduit) to magically silence the wailing, @Check[Music Lore|dc:26] (expert; generator, scanners) or Performance (expert; generator, scanners) to harmonize with the wailing; one success negates the hazard's effects for that round (see Routine below)

Special The hazard can be temporarily disabled but not permanently disabled.
cnText_system_details_disable.text:
@Check[arcana|dc:30]（专家；魔法导管）、自然（专家；魔法导管）或神秘（专家；魔法导管），以魔法压下哀号；或@Check[Music Lore|dc:26]（专家；发电机、扫描仪）或表演（专家；发电机、扫描仪），与哀号协调共鸣；一次成功可抵消危害在该轮的效果，见下方“流程”

特殊该危害可以被暂时解除，但无法永久解除。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The hazard wails as one action, dealing @Damage[(2d10+9)[mental]] damage to all creatures in its zone (@Check[will|dc:23|basic] save).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）危害用一个动作哀号，对其所在区域内所有生物造成@Damage[(2d10+9)[mental]]伤害，目标进行@Check[will|dc:23|basic]豁免。

2yrGP4fNXEC5ARHU.name: 吞噬者纪念碑 Monument to the Devourer

items.name: 囚魂涌动
items.description:
触发一个活物移动至纪念碑15尺内

效果所有被这座纪念碑杀死之人的灵魂向外涌出，对纪念碑60尺内的所有活物造成@Damage[(4d10+22)[void]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic]豁免）。被此作祟杀死的生物，其灵魂会被困在纪念碑中，直到纪念碑被摧毁。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A living creature moves within 15 feet of the monument

Effect The souls of all those killed by this monument surge outward, dealing @Damage[(4d10+22)[void]] damage to all living creatures within 60 feet of the monument (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save). Creatures killed by this haunt have their soul trapped in the monument until the monument is destroyed.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: This shrine has long served as an altar for sacrificial rites and foul magic. When non-believers approach the monument, the souls of all those killed here surge out to reap their lives.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这座神龛长久以来一直是举行献祭仪式和施展邪恶魔法的祭坛。非信徒靠近纪念碑时，所有在此被杀者的灵魂都会涌出，收割来者的生命。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[deception|dc:33] (master) to pose as a believer and command the monument to still, or @Check[religion|dc:30] (expert) to pray to the gods for protection, or @Check[occultism|dc:30] (expert) to soothe the trapped spirits; two successes are required to disable it
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[deception|dc:33]（大师）以假扮信徒，命令纪念碑平息；或@Check[religion|dc:30]（专家）以向众神祈求庇护；或@Check[occultism|dc:30]（专家）以安抚受困的精魂；解除需要两次成功

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: 1 hour

items.name: 失败！
items.description:
触发一艘星舰的船员在3轮后仍未解答凶兆提问中的问题，或一艘星舰摧毁了探测器

效果探测器爆炸，将碎片射向触发的星舰。如果该星舰在5个区域内，它受到@Damage[(6d10+31)[piercing]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship's crew fails to solve the problem from Ominous Request after 3 rounds, or a starship destroys the probe

Effect The probe explodes, sending its shards toward the triggering starship. The starship, if within 5 zones, takes @Damage[(6d10+31)[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] save).

items.name: 凶兆提问
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移动至陷阱5个区域内

效果陷阱与触发的星舰建立通讯，并提出一个逻辑问题。星舰船员须在3轮内正确解答，否则陷阱使用“失败！”。如果通过拆除探测器或解出方程来解除陷阱，陷阱便停止运作，并自行拆解，不造成危害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves within 5 zones of the trap

Effect The trap opens comms with the triggering starship and presents a logic problem. The starship's crew has 3 rounds to correctly solve the problem, or the trap uses Failure! If the trap is disabled by disarming the probe or solving the equation, the trap deactivates and disassembles harmlessly.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A mysterious probe appears with a simple but deadly task: solve its equation or be destroyed.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个神秘探测器出现，布置了一项简单却致命的任务：解开它的方程，否则就被摧毁。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:35], Crafting, or Thievery (expert) to disarm the probe, or @Check[arcana|dc:37] or any Science Lore (expert) to solve the equation
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:35]、工艺或贼活（专家）以解除探测器；或@Check[arcana|dc:37]或任意科学学识（专家）以解开方程

items.name: 买！买！买！
items.description:
触发一个生物直接或用工具接触围栏

效果陷阱对触发生物造成@Damage[1d10[electricity]]伤害。如果陷阱尚未掷先攻，它便掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature touches the fence directly or with a tool

Effect The trap deals @Damage[1d10[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature. The trap rolls initiative if it hasn't already.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A 15-foot-tall electrified fence electrocutes anyone who touches it.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一道15尺高的通电围栏会电击所有触碰者。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained) to ground a 10-foot portion of the fence, or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to cut power to the fence
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训）以将10尺长的一段围栏接地；或@Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）以切断围栏电源

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The trap electrocutes each creature touching the fence directly or with a tool, dealing @Damage[1d10[electricity]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）陷阱电击直接或用工具触碰围栏的每个生物，造成@Damage[1d10[electricity]]伤害，目标进行@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic]豁免。

items.name: 有害突变
items.description:
触发一个生物在迷雾中开始回合

效果迷雾涌动着能量，使其中所有生物的身体发生有害突变，造成@Damage[(6d10+27)[bludgeoning]]伤害。区域中的生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:32]豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害，并抵抗住突变。

失败该生物受到全额伤害。它的皮肤长满恶臭水疱，持续1小时。只要此突变仍在，它便处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}状态，且无法降低恶心状态值。

大失败该生物受到双倍伤害。它的四肢痛苦地扭曲，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4小时}。只要此突变仍在，它便处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}状态，且无法降低恶心状态值。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature begins its turn in the fog

Effect The fog surges with energy, dealing @Damage[(6d10+27)[bludgeoning]] damage to all creatures in the fog as it harmfully mutates their bodies. Creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage. It resists mutation.

Failure The creature takes full damage. Its flesh becomes coated in foul-smelling blisters for 1 hour. For as long as it has this mutation, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and can't reduce the value of its sickened condition.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage. Its limbs become painfully twisted for [[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours}. For as long as it has this mutation, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and can't reduce the value of its sickened condition.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A fog of transmutative fumes fills a 30-foot radius area, painfully mutating creatures who enter.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 具有变化作用的烟雾充满半径30尺的区域，使进入者痛苦地变异。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:35] (master) to neutralize the fog, or @Check[survival|dc:35] (master) to disperse the fog
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:35]（大师）以中和雾气；或@Check[survival|dc:35]（大师）以驱散雾气

5TGgljErrluk0gTb.name: 星界巨兽遗骸 Extinct Astral Behemoth

items.name: 腐烂咕鸣
items.description:
触发一艘星舰在危害所在区域结束移动，或在该区域采取动作

效果尸骸对触发的星舰进行一次腐蚀液滴打击。若此攻击对星舰的船体点造成伤害，分解中的黏液便覆盖该星舰，使所有星舰相对于它都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，直到船员花费1小时清洁船体，或该星舰获得1点护盾点。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship ends its movement or takes an action in the hazard's zone

Effect The carcass makes a caustic droplets Strike against the triggering starship. A starship that takes damage to its Hull Points from this attack is covered in decomposing slime that causes all starships to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to it until the crew spends 1 hour cleaning the hull or until it gains 1 Shield Point.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The hulking carcass of a primal beast floats in frozen chunks suspended in a spray of its brightly pigmented blood. The hazard is a Large starship object.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一头原始巨兽的庞大尸骸冻成碎块，悬浮在自身喷洒出的鲜艳血液中。该危害是一件大型星舰物体。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:28] (expert; gunnery) to release death gases and blood safely, or @Check[piloting|dc:26] (trained; pilot's console) to evade the hazard's secretions
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:28]（专家；炮术）以安全释放尸气与血液；或@Check[piloting|dc:26]（受训；驾驶控制台）以躲避危害的分泌物

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard resets over the course of the round and is ready to trigger again 1 round later.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 危害在该轮内重置，1轮后可以再次触发。

items.name: 汲取记忆
items.description:
触发一个非无心生物接近至记忆水晶5尺内

效果记忆水晶向其所占空间相邻的每个方格蔓延。生长时，它们吸收周围的记忆和游离思绪，对扩张后10尺内的生物造成@Damage[8d10[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:42|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A non-mindless creature comes within 5 feet of the memory crystals

Effect The memory crystals expand into every square adjacent to their space. As they grow, they absorb memories and ambient thought from their surroundings, dealing @Damage[8d10[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:42|basic] save) to creatures within 10 feet after they expand.

items.name: 记忆场域
items.description:
灵光5尺

记忆水晶对附近生物造成@Damage[8d10[mental]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Aura 5ft

Memory crystals deal @Damage[8d10[mental]] damage to nearby creatures.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Glowing yellow crystals refract the blurred imprints of stolen memories within their facets.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 发光的黄色水晶在切面间折射出被盗记忆的模糊印痕。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:48] (legendary) to erect mental wards, or @Check[occultism|dc:48] (legendary) to harmlessly feed surface thoughts to the crystals, or @Check[religion|dc:51] (legendary) to pray for protection from the crystals
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:48]（传奇）以建立心灵防护；或@Check[occultism|dc:48]（传奇）以无害的表层思绪喂养水晶；或@Check[religion|dc:51]（传奇）以祈求庇护，免遭水晶影响

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: After expanding, the memory crystals can't grow again for 1 day.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 扩张后，记忆水晶在1日内无法再次生长。

items.name: 宇宙之雨
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入危害所在区域，或在该区域结束回合

效果流星砸向触发星舰的船体，造成@Damage[1d10[cold]]伤害和@Damage[1d10[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the hazard's zone or ends its turn in the hazard's zone

Effect Meteors pelt the triggering starship's hull, dealing @Damage[1d10[cold]] damage and @Damage[1d10[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Superheated chunks of debris move at high velocity through the area. Starships in the hazard's zone are concealed from all starships outside the hazard's zone.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 过热的碎片高速穿过区域。危害所在区域内的星舰，对区域外的所有星舰都具有隐蔽。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:20] (trained) to calculate meteor trajectories, @Check[nature|dc:20] (trained) to anticipate meteor patterns, or @Check[piloting|dc:18] (trained) to evade the meteors
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:20]（受训）以计算流星轨迹；@Check[nature|dc:20]（受训）以预判流星规律；或@Check[piloting|dc:18]（受训）以躲避流星

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard resets immediately.

items.name: 激光网
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至传感器5尺内

效果激光发射，每道激光各对走廊中的一个生物进行打击。如果生物多于激光，激光优先指定触发的生物；如果生物少于激光，激光优先对触发的生物进行多次打击。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of a sensor

Effect The lasers fire, each one Striking a creature in the hallway. If there are more creatures than lasers, the lasers prioritize the triggering creature or creatures; if there are fewer creatures than lasers, the lasers prioritize Striking the triggering creature or creatures multiple times.

items.name: 激光
items.description: 不应用多重攻击减值
items.expectedDescription: No multiple attack penalty

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Six sensors concealed in a 15-foot-long corridor fire lasers when they detect movement.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一条15尺长的走廊中藏有六个传感器，侦测到移动时便发射激光。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:15] (trained) or Thievery (trained) to disable each sensor, or @Check[acrobatics|dc:23] (expert) to slip past each sensor
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:15]（受训）或贼活（受训）以解除各个传感器；或@Check[acrobatics|dc:23]（专家）以悄然绕过各个传感器

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets after 15 minutes.

6LRpqcEAkKdstSr8.name: 失控机械臂 Haywire Robotic Arm

items.name: 制造
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至机械臂触及范围内

效果陷阱对触发生物进行一次机械臂打击，随后攫抓（运动+17）。因陷阱而处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}状态的生物受到@Damage[1d6[persistent,bludgeoning]]伤害，直到它@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}（DC 27），或陷阱停止运作或被摧毁。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within reach of the robotic arm

Effect The trap makes an arm Strike against the triggering creature, then Grabs (+17 Athletics). A creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the trap takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bludgeoning]] damage until they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (DC 27) or the trap is deactivated or destroyed.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A robotic manufacturing arm malfunctions, attacking nearby creatures.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一条工业机械臂发生故障，攻击附近的生物。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:20] (trained) to debug the malfunctioning arm, or @Check[crafting|dc:25] (trained) to cause the arm's joints to seize, or @Check[thievery|dc:23] (trained) to disable the arm
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:20]（受训）以排除机械臂故障；或@Check[crafting|dc:25]（受训）以卡住机械臂关节；或@Check[thievery|dc:23]（受训）以解除机械臂

items.name: 骇客的痴迷
items.description:
触发一个生物直接或用工具接触控制台

效果作祟以色彩斑斓的图像和有趣的数据吸引使用者的注意，同时削弱其心智防御。触发生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:22]豁免。随后，陷阱掷先攻。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败该生物陷入呆滞1。

大失败该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}。此外，它对计算机处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}状态，除了被动观看计算机上的数据外，不能采取任何动作。在自己的每个回合结束时，它可以重试此豁免，以移除迷魂状态。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature touches the console directly or with a tool

Effect The haunt distracts the user with colorful graphics and interesting data while lowering their mental defenses. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is stupefied 1.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}. Additionally, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with the computer and can't take any actions except to passively view the data on the computer. At the end of each of their turns, they can retry this saving throw to remove the fascinated condition.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A ghostly hacker haunts their computer and attempts to drain the spirit of anyone who accessed the computer.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一名幽灵骇客萦绕在自己的计算机中，试图吸取所有访问该计算机者的精魂。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:16] (trained) to partition the haunted code, or @Check[religion|dc:18] (trained) or Occultism (trained) to exorcise the spirit
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:16]（受训）以隔离闹鬼代码；或@Check[religion|dc:18]（受训）或神秘（受训）以驱除精魂

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The haunt absorbs the spirits of the living, dealing @Damage[(1d10+4)[spirit]] damage to all living creatures within 10 feet of the computer (@Check[will|dc:18|basic] save). On a critical failure, a creature is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. This routine doesn't count as a hostile action for the purposes of ending the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} condition.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）作祟吸收活物的精魂，对计算机10尺内所有活物造成@Damage[(1d10+4)[spirit]]伤害，目标进行@Check[will|dc:18|basic]豁免。大失败时，生物还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。在判断是否结束@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}状态时，此流程不视为敌对行为。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets after 1 hour.

7MOx2VBvqiKchNMD.name: 附身作战站位 Possessed Battle Stations

items.name: 灵魂入侵
items.description:
触发一个生物开始操控作战站位，或在受影响星舰上使用站位动作

效果灵魂试图排斥触发生物，夺取作战站位的控制权。该生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:30]豁免，依照下列结果结算。随后，作祟掷先攻。

大成功该生物斥退灵魂。该生物尝试解除此作祟的技能检定获得+1状态加值，持续1小时。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败灵魂控制了作战站位，操控站位的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

大失败灵魂控制了作战站位，操控站位的生物从死者视角体验到深空中惨死的记忆，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}。

控制作战站位的灵魂，会持续尝试排斥任何试图操控该站位的生物，直到作祟被解除。只要仍控制着作战站位，作祟便会在执行流程时，优先以最具破坏性的方式操控它控制的站位。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature starts helming a battle station or uses a station action on the affected starship

Effect The spirits attempt to repel the triggering creature and seize control of the battle station. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] save with the following results. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature rebukes the spirit. Skill checks attempted by the creature to disable the haunt gain a +1 status bonus for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The spirit takes control of the battle station, and the helming creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The spirit takes control of the battle station, and the helming creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as it experiences memories of grisly deaths in deep space from the perspectives of the slain.

The spirit controlling a battle station continuously attempts to repel any creature that tries to helm the battle station until the haunt is disabled. As long as it's in control of a battle station, the haunt uses its routine to prioritize helming the battle stations it controls in the most destructive way possible.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The tormented spirits of dead crewmates infest the starship's battle stations and try to force the crew to reenact their catastrophic deaths.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 死去船员饱受折磨的精魂侵占星舰的作战站位，试图强迫船员重演他们惨烈的死亡。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:28] (expert; magic conduit), Nature (expert; magic conduit), Occultism (expert; magic conduit), or Religion (expert; magic conduit) to magically purify the station, or @Check[athletics|dc:28] (expert; gunnery) or Intimidation (expert; gunnery) to overpower the spirit, or @Check[computers|dc:28] (expert; scanners) to ban the spirit from the data matrix, or @Check[computers|dc:28] (expert; drone console) or Crafting (expert; drone console) to force reset the possessed drones, or @Check[computers|dc:34] (expert; magic conduit, scanners) to delete a spirit's soul code, or @Check[crafting|dc:28] (expert; generator) to execute emergency countermeasures, or @Check[piloting|dc:28] (expert; pilot's console) to disorient the spirit with ace maneuvers, or @Check[religion|dc:31] (expert; magic conduit) to exorcise a battle station; a success purges one battle station, and a number of successes equal to the number of battle stations on board the starship are required to disable the haunt
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:28]（专家；魔法导管）、自然（专家；魔法导管）、神秘（专家；魔法导管）或宗教（专家；魔法导管），以魔法净化站位；或@Check[athletics|dc:28]（专家；炮术）或威吓（专家；炮术），以压倒精魂；或@Check[computers|dc:28]（专家；扫描仪）以将精魂逐出数据矩阵；或@Check[computers|dc:28]（专家；无人机控制台）或工艺（专家；无人机控制台），以强制重置被附身的无人机；或@Check[computers|dc:34]（专家；魔法导管、扫描仪）以删除精魂的灵魂代码；或@Check[crafting|dc:28]（专家；发电机）以执行紧急应对措施；或@Check[piloting|dc:28]（专家；驾驶控制台）以高超机动使精魂迷失方向；或@Check[religion|dc:31]（专家；魔法导管）以驱除一个作战站位中的精魂；一次成功净化一个作战站位，解除作祟所需成功次数等于星舰上的作战站位数量

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
(6 actions) The haunt uses its actions to helm any battle stations it controls, prioritizing piloting console station actions to move the starship closer to danger. The haunt always takes harmful or useless actions, such as leaving cover or changing the starship's heading in battle, putting the starship on a collision course, firing on allies, or neglecting the shields.

After 6 rounds, if the haunt hasn't been disabled, all creatures on board the starship experience a reenactment of the spirit crew's annihilation and take @Damage[(2d12+15)[spirit]] damage (@Check[will|dc:30|basic] save). On a critical failure, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. The haunt ends once the reenactment occurs.
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
（6个动作）作祟用其动作操控自己控制的任何作战站位，优先使用驾驶控制台的站位动作，使星舰更接近危险。作祟始终采取有害或无用的动作，例如离开掩蔽、在战斗中改变星舰朝向、驶向碰撞航线、向盟友开火，或忽视护盾。

6轮后，如果作祟尚未被解除，星舰上所有生物都会经历精魂船员覆灭的重演，受到@Damage[(2d12+15)[spirit]]伤害，并进行@Check[will|dc:30|basic]豁免。大失败时，生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。重演发生后，作祟结束。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: Unless exorcised or purged (see above), the spirits return to their battle stations over the course of 24 hours, after which the haunt can trigger again.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 除非被驱除或净化，见上文，否则精魂会在24小时内返回作战站位，之后作祟可以再次触发。

items.name: 开始碾压
items.description:
触发两个或更多生物在房间内结束回合

效果门猛然关闭，将房间封死。随后，陷阱掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger Two or more creatures end their turn in the room

Effect The doors slam shut, sealing the room. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: When activated, the automated trash compactor slowly crushes everything inside it.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 自动垃圾压缩机启动后，会缓缓压碎内部的一切。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:26] (expert) to jam the crushing mechanism, or @Check[thievery|dc:24] (expert) to deactivate the trap; @Check[athletics|dc:28] (trained) to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the door (this doesn't disable the trap)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:26]（专家）以卡住压碎机构；或@Check[thievery|dc:24]（专家）以停用陷阱；@Check[athletics|dc:28]（受训）以对门@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}，这不会解除陷阱

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) Two of the room's walls move 5 feet toward the center of the room, automatically pushing any creatures in those spaces 5 feet closer to the room's center and dealing @Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]] damage to all creatures in the room (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save). Creatures that die from this damage are crushed to a fine paste.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）房间的两面墙向中央移动5尺，自动将这些空间内的所有生物向房间中央推近5尺，并对房内所有生物造成@Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]]伤害，目标进行@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic]豁免。死于此伤害的生物被压成细糊。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

items.name: 激光冲击
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至炮塔30尺内

效果陷阱对该生物进行一次激光打击；陷阱掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the turret

Effect The trap makes a laser Strike against the creature; the trap rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A concealed turret pops up and fires a laser when intruders enter a secure area.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 入侵者进入安保区域时，一座隐藏炮塔会弹出并发射激光。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:18] (trained) to reprogram the turret, or @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained) to cut power to the turret, or @Check[thievery|dc:16] (trained) to disable the turret
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:18]（受训）以重编炮塔；或@Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训）以切断炮塔电源；或@Check[thievery|dc:16]（受训）以解除炮塔

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap makes a laser Strike against up to three creatures in range, or multiple Strikes against one creature in range if it has no additional targets.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱对射程内至多三个生物各进行一次激光打击；如果没有其他目标，则对射程内一个生物进行多次打击。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets after 1 minute.

items.name: 爆炸
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至装置30尺内

效果陷阱发出巨响。下轮结束时，装置爆炸，对其15尺内的所有生物造成@Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]豁免）。此次爆炸摧毁该装置。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the device

Effect The trap makes a loud noise. At the end of the next round, the device explodes, dealing @Damage[(2d6+5)[piercing]] damage to all creatures within 15 feet of the device (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save). This explosion destroys the device.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A generator, engine, or other large immobile device overloads and is moments from catastrophically exploding.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一台发电机、引擎或其他大型固定装置过载，即将发生灾难性爆炸。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:19] (trained) to safely shut down the device, or @Check[thievery|dc:21] (trained) to quickly vent the device
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:19]（受训）以安全关闭装置；或@Check[thievery|dc:21]（受训）以迅速为装置排气

items.name: 冻住！
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至喷嘴下方

效果陷阱向触发生物喷射冷气，造成@Damage[(4d10+26)[cold]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:33]豁免）。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}。

失败该生物受到全额伤害，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。

大失败该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入笨拙2，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}，持续1分钟。触发生物10尺内的生物受到@Damage[(2d12+13)[cold]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves below the nozzles

Effect The trap sprays cold air on the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[(4d10+26)[cold]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:33] save).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}.

Failure The creature takes full damage, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} or [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes clumsy 2, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 minute. Creatures within 10 feet of the triggering creature take @Damage[(2d12+13)[cold]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:29|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Hidden nozzles in the ceiling release hyper-cold air, potentially freezing intruders in place.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 天花板内隐藏的喷嘴释放极寒空气，可能将入侵者冻在原地。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:27] (master) to increase the air's temperature to safe levels, or @Check[thievery|dc:27] (master) to deactivate the nozzles
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:27]（大师）以将空气温度升至安全水平；或@Check[thievery|dc:27]（大师）以停用喷嘴

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets after 1 minute.

items.name: 发射抓钩
items.description: 踏崖车向100尺内的一处垂直表面发射双抓钩，将自身拉向该表面，并展开尖刺附着其上。
items.expectedDescription: The clifftreader fires its dual grappling hooks at a vertical surface within 100 feet and pulls itself to that surface, clinging onto it with its deployable spikes.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Scaling the sides of buildings as easily as it scales cliffsides, the clifftreader races through mountains and cityscapes alike with ease. This unique vehicle looks like a motorcycle whose singular, large wheel loops over the pilot, with deployable spikes to hook into and climb cliff faces. It's also equipped with two grappling hooks to leap across gaps.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 踏崖车攀爬建筑外墙与峭壁同样轻松，能在山地和城市间自在驰骋。这种独特载具形似摩托车，唯一的巨大车轮从驾驶员上方环绕而过，并能展开尖刺，钩住崖面攀爬。它还配备两个抓钩，用于跨越间隙。

items.name: 撞击
items.description:
触发一艘星舰穿过危害所在区域，但其移动既非在该区域开始，也非在该区域结束

效果危害对触发的星舰进行一次碰撞打击。一颗小行星被摧毁。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves through the hazard's zone but doesn't start or end its movement in that zone

Effect The hazard makes a collision Strike against the triggering starship. One asteroid is destroyed.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A sprawling field of floating rocks litters this part of space. The hazard is a Large starship object.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 大片漂浮岩石散布在这片太空中。此危害是一件大型星舰物体。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:21] (trained; scanners) to calculate a safe route, or @Check[piloting|dc:23] (trained; pilot's console) to navigate around the hazard (these checks don't disable the hazard)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:21]（受训；扫描仪）以计算安全路线；或@Check[piloting|dc:23]（受训；驾驶控制台）以绕过危害，这些检定不会解除危害

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The asteroid field resets automatically until at least 10 asteroids have been destroyed, eliminating the hazard.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 小行星带会自动重置，直到至少10颗小行星被摧毁，消除危害。

items.name: 宇宙黏液
items.description: 处于太空时，这团黏液是一个小型星舰物体。
items.expectedDescription: The slime is a Small starship object while in space.

items.name: 黏液群落
items.description: 每当危害受到伤害时，每个被指定的5尺立方黏液至多承受@Damage[6[untyped]]伤害。伤害结算后，其每缺失@Damage[6[healing]]生命值，便失去6点最大生命值，并有一个5尺立方的黏液被摧毁。
items.expectedDescription: Any time the hazard takes damage, it can take a maximum of @Damage[6[untyped]] damage per targeted 5-foot cube of slime. For every @Damage[6[healing]] Hit Points it's missing after the damage is dealt, it loses 6 maximum Hit Points and one 5-foot cube of slime is destroyed.

items.name: 熔穿船壳
items.description:
触发一艘中型或更大的星舰位于距危害0个区域处

效果危害出现在星舰上一间房内，与外墙（船壳）相邻的一个5尺方格中；出现位置随机决定或由GM决定。随后，危害掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A Medium or larger starship is within 0 zones of the hazard

Effect The hazard appears in a 5-foot square adjacent to an exterior (hull) wall inside a room on board the starship (determined randomly or by the GM). The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: 黏液增殖
items.description: 危害以能抓握的卷须缓缓爬行，用酸性黏液覆盖房间的天花板、地面和墙壁。危害将其黏液扩展至三个相邻的5尺立方体内。受影响区域变为困难地形。作战站位因黏液增殖而被黏液覆盖时，便发生故障。危害可以穿过星舰的门、舱壁、船壳和其他设施来进行黏液增殖。
items.expectedDescription: Inching forward on prehensile tendrils, the hazard covers the ceiling, floor, and walls of a room with acidic slime. The hazard expands its slime to three adjacent 5-foot cubes. The affected area becomes difficult terrain. Battle stations become malfunctioning when they're covered in slime due to Proliferate Slime. The hazard can Proliferate Slime through doors, bulkheads, hulls, and other features of a starship.

items.name: 喷吐腐蚀蒸气
items.description: 危害10尺内的所有生物受到@Damage[2d8[acid]]伤害，进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:19|basic]豁免。此外，豁免失败的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}，大失败时则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。
items.expectedDescription: All creatures within 10 feet of the hazard takes @Damage[2d8[acid]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:19|basic] save. Additionally, a creature that fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on critical failure).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: An unwelcome infestation pollutes the decks with sticky slime that proliferates throughout a starship.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 令人厌恶的侵染以黏稠黏液污染甲板，在整艘星舰内蔓延。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:18] (trained) or Survival (trained) to denature the hazard with chemicals (destroys a @Template[type:cone|distance:5] of slime on a success, or @Template[type:cone|distance:10] on a critical success), or @Check[religion|dc:25] (expert; magic conduit) to purify the starship; two successes are required to disable the hazard, or destroy every infested square
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:18]（受训）或生存（受训）以化学药剂使危害变性，成功时摧毁@Template[type:cone|distance:5]黏液，大成功时摧毁@Template[type:cone|distance:10]；或@Check[religion|dc:25]（专家；魔法导管）以净化星舰，需要两次成功才能解除危害；也可以摧毁每个被侵染的方格

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) The hazard uses Proliferate Slime each round, spreading to as many rooms as possible until the starship interior is covered or the hazard is destroyed. The hazard then uses Spew Corrosive Vapor.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （2个动作）危害每轮使用黏液增殖，尽可能蔓延到更多房间，直到覆盖整艘星舰内部或被摧毁。危害随后使用喷吐腐蚀蒸气。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The slime returns and begins proliferating again in 24 hours unless the entire starship is completely cleansed, or the starship is restored to full Hull Points.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 除非整艘星舰被彻底清洁，或船体点恢复至满值，否则黏液会在24小时后返回并再次增殖。

items.name: 你看到了吗？
items.description:
触发危害位于星舰的传感器范围内，且该星舰使用由扫描仪授予的站位动作

效果扫描仪探测到一团形如行星、蠕动不休的触手。触发星舰上的所有生物受到@Damage[(3d12+18)[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:38|basic]豁免）。豁免失败时，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}；大失败时，它还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship uses a station action granted by its scanners while the hazard is within the starship's sensor range

Effect The scanners pick up a wriggling mass of tentacles shaped like a planet. All creatures on board the triggering starship take @Damage[(3d12+18)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:38|basic] save). On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}; on a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: This planet looks like a wriggling mass of tentacles.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这颗行星看起来像一团蠕动的触手。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:36] (master; magic conduit), @Check[nature|dc:36] (master; magic conduit), @Check[occultism|dc:36] (master; magic conduit), or @Check[religion|dc:36] (master; magic conduit) to ward against the hazard
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:36]（大师；魔法导管）、@Check[nature|dc:36]（大师；魔法导管）、@Check[occultism|dc:36]（大师；魔法导管）或@Check[religion|dc:36]（大师；魔法导管），以抵御危害

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard resets immediately, but it can't affect the same starship again for the next 24 hours. Disabling the hazard protects the starship that disabled it from being affected by it again, but doing so doesn't permanently destroy the planetoid.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 危害立即重置，但在接下来的24小时内无法再次影响同一艘星舰。解除危害可保护解除它的星舰，避免再次受其影响，但不会永久摧毁这颗小行星。

items.name: 钻孔钻头
items.description: 螺旋行者造成的碰撞伤害忽略物体的前5点硬度。如果螺旋行者的碰撞伤害，将一个物体或其中一部分降至0生命值，且被摧毁的部分足够大，可供螺旋行者穿过，则螺旋行者、驾驶员和乘客均不受伤害。
items.expectedDescription: Collision damage from a spiralrunner ignores the first 5 points of an object's Hardness. If an object or section of an object large enough for the spiralrunner to drive through is reduced to 0 Hit Points by a spiralrunner's collision damage, the spiralrunner and its pilot and passengers take no damage.

items.name: 掘隧
items.description: 螺旋行者使用掘地速度时，沿路留下宽10尺、高5尺的隧道。
items.expectedDescription: When a spiralrunner uses its burrow Speed, it leaves a tunnel 10 feet wide and 5 feet high in its path.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The spiralrunner speeds both on the roads and below them. Equipped with a massive burrowing drill and an array of smaller drills on its bumper, this sturdy rally car can dive into the earth, boring new paths to race down in its wake.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 螺旋行者能在道路及其下方疾驰。这辆坚固的拉力赛车配有巨大的掘地钻头，保险杠上还排列着一组小钻头，可以钻入地下，沿途开辟新的赛道。

items.name: 灵活机动
items.description: 配备足额熟练桨手的划桨式陆行独木舟，可以快速转向、原地转向或倒划。每次在短于载具自身长度的距离内转向90度，都额外消耗5尺移动距离。倒划速度至多为游泳速度的一半，且倒划时不能转向。
items.expectedDescription: With a full complement of skilled rowers, a rowed landcutter canoe can turn swiftly, turn in place, and row backward. Each 90-degree turn made in less than a vehicle length costs 5 extra feet of movement. It can row backward no faster than half its swim Speed, and it can't turn while rowing backward.

items.name: 水陆转移
items.description: 陆行独木舟切换移动模式，撑起船桨在陆地上行走，或沉入水中，以划桨方式穿越波浪。
items.expectedDescription: The landcutter switches between travel modes, rising onto its paddles to walk on land or sinking into the water to be rowed across the waves.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Landcutter canoes are often used on mountainous worlds with difficult portages and were first developed on Vesk Prime. This vessel has lightweight metallic paddles that are reinforced so they can be slotted into ball joints attached to the hull, allowing it to rise from the water and walk on the blades of the paddles.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 陆行独木舟最初在维斯克主星开发，常用于山地众多、陆上搬运困难的世界。它配有轻质金属桨，经强化后可以插入船壳上的球形关节，使船离开水面，以桨叶步行。

items.name: 乘风而行
items.description:
需求滑翔摩托身处空中

效果滑翔摩托展开机翼，使其能使用飞行速度，直到下次接触地面。滑翔摩托必须先以乘风而行启动飞行速度，才能使用该速度。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The glidecycle is in the air

Effect The glidecycle's wings pop open, allowing it to use its fly Speed until it next touches the ground. A glidecycle can't use its fly Speed without first activating it with Ride the Current.

items.name: 跃升启动
items.description: 你使用单动作版本的驾驶，随后滑翔摩托的引擎将其向上推进，跃至20尺高的空中。
items.expectedDescription: You use the 1-action version of Drive, then the glidecycle's engine propels it upward, launching it 20 feet into the air.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The glidecycle originated with offroad racers trying to incorporate canyons and gorges into their tracks. With the press of a button, the motorcycle pops out ultralight wings from its sides and dives through the air.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 滑翔摩托源自越野赛车手将峡谷和沟壑纳入赛道的尝试。按下按钮，摩托车两侧就会弹出超轻机翼，凌空滑翔。

items.name: 再配置
items.description: 掠云艇调整推进器。它获得35尺游泳速度，但失去飞行速度，或反向切换。
items.expectedDescription: The cloudskipper adjusts its thrusters. It gains a swim Speed of 35 feet but loses its fly Speed, or vice versa.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Shaped like a slender bullet with a sharp nose, a cloudskipper is a one-person pod with short wings and adjustable thrusters. By adjusting the angle of the wings and thrusters, the cloudskipper can transition between skipping along the water and racing through the skies.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 掠云艇是一种单人舱，形似尖头的细长子弹，配有短翼和可调推进器。调整机翼与推进器角度，就能在掠水与空中疾驰之间切换。

items.name: 站位乱序！
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入陷阱所在的区域

效果在另一个现实中，熟悉的船员担任着不同职务。星舰上所有操控作战站位的生物都必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:28]豁免。每个失败的生物都被随机传送至另一个作战站位；若所有站位均有人操控，则传送至一个与其他站位相邻的空间。在接下来1小时内，受影响的生物可以花费1个具有专注特征的动作获取其他时间线中的知识，但只能如此做一次。它选择下列一项技能：@Check[arcana|dc:28]、@Check[computers|dc:28]、@Check[crafting|dc:28]、@Check[occultism|dc:28]、@Check[nature|dc:28]、@Check[piloting|dc:28]或@Check[religion|dc:28]。在1分钟内，于被传送到的站位使用站位动作时，该生物可以用所选技能代替所需的任何其他技能。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the same zone as the trap

Effect In another reality, familiar crew members have different roles. All creatures helming a battle station on board the starship must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:28] save. Each creature that fails is teleported at random to another battle station or a space adjacent to a different battle station if all of them are helmed. Once within the next hour, an affected creature can spend 1 action that has the concentrate trait to access knowledge from other timelines, allowing it to choose one of the following skills: @Check[arcana|dc:28], @Check[computers|dc:28], @Check[crafting|dc:28], @Check[occultism|dc:28], @Check[nature|dc:28], @Check[piloting|dc:28], or @Check[religion|dc:28]. For 1 minute, the creature can use that skill in place of any different required skill when taking a station action at the station they were teleported to.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Another timeline collides with the present.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 另一条时间线与当前现实相撞。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:28] (expert; magic conduit) or Occultism (expert; magic conduit) to realign reality, or Counter Magic (magic conduit; 4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the trap
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:28]（专家；魔法导管）或神秘（专家；魔法导管），以重新校准现实；或反制魔法（魔法导管；4环；反制DC 24），以反制陷阱

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets automatically after 1 minute.

items.name: 释放孢子
items.description:
触发一个生物接触或伤害真菌

效果真菌在@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内释放致幻孢子。区域内的所有生物都必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:21]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}1轮，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}10分钟；大失败时则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creatures touches or damages the fungus

Effect The fungus releases psychotropic spores in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. All creatures in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 10 minutes (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A colorful fungus releases psychotropic spores when a creature comes near.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一株色彩鲜艳的真菌在生物靠近时释放影响精神的孢子。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:20] (trained) to force the fungus into a dormant state, or @Check[survival|dc:22] (trained) to safely remove the fungus
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:20]（受训）以迫使真菌休眠；或@Check[survival|dc:22]（受训）以安全移除真菌

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: Dormant fungus reactivates in 1 hour; destroyed fungus regrows over the course of 2 weeks.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 休眠真菌在1小时后重新活跃；被摧毁的真菌会在2周内重新生长。

items.name: 再配置
items.description: 船式摩托转动车轮。它获得40尺速度，但失去游泳速度，或反向切换。
items.expectedDescription: The boatercycle rotates its wheels. It gains a Speed of 40 feet but loses its swim Speed, or vice versa.

items.name: 脚踏动力
items.description: 电池耗尽时，可以通过一个1分钟活动，将船式摩托配置为使用脚踏动力，以作应急。此时它按牵引式载具运作。
items.expectedDescription: As an emergency measure if its battery runs dry, a boatercycle can be configured to use pedal power as a 1-minute activity. This functions as a pulled vehicle.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: With an aerodynamic shape and bidirectional wheels that swivel into twin propjets, a boatercycle's purpose is obvious. It can seamlessly transition between road and sea, allowing an adventurous pilot to traverse the glimmering beaches of resort worlds however they please.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 船式摩托采用流线造型，双向车轮可旋转成一对喷泵，其用途一望即知。它能在公路与海洋之间无缝切换，让爱冒险的驾驶员随心驰骋于度假世界闪耀的海滩。

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The wealthiest citizens of the Pact Worlds just can't help but show off their wealth, and luxurious yachts are designed to do just that. More a mobile marine resort than a vehicle, they contain everything needed to entertain the passengers for months at a time, including theaters, swimming pools, top-of-the-line holoprojectors, lavish sleeping quarters, and even a landing pad for small aircraft. Despite their size, these ships are meant to operate with almost no crew, to allow for the utmost privacy of the owner and their guests.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 协约世界最富有的公民总忍不住炫耀财富，豪华游艇正为此而设计。比起载具，它们更像移动的海上度假胜地，配有让乘客数月娱乐不休的一切设施，包括剧院、泳池、顶级全息投影仪、奢华卧室，甚至还有小型飞行器停机坪。尽管体型庞大，这些船仍被设计成几乎无需船员便可运作，为主人和宾客提供最大限度的隐私。

items.name: 锁定目标
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移动至危害6个区域内

效果危害向该星舰发射四枚追踪导弹。导弹最初位于距触发星舰6个区域处。随后，陷阱掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves within 6 zones of the hazard

Effect The hazard launches four seeking missiles at it. The missiles begin 6 zones away from the triggering starship. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Stray munitions from an ancient battle hurtle across space and time, seeking targets they were never intended for.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一场古老战役遗留的流弹穿越时空，寻找原本不属于它们的目标。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) Each missile moves 2 zones toward the triggering starship. When a missile reaches the starship's zone, it explodes, dealing @Damage[3d10[fire],3d10[piercing]] damage to the starship (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] save). Each missile pursues the triggering starship until it explodes or is disabled or destroyed.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）每枚导弹向触发星舰移动2个区域。导弹抵达星舰所在区域时爆炸，对星舰造成@Damage[3d10[fire],3d10[piercing]]伤害，并进行@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic]豁免。每枚导弹都会追逐触发星舰，直到爆炸、被解除或被摧毁。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard resets after 1 day.

items.name: 时光震颤
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至裂隙10尺内

效果触发生物的身体急速衰老，受到6d10+20伤害。它必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:33]豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}。

失败该生物受到全额伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭2}。

大失败该生物受到双倍伤害，陷入笨拙2和力竭2，并陷入缓慢状态1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the rift

Effect The triggering creature takes 6d10+20 damage as its body rapidly ages. It must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The creature takes full damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes clumsy 2 and enfeebled 2, and becomes slowed for 1 minute.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A rift in time rapidly ages and slows anyone who draws near.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一道时间裂隙使所有靠近者迅速衰老、行动迟缓。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:36] (master) or Occultism (master) to magically mend time, @Check[thievery|dc:40] (master) to repair the time rift, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 31) to counteract the rift
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:36]（大师）或神秘（大师）以魔法修补时间；@Check[thievery|dc:40]（大师）以修复时间裂隙；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（7环；反制DC 31）以反制裂隙

items.name: 电震
items.description:
触发一个生物直接或用工具抓握控制台

效果陷阱对触发生物及其5尺内的生物造成@Damage[5d8[electricity]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature grasps the console directly or with a tool

Effect The trap deals @Damage[5d8[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature and creatures within 5 feet of the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A shock grid built into a computer console or door panel releases a powerful electric charge.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 计算机控制台或门控面板内置的电击网释放强大电荷。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:16] (trained) to disable the console's programming, or @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained) to rewire the shock grid, or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to deactivate the shock grid
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:16]（受训）以停用控制台程序；或@Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训）以重新连接电击网线路；或@Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）以停用电击网

items.name: 撕裂现实
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至休眠裂口30尺内

效果现实中裂开一道缺口，在地面上挖出一个半径5尺的洞。陷阱掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the dormant tear

Effect A tear opens in reality, gouging a 5-foot radius hole in the earth. The trap rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A tear in reality emits a chaotic churn of energy into the air like a geyser, raining destruction down on an area.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 现实裂口如间歇泉般向空中喷出翻涌的混乱能量，向区域倾泻毁灭。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:27] (expert) to diffuse the magical energy, or @Check[nature|dc:25] (expert) to seal the tear, or @Check[survival|dc:30] (trained) to coax the earth back together
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:27]（专家）以疏散魔法能量；或@Check[nature|dc:25]（专家）以封闭裂口；或@Check[survival|dc:30]（受训）以引导大地重新合拢

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) A chaotic churn of energy blasts out of the tear, dealing @Damage[(2d10+5)[acid]] damage to all creatures in a 30-foot-tall cylinder centered on the tear (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save). Creatures damaged by this energy are additionally pushed 10 feet into the air (20 feet on a critical failure). This dispersed energy then rains down, dealing @Damage[1d10[fire]] damage to all creatures within 60 feet of the tear (@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （2个动作）翻涌的混乱能量从裂口喷出，对以裂口为中心、高30尺的柱形内所有生物造成@Damage[(2d10+5)[acid]]伤害，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免。被此能量伤害的生物还被向空中推高10尺，大失败时为20尺。散开的能量随后如雨落下，对裂口60尺内所有生物造成@Damage[1d10[fire]]伤害，目标进行@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic]豁免。

JWUqNZIcNNReYwqQ.name: 现实裂口 Rip in Reality

items.name: 虚空之拥
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入陷阱所在区域

效果陷阱试图将触发星舰上的所有生物拉入现实裂口。星舰上的每个生物都必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:33]豁免。随后，陷阱掷先攻。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物奋力爬出裂口。它陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

失败该生物被拉入裂口。它陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

大失败该生物被拉入裂口。它陷入惊惧2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，且直到陷阱被解除前都无法逃出裂口。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the trap's zone

Effect The trap attempts to pull all creatures on board the triggering starship into the reality breach. Each creature on the starship must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] save. The trap then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature claws out from the breach. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is pulled into the breach. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled into the breach. The creature is frightened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, and it can't escape from the breach until the trap is disabled.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Gnashing, toothy mouths and spiny tentacles grope and writhe inside a pit that just appeared out of nowhere.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个凭空出现的深坑中，长满牙齿的嘴不停咬合，棘刺触手摸索扭动。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[occultism|dc:38] (master) or @Check[religion|dc:38] (master) to seal the pit (two successes are required to disable the trap), or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 37) or planar seal or planar tether (7th rank; counteract DC 33) to counteract the trap
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[occultism|dc:38]（大师）或@Check[religion|dc:38]（大师）以封闭深坑，解除陷阱需要两次成功；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（7环；反制DC 37），或位面封锁、位面系留（7环；反制DC 33），以反制陷阱

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) As an action, the trap manifests mind-rending visions of eldritch creatures from another reality. Each creature inside the reality breach takes @Damage[(3d10+16)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:35|basic] save). A creature can attempt an Arcana or Occultism check in place of their saving throw, if desired.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）陷阱用一个动作呈现来自另一现实的诡异生物幻象，撕裂心智。现实裂口内的每个生物受到@Damage[(3d10+16)[mental]]伤害，并进行@Check[will|dc:35|basic]豁免。如果愿意，生物可以用奥秘或神秘检定代替豁免。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets after 1 hour.

items.name: 神性崇拜
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移动至危害10个区域内

效果神性恒星迫使渺小的生物崇拜自己。10个区域内的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:47]豁免。失败时，生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}，并须花费所有动作，将此危害奉为神明加以崇拜，直到危害的下个回合开始；期间无法使用反应。虔诚信奉其他神明的生物，在此豁免上获得+1状态加值。随后，危害掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves within 10 zones of the hazard

Effect The deific star compels lesser creatures to worship it. Creatures within 10 zones must attempt a @Check[will|dc:47] save. On a failure, creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} and must spend all their actions worshipping the hazard as a god until the beginning of the hazard's next turn and can't use reactions during this time. Creatures with strong faith in another god gain a +1 status bonus to their save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: 指挥神使
items.description: 危害在10个区域内的一艘星舰上召唤一个特定的18级或更低等级生物。该生物在危害被创建时决定，可以是天族、邪魔、棱光裔，或与神性恒星有关的其他类型生物。该生物掷先攻，并持续存在，直到被击败或召回。有人解除危害时，该生物也会消失。如果危害已有神使在场，则改为指示该生物在危害之后立即进行自己的回合，或召回神使。与大多数被召唤生物不同，召唤出的神使每轮可以使用3个动作和反应。
items.expectedDescription: This hazard summons a specific 18th-level or lower creature on board a starship within 10 zones. The creature is determined when the hazard is created. The creature might be a celestial, fiend, prismeni, or any other creature type associated with the deific star. The creature rolls initiative and remains until defeated or recalled. The creature also disappears if someone disables the hazard. If the hazard already has a herald present, the hazard instead directs the creature to take its turn immediately after the hazard or recalls the herald. The summoned herald can use 3 actions each round and reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

items.name: 恒星赐福
items.description: 危害祝福一个目标。如果目标是星舰，其船体点与护盾点恢复至满值，且所有故障作战站位被修复。如果目标是生物，其生命值恢复至满值，且影响它的所有负面状态被移除。
items.expectedDescription: The hazard blesses a target. If the target is a starship, its HP and SP are fully restored, and all malfunctioning battle stations are repaired. If the target is a creature, its HP is fully restored, and all negative conditions affecting it are removed.

items.name: 恒星神罚
items.description: 危害惩击一个目标，造成@Damage[(4d10+22)[fire]]伤害和@Damage[(4d10+22)[spirit]]伤害，进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:47|basic]豁免。因恒星神罚的伤害而死的生物，除非获得神明的奇迹恩惠，否则无法以任何方法复活。
items.expectedDescription: The hazard smites a target, dealing @Damage[(4d10+22)[fire]] damage and @Damage[(4d10+22)[spirit]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:47|basic] save. Any creature that dies from damage caused by Stellar Smite can't be brought back from the dead by any means other than a miraculous favor from a deity.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A sacred or profane entity with tremendous godlike power manifests as a living star.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个拥有如神般强大力量的神圣或亵渎实体，显现为一颗活体恒星。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[deception|dc:48] (legendary; any battle station) or Diplomacy (legendary; any battle station) to earn the entity's favor, @Check[performance|dc:48] (legendary; any battle station) to challenge it to a contest and win, or @Check[religion|dc:48] (legendary; any battle station) to worship it or overwhelm it with another deity's power; four successes are required to disable the hazard
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[deception|dc:48]（传奇；任意作战站位）或交涉（传奇；任意作战站位），以赢得实体青睐；@Check[performance|dc:48]（传奇；任意作战站位）以挑战并赢得竞赛；或@Check[religion|dc:48]（传奇；任意作战站位）以崇拜它或用另一神祇的力量压倒它；解除危害需要四次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) If the hazard is hostile to any starships within 10 zones, it Directs Herald and orders it to attack all targets the hazard has judged unworthy. Then, it uses Stellar Smite to punish targets and Stellar Blessing to reward others, depending on how the deific star's edicts and anathemas align with present targets. The hazard's edicts and anathemas should be determined when the hazard is created.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）如果危害对10个区域内的任何星舰怀有敌意，就使用指挥神使，命令其攻击危害判为不配的所有目标。随后，根据神性恒星的敕令和禁忌与当前目标的关系，使用恒星神罚惩罚目标，并用恒星赐福奖励其他目标。危害的敕令和禁忌应在创建危害时确定。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: This hazard can't be destroyed except by a god or godlike entity and can reform at any time.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 除神祇或如神般的实体外，没有任何事物能够摧毁此危害，且它可以随时重塑。

items.name: 炮组齐射
items.description:
频率每天四次

效果战舰以炮组向200尺内的一个@Template[type:burst|distance:20]发起弹幕炮击。区域内的生物与物体受到@Damage[4d8[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害和@Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic]豁免）。除了驾驶员，船员或乘客也可以使用此能力。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency four times per day

Effect The battleship unleashes a barrage from its artillery batteries, targeting a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] within 200 feet. Creatures and objects in the area take @Damage[4d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage and @Damage[4d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). This ability can be used by crew or passengers, in addition to the pilot.

items.name: 电磁脉冲（EMP）
items.description:
频率每10分钟一次

效果战舰释放电磁脉冲，使敌舰失灵。@Template[type:emanation|distance:50]内的生物与物体必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:32]豁免检定。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}，持续1轮。

失败目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障2}，持续1分钟。

大失败目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障4}，持续1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The battleship unleashes an electromagnetic pulse, disabling enemy ships. Creatures and objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 4} for 1 minute.

items.name: 激光横扫
items.description:
频率每轮一次

效果战舰以巨型激光横扫战场，对生物和物体造成@Damage[8d6[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，作用范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:60]（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic]豁免）。除驾驶员外，船员或乘客也能使用此能力。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Effect The battleship sweeps its massive laser across the battlefield, dealing @Damage[8d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures and objects in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). This ability can be used by crew or passengers, in addition to the pilot.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: This colossal ship is built for one purpose: war. It wears that purpose proudly, with its massive spinal laser cannon, reinforced batteries, and anti-artillery armor clearly displayed to make a bold statement on whichever sea it finds itself. The battleship's passenger quarters are typically filled with off-duty crew rather than civilians, allowing it to be active around the clock as its crew and pilot operate in shifts. Despite its size, the apex battleship is far from sluggish or clumsy, with massive turbine engines that allow it to keep pace with smaller craft in battle.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这艘庞大巨舰仅为战争而建，并以此为荣。巨大的纵轴激光炮、强化炮组和抗炮击装甲毫不遮掩，无论驶入哪片海域，都以鲜明姿态宣示其用途。战舰客舱通常住着轮休船员而非平民，让驾驶员与船员轮班，全天候运作。尽管体型庞大，巅峰战舰绝不迟钝笨拙，巨大的涡轮引擎使其能在战斗中跟上小型船只。

items.name: 预备弹药
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入陷阱所在区域

效果陷阱的引爆值设为0，然后陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the trap's zone

Effect The trap's detonation value is set to 0, then the trap rolls initiative.

items.name: 引爆
items.description:
触发引爆值达到5，有人解除或重新编程爆炸物的检定失败，或一艘星舰离开陷阱所在的区域

效果陷阱爆炸，对1个区域范围内的所有星舰造成@Damage[(6d12+37)[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic]豁免），并使舰上所有生物暴露于严酷辐射。距离不超过2个区域的星舰受到@Damage[(4d12+26)[fire]]伤害，这些星舰上的生物暴露于严重辐射。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The detonation value reaches 5, someone fails a check to disarm or reprogram the explosive, or a starship leaves the trap's zone

Effect The trap explodes, dealing @Damage[(6d12+37)[fire]] damage to all starships within 1 zone (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] save) and exposing all creatures on board to incredible radiation. Starships up to 2 zones away take @Damage[(4d12+26)[fire]] damage, and creatures on board those starships are exposed to severe radiation.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A stray munition packed with powerful explosives is primed to detonate.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一枚装满强力炸药的遗落弹药已准备引爆。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:38] (expert) to reprogram the explosive, or @Check[crafting|dc:34] (expert) to disarm the explosive, or @Check[religion|dc:43] (master) to pray for a miracle; three successes required to disable the trap
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:38]（专家）以重编爆炸物；或@Check[crafting|dc:34]（专家）以拆除爆炸物；或@Check[religion|dc:43]（大师）以祈求奇迹；解除陷阱需要三次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The trap's detonation value goes up by 1. When the detonation value reaches 5, the trap emits a red light before it Detonates.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）陷阱的引爆值增加1。引爆值达到5时，陷阱先发出红光，随后引爆。

L5NtWCCJdmkrD2d2.name: 爆裂卵囊 Exploding Egg Sac

items.name: 爆炸
items.description:
触发一个生物触碰卵囊或丝线

效果陷阱对卵囊周围30尺内的所有生物进行丝线打击，然后卵囊爆炸，对30尺内的所有生物造成@Damage[(2d10+9)[acid]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic]豁免）。如果卵囊内的生物能够存活，它便会孵化。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature touches the egg sac or touches a filament

Effect The trap makes a filament Strike against all creatures within 30 feet of the egg sac, then the egg sac explodes, dealing @Damage[(2d10+9)[acid]] damage to all creatures within 30 feet (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic] save). If the creature within the egg sac is viable, it hatches.

items.name: 丝线
items.description: 不应用多重攻击减值
items.expectedDescription: No multiple attack penalty

cnText_system_details_description.expected: An ovular alien egg sac emerges from the ground or other surface; pulsing, veinlike filaments cover all surfaces in a 30-foot radius around the egg sac.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个卵形异星卵囊从地面或其他表面冒出；卵囊周围30尺半径内的所有表面都覆盖着脉动的血管状丝线。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:30] (trained) to cause the egg sac to implode, or @Check[survival|dc:23] (expert) to safely destroy the filaments in an adjacent square
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:30]（受训）以使卵囊内爆；或@Check[survival|dc:23]（专家）以安全摧毁相邻一格内的丝线

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: If the egg sac survives and hasn't hatched, filaments regrow in 1 day.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 如果卵囊存活且尚未孵化，丝线会在1日内重新生长。

items.name: 突发惊吓
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至闹鬼区域周围10尺内

效果作祟重现了造就它的创伤时刻，生动地冲击该生物的感官，仿佛它正亲历此事。该生物必须进行@Check[will|dc:24]豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到@Damage[(2d8+5)[mental]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}状态。

失败目标受到@Damage[(4d8+10)[mental]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态。

大失败目标受到@Damage[(8d8+20)[mental]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the haunted area

Effect The haunt replays the traumatic moment that created it, vividly assaulting the creature's senses as though the creature was experiencing the event. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(2d8+5)[mental]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(4d8+10)[mental]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(8d8+20)[mental]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A psychic imprint of a horrific event replays in vivid detail.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一场恐怖事件留下的心灵印痕，以鲜明的细节不断重演。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[occultism|dc:28] (expert) or Religion (expert) to cleanse the area
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[occultism|dc:28]（专家）或宗教（专家）以净化区域

items.name: 有机维生系统
items.description: 生物潜艇的鳃和内部肠道生物群能无限期地为船员提供空气、食物和水，但每天必须给潜艇喂食一个中型生物（通常是鱼），以维持这些系统。
items.expectedDescription: A biosub's gills and internal gut biome can produce air, food, and water for its crew indefinitely, though the ship must be fed a Medium creature (usually a fish) every day to maintain these systems.

items.name: 半生命体
items.description: 虽然生物潜艇有一部分是活体，其科技组件却使它更能抵御多数载具免疫的效应（反之亦然）。任何适用于生物或物体的效应都会影响生物潜艇，但对抗通常只影响其中一类的效应时，它的豁免获得+2环境加值。
items.expectedDescription: Though a biosub is partially alive, its technological components make it more resistant to effects most vehicles are immune to (and vice versa). Any effect that applies to creatures or objects affects a biosub, though it gets a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would normally only affect one or the other.

items.name: 潜水能力
items.description: 生物潜艇能在水下航行，其构造能承受任何深度的水压。
items.expectedDescription: A biosub can travel beneath the surface of the water, built to withstand water pressure at any depth.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: In an effort to overcome the enormous challenge of creating vessels that can withstand the pressures of the deep sea, some engineers have capitalized on life's ability to adapt to even the most extreme conditions. Biosubs use a combination of cutting-edge submersible technology and advanced biotech grafts to create a semi-living ship. Thanks to this unique construction, they enjoy some of the benefits (and drawbacks) of being simultaneously a living creature and a piece of technology.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 建造能够承受深海压力的船只极为困难，一些工程师因此利用生命适应极端条件的能力。生物潜艇结合尖端潜水技术与先进的生物工程植入物，造出半活体船只。得益于这种独特构造，它们同时作为活物和科技产物，享有两者的部分优势，也承受部分弊端。

items.name: 登舰小队
items.description: 该危害内装有一个特定的1级生物或两个特定的–1级生物。当登舰小队中的一个生物通过部署登舰者被部署时，将它从该危害的登舰小队中移除。
items.expectedDescription: The hazard contains a specific 1st-level creature or two specific –1-level creatures. When a creature in the boarding party is Deployed as a Boarder, it's removed from the hazard's boarding party.

items.name: 侦测敌舰
items.description:
触发一艘敌方星舰在登舰舱周围3个区域内开始其回合

效果登舰舱朝触发星舰移动1个区域，然后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An enemy starship starts its turn within 3 zones of the boarding pod

Effect The boarding pod moves 1 zone toward the triggering starship, then rolls initiative.

items.name: 撞击
items.description: 该危害飞向一艘星舰，试图与其相撞。目标必须成功通过@Check[reflex|dc:17]豁免，否则该危害便会嵌入星舰。它会随星舰一同移动，直到被摧毁或解除。
items.expectedDescription: This hazard flies toward a starship and attempts to collide with it. The target must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:17] save, or the hazard becomes embedded in the starship. It moves with the starship until it's destroyed or disabled.

items.name: 部署登舰者
items.description:
需求该危害嵌入一艘星舰

效果该危害释放其登舰小队，小队成员在创建该危害时决定。登舰生物投掷先攻，并战斗至被摧毁为止。登舰生物每轮能使用3个动作，也能使用反应。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The hazard is embedded in a starship

Effect This hazard unleashes its boarding party, determined when the hazard is created. The boarding creature rolls initiative and fights until destroyed. The boarding creature can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions.

items.name: 喷气推进
items.description: 该危害移动2个区域。
items.expectedDescription: The hazard moves 2 zones.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A boarding pod containing a hostile boarding party launches through space.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个载有敌对登舰队的登舰舱发射出去，穿越太空。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:17] (trained; scanners) to hack and disable the boarding pod before it collides (two successes are required to disable it in this way); @Check[piloting|dc:17] (trained; pilot's console) to shake off a boarding pod that has collided with the starship
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:17]（受训；扫描仪）以在碰撞前骇入并解除登舰舱，以此方式解除需要两次成功；@Check[piloting|dc:17]（受训；驾驶控制台）以甩掉已经撞上星舰的登舰舱

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) The hazard Jet Propels, then Collides against a starship in its zone. If the hazard has successfully Collided against a starship, it instead Deploys Boarder.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （2个动作）危害先使用喷气推进，随后对其所在区域内的一艘星舰碰撞。如果危害已经成功碰撞星舰，则改为部署登舰者。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: Manually salvage the boarding pod and repair it.

items.name: 隔热防护
items.description: 岩浆巡航车的防火屏障也会保护船员。岩浆巡航车上的生物免疫严重或更低程度环境高温的效应。此外，它们会将严酷环境高温的效应降低至极度高温的效应。
items.expectedDescription: A magma cruiser's fire shielding protects its crew as well. Creatures on board a magma cruiser are immune to the effects of severe environmental heat or less. In addition, they reduce the effects of incredible environmental heat to those of extreme heat.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: With innumerable planets in the galaxy, there are always worlds that are worth exploring but have inherently dangerous environments. Engineers and shipbuilders see these hazardous environments not as deterrents, but as challenges to overcome. Worlds covered in magma or lava are often ideal locations for manufacturing or mining facilities, but surveyors and future inhabitants need a way to safely traverse the surface of such planets. While these magma cruisers are most common in Near Space, similar vessels also exist for other hostile environments such as acid lakes.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 星系中行星无数，总有值得探索却环境险恶的世界。工程师和造船师将这些危险环境视为需要克服的挑战。岩浆或熔岩覆盖的世界通常适合建造生产或采矿设施，但勘测者和未来居民需要安全穿越行星表面的手段。岩浆巡航船在近宇最为常见，也有类似船只用于酸湖等其他恶劣环境。

items.name: 附着
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移入该危害所在的区域

效果星界藤壶对触发星舰进行吸盘打击。成功时，藤壶附着在触发星舰的船体上，该星舰的速度受到–1个区域的状态减值。藤壶的消化液具有腐蚀性，在星舰回合结束时对星舰造成@Damage[1d6[acid]]伤害，直至藤壶被解除或摧毁。藤壶在5轮后自动脱落。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves into the hazard's zone

Effect The astral barnacles make a sucker Strike against the triggering starship. On a success, the barnacles cling to the triggering starship's hull, and the starship takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed. The barnacles' digestive fluids are caustic, dealing @Damage[1d6[acid]] damage to the starship at the end of the starship's turn or until the barnacles are disabled or destroyed. The barnacles fall off automatically after 5 rounds.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Floating barnacles cling to the starship passing by.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 漂浮的藤壶附着在经过的星舰上。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:13] (trained; magic conduit) to repel, or @Check[piloting|dc:16] (trained; pilot's console) to shake off the barnacles
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:13]（受训；魔法导管）以驱退藤壶；或@Check[piloting|dc:16]（受训；驾驶控制台）以甩掉藤壶

items.name: 攻击编队
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移动至作祟所在区域周围4个区域内

效果四艘幽灵舰船在作祟所在区域显现。作祟对触发星舰进行两次幽灵激光打击，然后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves within 4 zones of the haunt's zone

Effect Four spectral vessels materialize in the haunt's zone. The haunt attempts two spectral laser Strikes against the triggering starship, then rolls initiative.

items.name: 幽灵激光
items.expectedDescription: (range increment 4 zones)
items.description: （射程增量4个区域）

items.name: 掠袭编队
items.description:
需求至少还剩两艘幽灵星舰

效果两艘幽灵星舰一同移动至多4个区域。每艘星舰各自在移动途中的任意时点对一个目标进行幽灵激光打击；所有目标在对抗这些打击时都处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements At least two spectral starships remain

Effect Two spectral starships move together up to 4 zones. Each attempts a spectral laser Strike against a target at any point during their movement; all targets are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to these Strikes.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Ghostly starships battle ceaselessly in this sector.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 幽灵星舰在这片星区中无休止地交战。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[deception|dc:36] (master; scanners) to trick a spectral starship into believing its battle is won; @Check[religion|dc:34] (master; magic conduit) to exorcise one spectral starship; one success disables a spectral starship, and four successes are required to disable the haunt
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[deception|dc:36]（大师；扫描仪）以骗过一艘幽灵星舰，使其相信战斗已经获胜；@Check[religion|dc:34]（大师；魔法导管）以驱除一艘幽灵星舰；一次成功解除一艘幽灵星舰，解除作祟需要四次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action per spectral starship) The spectral starships operate in pairs and maneuver to surround their targets whenever possible. On a typical round, one pair performs Flyby Formation, while the other pair opens fire, each of them firing one spectral laser Strikes. The haunt fights until all spectral starships are exorcised or temporarily destroyed.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （每艘幽灵星舰1个动作）幽灵星舰两艘一组行动，尽可能机动包围目标。通常一轮中，一组使用掠袭编队，另一组开火，各进行一次幽灵激光打击。作祟会持续战斗，直到所有幽灵星舰被驱除或暂时摧毁。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The spectral starships can't be permanently destroyed unless they're exorcised. They reform over the course of 24 hours, after which the haunt can trigger again.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 除非被驱除，否则幽灵星舰无法永久摧毁。它们会在24小时内重塑，之后作祟可以再次触发。

items.name: 强化转向
items.description: 处于水面模式时，水下滑行艇每向前移动一个车身长度便可转向至多180度，而非通常的90度。
items.expectedDescription: While in surface mode, an underwater skimmer can turn up to 180 degrees for every vehicle length it moves forward, instead of the normal 90 degrees.

items.name: 再配置
items.description: 滑行艇在水面模式与潜行模式之间切换。
items.expectedDescription: The skimmer switches between surface mode and stealth mode.

items.name: 潜水能力
items.description: 处于潜行模式时，水下滑行艇能在水下航行，最深可至1000尺。其储气罐能供1个中型生物维持至多4小时，之后该生物必须屏息，否则便开始窒息，直至滑行艇再次浮出水面。
items.expectedDescription: While in stealth mode, an underwater skimmer can travel beneath the surface of the water, to a depth of up to 1,000 feet. Its air reservoir can sustain 1 Medium creature for up to 4 hours, after which they must hold their breath or begin to suffocate until the skimmer surfaces again.

items.name: 水下渗透
items.description: 水下滑行艇处于潜行模式且潜入水下时，驾驶员可以用一个载具动作进行[[/act hide]]，将其效果赋予滑行艇。这样做时，可以用驾驶检定代替隐秘检定。
items.expectedDescription: While an underwater skimmer is in stealth mode and submerged, the pilot can [[/act hide]] as a vehicle action, conferring the benefits to the skimmer. They can roll Piloting instead of Stealth to do so.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: These nimble scout vessels can move quickly or stealthily in naval theaters, changing between configurations to meet the needs of the mission.
