Though they were originally military vehicles, they're also widely used by marine xenobiologists, divers, and others who need a versatile undersea craft.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这些灵巧侦察船能在海战中迅速或隐秘地行动，切换配置以满足任务需求。虽然最初是军用载具，如今海洋异星生物学家、潜水者以及其他需要多用途水下载具的人也广泛使用它们。

cnText_system_details_speed.expected: swim 50 feet (motorized; surface mode), swim 35 feet (motorized; stealth mode)
cnText_system_details_speed.text: 游泳50尺（机动；水面模式），游泳35尺（机动；隐秘模式）

SBKIdzyEghJyQfgr.name: 失控自动驾驶 Haywire Autopilot

items.name: 冲撞
items.description:
一个生物移动至悬浮汽车周围30尺内

效果悬浮汽车沿直线行驶30尺，对其经过区域内的所有生物造成@Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic]豁免）。被汽车伤害的生物还会被撞至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
A creature moves within 30 feet of the hovercar

Effect The hovercar drives 30 feet in a straight line, dealing @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]] damage to all creatures in the area it passes through (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). Creatures damaged by the car are additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A hovercar's autopilot goes haywire, causing it to run over nearby creatures.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 悬浮车的自动驾驶失控，碾压附近的生物。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:26] (expert) to remotely reprogram the autopilot, or @Check[piloting|dc:24] or @Check[thievery|dc:24] (expert) to override the autopilot while aboard the car; three total successes are required to disable the trap; @Check[acrobatics|dc:23] or @Check[athletics|dc:23] to board the car (boarding doesn't disable the trap)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:26]（专家）以远程重编自动驾驶；或在车内以@Check[piloting|dc:24]或@Check[thievery|dc:24]（专家）覆盖自动驾驶；解除陷阱总计需要三次成功；@Check[acrobatics|dc:23]或@Check[athletics|dc:23]以上车，上车不会解除陷阱

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each successful disable. The hovercar uses 1 action to drive 30 feet in a straight line, three times, changing direction between actions as desired. Creatures in the area the hovercar passes through take @Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). Creatures damaged by the car are additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）每有一次成功解除，陷阱每回合就少1个动作。悬浮车每次用1个动作沿直线行驶30尺，共三次，可以在动作之间任意改变方向。悬浮车经过区域内的生物受到@Damage[(2d10+13)[bludgeoning]]伤害，并进行@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic]豁免。被车辆伤害的生物还被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

T2xb9NaE2RbisYry.name: 遭骇入的漂流域信标 Hacked Drift Beacon

items.name: 垃圾广告风暴
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移动至该危害周围1个区域内，或使用任意扫描仪站位动作，以该危害所在区域为目标

效果陷阱投放一则定向广告，诱使观众花费信用点购买产品或服务。所有能看见、听见或感知该广告的生物（包括通过星舰传感器感知）都必须进行@Check[will|dc:17]豁免。陷阱投掷先攻。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态。

失败该生物处于目眩和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}状态，直到该危害被解除。

大失败该生物处于目眩和迷魂状态，除操作最近的计算机或通讯装置并按照广告指示购物之外，不能采取任何动作；这些效应持续至该危害被解除。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves within 1 zone of the hazard or uses any scanners station action targeting the hazard's zone

Effect The trap launches a targeted ad enticing viewers to spend credits on a product or service. All creatures that can see, hear, or sense the ad (including through starship sensors) must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save. The trap rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.

Failure The creature is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} until the hazard is disabled.

Critical Failure The creature is dazzled and fascinated, and it can't take any actions except to access the nearest computer or comm unit and make purchases as directed by the ad; these effects last until the hazard is disabled.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A hijacked Drift beacon broadcasts obnoxious ads or some other repetitive message.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个被劫持的漂流信标播放令人厌烦的广告或其他重复信息。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:20] (trained) to repair the Drift beacon's code, @Check[crafting|dc:22] (trained) to disassemble the trap, or @Check[religion|dc:23] (trained) to consecrate it for Triune
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:20]（受训）以修复漂流信标代码；@Check[crafting|dc:22]（受训）以拆卸陷阱；或@Check[religion|dc:23]（受训）以为三贤一祝圣信标

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The hazard plays a new ad, forcing all creatures that can sense it to attempt a new save against Spam Storm.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）危害播放一则新广告，迫使所有能感知广告的生物再次对垃圾信息风暴尝试豁免。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

items.name: 速度过快
items.description: 水翼艇以机动性为代价换取速度。它必须移动完整速度的距离才能转向至多90度，而非通常只需移动一个车身长度。此外，其驾驶员进行具有鲁莽特征的载具动作所需的驾驶检定时，受到–2状态减值。
items.expectedDescription: A hydrofoil's speed comes at the cost of maneuverability. It must move its full speed to turn up to 90 degrees, instead of the normal vehicle length. In addition, its pilot takes a –2 status penalty to Piloting checks for vehicle actions with the reckless trait.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: These long and narrow boats are made to go extremely fast in straight lines but aren't much good at anything else; even experienced operators have trouble getting much maneuverability out of the fragile vessels. When you need to get light cargo or a few passengers across a body of water as quickly as possible, though, a hydrofoil is hard to beat.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这些狭长小艇旨在以极快速度直线航行，却几乎不擅长其他事；即使经验丰富的操纵者也难以让脆弱的船身灵活机动。不过，如果需要尽快将轻型货物或少量乘客运过一片水域，很少有比水翼艇更好的选择。

TzlnFwSGU2nJCf41.name: 终点巨轮卡车 Terminus Monster Truck

items.name: 碾碎者
items.description: 当终点巨轮卡车碾过并撞击一个目标时，如果目标因碰撞伤害而降至0生命值，巨轮卡车及其驾驶员和乘客便不受到伤害。
items.expectedDescription: When a terminus monster truck Runs Over and rams a target, if the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the collision damage, the monster truck and its pilots and passengers take no damage.

items.name: 巨大车轮
items.description: 终点巨轮卡车能驶上并越过至多5尺高的障碍，但它将这些空间视为困难地形，巨型悬挂车轮不会忽略这种困难地形。
items.expectedDescription: A terminus monster truck can move up and over obstacles up to 5 feet in height, though it treats such spaces as difficult terrain that mega suspension wheels doesn't ignore.

items.name: 巨型悬挂车轮
items.description: 终点巨轮卡车忽略非魔法困难地形和极度困难地形。此外，卡车的悬挂系统能吸收部分冲击，使其将坠落距离视为缩短15尺。
items.expectedDescription: A terminus monster truck ignores non-magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain. In addition, it treats falls as 15 feet shorter as the truck's suspension absorbs some of the impact.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: This gargantuan eight-wheeled vehicle is a commercial variant of prototype models developed for a destructive, vehicular arena combat sport played on Akiton and in the depths of Absalom Station. Although these initial prototypes made use of flashy and over-the-top weaponry, such as buzz saws and flamethrowers, the commercial model strips back these pyrotechnics in favor of a more dedicated, utility-orientated off-road design.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这种庞大的八轮载具是某种原型车的商用版本。原型车专为一种充满破坏性的载具竞技场运动开发，流行于阿基顿及艾巴萨罗姆空间站深处。最初的原型装有圆锯、火焰喷射器等华丽而夸张的武器；商用型号削减这些炫目武装，转而采用更专注实用性的越野设计。

items.name: 危险气流
items.description: 船体破口周围10尺内的所有空间都是真空。该区域是困难地形。生物朝船体破口移动时，可以忽略此困难地形。
items.expectedDescription: All spaces within 10 feet of the hull breach are a vacuum. The area is difficult terrain. A creature can ignore this difficult terrain while moving toward the hull breach.

items.name: 真空裂口
items.description:
触发星舰已没有任何剩余护盾点时，一个回合开始

需求星舰位于真空中，且星舰内部不是真空

效果空气迅速从破口逸出。该危害充斥其当前空间周围10尺内的每个空间，除非这些空间被气闸或同样坚固且气密的屏障隔开。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A turn starts while the starship doesn't have any remaining Shield Points

Requirements The starship is in a vacuum, and the inside of the starship isn't a vacuum

Effect Air rapidly escapes through the breach. The hazardous fills every space within 10 feet of its current space, unless those spaces are blocked by an airlock or a similarly strong and airtight barrier. The trap then rolls initiative.

items.name: 吸入太空
items.description: 处于危险气流空间内的生物必须进行@Check[fortitude|dc:20]豁免。失败时，生物沿最短路径被拉向船体破口15尺（大失败时30尺）。未固定的大型或更小物体也会被拉动，并自动失败。穿过船体破口的生物和物体会飘入太空。如果未固定，它们会以每分钟1个区域的速度，沿星舰航向的反方向远离星舰所在的区域。
items.expectedDescription: Creatures in the spaces of hazardous airflow must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save. On a failure, a creature is pulled 15 feet toward the hull breach along the shortest possible path (30 feet on critical failure). Untethered Large or smaller objects are also pulled and automatically fail. Creatures and objects pulled through the hull breach float into space. If they're untethered, they move away from the starship's zone, opposite of its heading, at a rate of 1 zone per minute.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A 5-foot breach in the airlock or hull sucks everything inside a starship into space.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 气闸或船壳上的一个5尺破口，将星舰内的一切吸入太空。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:19] (trained) to patch up the hull, or restore 10 or more Hull Points to the starship; restoring 5 or more Shield Points to the starship suppresses the trap until the starship loses all its Shield Points but doesn't disable the trap; @Check[acrobatics|dc:19] to Maneuver in Flight or Athletics to Grab a Ledge avoids or stops the effects of Pull Into Space (this doesn't disable the trap)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:19]（受训）以修补船壳，或为星舰恢复10点或更多船体点；恢复5点或更多护盾点会压制陷阱，直到星舰失去全部护盾点，但不会解除陷阱；@Check[acrobatics|dc:19]以空中机动，或运动以抓住边缘，可避免或停止吸入太空的效果，这不会解除陷阱

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The trap Pulls Into Space.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）陷阱使用吸入太空。

items.name: 平台模式
items.description:
需求蛛行爬行车附着在稳定表面上

效果蛛行爬行车展开成一个20尺长、10尺宽的平坦平台，其船员和乘客站在平台上。驾驶员可以用一个互动动作结束此效应，使船员和乘客回到座位，并让其他所有生物从平台上掉下。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The spider-crawler is attached to a stable surface

Effect The spider-crawler unfolds into a 20-foot by 10-foot flat platform, which its crew and passengers are standing on. The pilot can end the effect with a single Interact action, returning its crew and passengers to their seats and dropping any other creatures off the platform.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Designed for heavily forested areas, the spider-crawler is a sturdy buggy that's equally at home navigating mountainous areas and scaling trees. Instead of wheels, it's equipped with four long, spider-like legs that make it remarkably nimble. Spider-crawlers are occasionally used by special ops teams, as their ability to unfold into a larger stationary platform allows for uniquely convenient sniping positions.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 蛛行爬行车是为密林环境设计的坚固越野车，既适合穿越山地，也适合攀树。它没有车轮，而是配备四条细长蛛腿，因此格外灵活。特战小队有时也会使用蛛行爬行车，因为它可以展开成更大的固定平台，提供独特而便利的狙击位置。

items.name: 重力脉冲
items.description:
触发一个生物进入传感器的侦测区域

效果陷阱释放重力脉冲，对触发生物造成@Damage[(2d6+3)[force]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic]豁免）。然后，传感器周围30尺内的区域变为零重力，持续1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters the sensor's detection area

Effect The trap releases a gravity pulse, dealing @Damage[(2d6+3)[force]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:15|basic] save). The area within 30 feet of the sensor then becomes zero gravity for 1 minute.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A harmful pulse of anti-gravity is activated by a sensor that detects motion within 30 feet.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 传感器侦测到30尺内的移动时，激活一道有害的反重力脉冲。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:18] (trained) to jam the motion detector's signal or @Check[thievery|dc:16] (trained) to deactivate the motion detector
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:18]（受训）以干扰移动侦测器信号；或@Check[thievery|dc:16]（受训）以停用移动侦测器

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap resets after 15 minutes.

WIk0lsl9INxtuTzP.name: 装甲运兵车 Armored Personnel Carrier

items.name: 双武器架
items.description: 装甲运兵车有两个武器架，左右两侧各一个；每个武器架均可通过两个互动动作安装或移除任意远程武器。运兵车的任何乘客都能以这样安装的武器进行打击。以这种方式安装且需要电池的武器可以直接从运兵车引擎供能，因此开火时不消耗任何充能。
items.expectedDescription: An armored personnel carrier has two weapon mounts, one on each side, which can each have any ranged weapon installed or removed with two Interact actions. Any of the carrier's passengers can make Strikes with weapons installed this way. Weapons installed this way that require batteries don't consume any charges when fired, as they can draw power directly from the carrier's engine.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: While numerous high-tech means exist to deploy troops into combat, a sturdy armored personnel carrier remains standard throughout most of the Pact Worlds, thanks to its relative affordability and reliability. Since the carrier's size and hardened armor slow its movement, it's also equipped with a pair of weapon mounts that allow the troops within to unleash suppressive fire on nearby threats.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 尽管已有诸多高科技手段能将部队投入战斗，坚固的装甲运兵车凭借相对低廉的价格和可靠性，仍是协约世界大部分地区的标准装备。车身尺寸与硬化装甲使其移动缓慢，因此还配有一对武器支架，让车内士兵能向附近威胁倾泻压制火力。

items.name: 人工智能导航
items.description:
除了正常驾驶外，驾驶员还可以尝试@Check[computers|dc:12]检定，将目的地输入梦行舱的机载人工智能。

大成功梦行舱比预期更快抵达目的地。其速度获得+15尺状态加值，直到抵达目的地。

成功梦行舱抵达目的地。

失败梦行舱纹丝不动。

大失败梦行舱朝着与目的地相反方向上10千米外的一点移动。
items.expectedDescription:
In addition to being driven normally, the pilot can enter their destination into a somnambupod's onboard AI by attempting a @Check[computers|dc:12] check.

Critical Success The somnambupod arrives at its destination faster than expected. It gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speed until it arrives.

Success The somnambupod arrives at its destination.

Failure The somnambupod doesn't move an inch.

Critical Failure The somnambupod moves toward a point 10 kilometers in the opposite direction from its destination.

items.name: 奢华彻底放松
items.description: 乘坐梦行舱时，驾驶员可以选择启动奢华彻底放松模式。舱壁变得不透明，遮住外部景象，同时播放舒缓音乐，让人容易入睡。以这种方式乘坐时，驾驶员不能采取任何动作，包括载具动作；但如果旅程至少持续6小时，便获得休息8小时的益处。
items.expectedDescription: While riding in a somnambupod, the pilot can choose to initiate complete luxury relaxation mode. The pod's enclosure becomes opaque, obscuring the outside world, and it plays calming music to allow for easy sleep. The pilot can take no actions while riding this way, including vehicle actions, but if the journey is at least 6 hours long, they gain the benefits of 8 hours of rest.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The somnambupod was designed as a luxury machine for the technology-inclined elite. Resembling a small bed-shaped pod with four crablike legs, the somnambupod's guiding design ethos is to provide riders relaxing, luxurious sleep during their journey. While it succeeds in this goal, it proved to lack mass appeal, leading one Pact Worlds journalist to famously state, "Who would even want something like this?"
cnText_system_details_description.text: 梦行舱原是为热衷科技的上流人士设计的奢侈机器。它形似一张小床，下有四条蟹足；核心设计理念是让乘客在旅途中享受轻松奢华的睡眠。虽然实现了这一目标，却未能吸引大众，一位协约世界记者因此留下名言：“到底谁会想要这种东西？”

items.name: 宇宙中的渺小
items.description: 生物和星舰首次在自身传感器范围内观察到该危害时，必须进行@Check[will|dc:44]豁免。成功时，生物或星舰处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}状态。失败时，生物或星舰处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并被存在的虚无感淹没（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧4}）。
items.expectedDescription: Creatures and starships must attempt a @Check[will|dc:44] save when they first observe the hazard within their sensor range. On a success, a creature or starship is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. On a failure, the creature or starship is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and overwhelmed with existential ennui (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4} on a critical failure).

items.name: 无可逃脱的虚空
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移动至危害10个区域内

效果触发星舰被拉向该危害1个区域，并困在该危害的轨道中。受困时，星舰不能改变航向，除朝向该危害移动外，也不能采取任何移动任意数量区域的动作；每轮都必须有人解除该危害，才能摆脱此限制。该危害孳生不死生物，然后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves within 10 zones of the hazard

Effect The triggering starship is pulled 1 zone toward the hazard and is trapped in the hazard's orbit. While trapped, the starship can't Change Heading or take any actions to move any number of zones except toward the hazard until someone disables it each round. The hazard Spawns Undead, then rolls initiative.

items.name: 孳生不死生物
items.description: 该危害在10个区域内的一艘星舰上召唤一个特定的17级不死生物。生物种类在创建该危害时决定。该生物投掷先攻，并持续存在，直到被击败或召回。如果有人解除该危害，该生物也会消失。如果该危害已经有一个不死生物存在，则改为指示该生物在危害之后立即进行其回合，或将不死生物召回。与大多数召唤生物不同，被召唤的不死生物每轮能使用3个动作和反应。
items.expectedDescription: This hazard summons a specific 17th-level undead creature on board a starship, within 10 zones. The creature is determined when the hazard is created. The creature rolls initiative and remains until defeated or recalled. The creature also disappears if someone disables the hazard. If the hazard already has an undead present, the hazard instead directs the creature to take its turn immediately after the hazard or recalls the undead. The summoned undead can use 3 actions each round and reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A supernatural black hole sucks all heat and light into its maw.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个超自然黑洞将所有热量与光线吸入巨口。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:47] (expert; scanners), Nature (expert; magic conduit), or Physical Science Lore (trained; generator or scanners) to take protective measures, or @Check[piloting|dc:50] (expert; pilot's console) to avoid the gravitational pull; one success is required per round for the triggering starship to act normally.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:47]（专家；扫描仪）、自然（专家；魔法导管）或物理科学学识（受训；发电机或扫描仪），以采取防护措施；或@Check[piloting|dc:50]（专家；驾驶控制台）以避开引力牵引；触发星舰每轮需要一次成功才能正常行动。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
(2 action actions) The hazard Spawns Undead, then pulls the starship 1 zone toward it and continues to trap the starship. The starship experiences additional effects depending on how close it is to the hazard. A starship's speed cannot be reduced below 1 from this hazard.

Within 10 zones: The starship's Speed is reduced by 1 zone.

Within 6 zones: The starship's Speed is reduced by 2 zones.

Within 4 zones: The starship's Speed is reduced by 4 zones, and two random battle stations are malfunctioning.

Within 2 zones: The starship's Speed is reduced to 1 zone, and all battle stations are malfunctioning.

Event Horizon (Hazard's Zone) A starship in the hazard's zone is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and can't take any actions to move any number of zones or Change Heading. Battle stations are malfunctioning. The starship takes @Damage[(4d10+20)[force]] damage each round (@Check[fortitude|dc:46|basic] save). If the starship is destroyed, all creatures and objects inside take damage instead.
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
（2个动作）危害先孳生不死生物，再将星舰向自身拉近1个区域，并继续困住星舰。星舰根据距离危害的远近受到额外效果。此危害无法将星舰速度降至1以下。

10个区域内：星舰速度降低1个区域。

6个区域内：星舰速度降低2个区域。

4个区域内：星舰速度降低4个区域，且随机两个作战站位发生故障。

2个区域内：星舰速度降至1个区域，且所有作战站位发生故障。

事件视界（危害所在区域）危害所在区域内的星舰@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，不能采取任何移动区域或改变朝向的动作。作战站位发生故障。星舰每轮受到@Damage[(4d10+20)[force]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:46|basic]豁免。如果星舰被摧毁，改为由内部所有生物和物体承受伤害。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: This hazard can't be permanently disabled, only escaped, and resets immediately.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 此危害不能永久解除，只能逃离，并会立即重置。

X88p0aK0YpFwOELb.name: 扰人全息广告 Distracting Holo Ad

items.name: 买！买！买！
items.description:
触发区域内的一个生物完成一个动作

效果陷阱投放一则定向广告，诱使观众花费信用点购买产品或服务。30尺内所有能看见、听见或感知该广告的生物都必须进行@Check[will|dc:17]豁免。陷阱投掷先攻。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态。

失败目标处于目眩和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}状态。

大失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}状态，持续1轮，且除操作最近的计算机或通讯装置并按照广告指示购物之外，不能采取任何动作。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature in the area finishes an action

Effect The trap launches a targeted ad enticing viewers to spend credits on a product or service. All creatures within 30 feet who can see, hear, or sense the ad must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save. The trap rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}.

Failure The target is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 round and can't take any actions except to access the nearest computer or comm unit and make purchases as directed by the ad.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Colorful, lifelike figures flit in and out of a holographic advertisement in a barrage of pleasant sounds and sensations, enticing passersby to spend their credits. The hologram's source is a nearby projector.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 鲜艳逼真的人物在全息广告中穿梭，伴随一连串悦耳声音和愉悦感受，诱使路人花费信用点。全息影像来自附近的投影仪。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:17] (trained) to deactivate the ad, or @Check[crafting|dc:20] (trained) or Thievery (trained) to disable the projector
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:17]（受训）以停用广告；或@Check[crafting|dc:20]（受训）或贼活（受训）以解除投影仪

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The hazard plays a new ad each round, forcing all creatures that can sense it to attempt a new save.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）危害每轮播放一则新广告，迫使所有能感知广告的生物再次尝试豁免。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.expected: (trained), or DC 20 (expert) to notice the holoprojector, or detect magic
cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.text: （受训），或DC 20（专家）以发现全息投影仪，或侦测魔法

items.name: 武器暗格
items.description: 电动战车设有数个隐藏隔间，总共能储存2负载的武器。驾驶员能将超过轻型负载的武器藏匿在这些隔间中，并能以交互动作取出其中的任意武器，如同这些武器正由自己携带一般。
items.expectedDescription: An electric chariot features several hidden compartments and can store a total of 2 Bulk worth of weapons. The pilot can Conceal weapons of greater than light Bulk in these compartments and can Interact to draw any weapon stored in these compartments as if they were being carried.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Though it began its life as an upscale model of motorized mobility aid, the version of the electric chariot that reached store shelves also boasts remarkable combat capabilities, including armored panels and a hidden weapon compartment.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 电动战车最初只是一款高档电动助行工具，但最终上市的版本还具有出色的战斗能力，包括装甲板和隐藏武器舱。

items.name: 撞击
items.description:
触发一个生物穿过街道

效果一辆幻影悬浮卡车撞向所有正在穿过街道的生物，造成@Damage[(6d12+37)[bludgeoning]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:43]豁免）。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害，被撞至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并被向后推10尺。

失败该生物受到完整伤害，被撞倒地，并被向后推20尺。

大失败该生物受到双倍伤害，被撞倒地，并被向后推30尺。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature crosses the street

Effect A phantom hover truck crashes into all creatures crossing the street, dealing @Damage[(6d12+37)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:43] save).

Success The creature takes half damage, is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and is pushed 10 feet back.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A phantom hover truck collides with creatures, replaying an accident from the past in gory detail.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一辆幻影悬浮卡车撞向生物，以血淋淋的细节重演过去的事故。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[occultism|dc:38] (master) to disperse the phantom truck, or @Check[religion|dc:36] (master) to ward yourself from harm
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[occultism|dc:38]（大师）以驱散幻影卡车；或@Check[religion|dc:36]（大师）以保护自己免受伤害

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: 1 day

cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.expected: (master) to hear the roar of hover jets
cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.text: （大师）以听见悬浮喷气引擎的轰鸣

items.name: 引爆
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移入陷阱所在的区域，或空雷被摧毁

效果空雷引爆，对其所在区域内的所有星舰造成1d6+2穿刺伤害和@Damage[(1d6+2)[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves into the trap's zone the mine is destroyed

Effect The mine detonates, dealing 1d6+2 piercing and @Damage[(1d6+2)[fire]] damage to all starships in its zone (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A mine packed with powerful explosives is concealed in plain sight.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一枚装满强力炸药的太空雷隐藏在眼前。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:15] (trained; generator, scanners) to hack the mine, or @Check[crafting|dc:16] (trained; drone console) to rewire it
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:15]（受训；发电机、扫描仪）以骇入太空雷；或@Check[crafting|dc:16]（受训；无人机控制台）以重新连接其线路

ZBFVGGGOlLAVY0Fb.name: 一日游代步车 Daytripper Person Carrier

items.name: 环保充电器
items.description: 一日游代步车内置的商用型电池会自动通过太阳能和背景辐射充电，只要未被使用，便能在24小时内充满电。如果电池已充满电，可将另一个电池供能设备接入其充电口，耗尽代步车电池的所有充能，并将这些充能转移至另一设备的电池。
items.expectedDescription: A daytripper's internal commercial battery charges automatically from solar power and background radiation, fully recharging over the course of 24 hours as long as it isn't in use. If the battery is fully charged, another battery-powered device can be connected to its charging port, depleting all the daytripper battery's charges and transferring them to the other device's battery.

items.name: 便携
items.description: 一日游代步车以纳米机器人技术制造，能以一个交互动作缩成小立方体。以这种方式折叠时，代步车可作为1负载的物品携带。必须再用一个交互动作将其重新组装，才能用作载具。
items.expectedDescription: Daytrippers are built with nanite technology, allowing them to shrink into a small cube as a single Interact action. While collapsed this way, the daytripper can be carried as an item with 1 Bulk. The daytripper must be reassembled as another Interact action before it can be used as a vehicle.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: This simple electric vehicle looks like a round platform with handles on each side, but it's equipped with an automatic balancing system that allows the pilot to propel it forward simply be leaning in that direction. Originally developed decades ago, it found unimpressive initial sales due to its awkward design and poor versatility. In recent years, however, fans of retro vehicles have expressed an ironic fondness for the "overlooked" daytripper, often stylizing refurbished units with lights, holo-etchings, and flashy paint jobs.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这种简单电动车形似两侧带扶手的圆形平台，但配有自动平衡系统，驾驶员只需向前倾斜就能推动它。它在数十年前开发，最初因设计别扭、用途有限而销量平平。近年来，复古载具爱好者却对这款“被忽视”的一日游代步车产生带着反讽的喜爱，常为翻新车辆加装灯光、全息蚀刻和炫目的涂装。

items.name: 陀螺机动性
items.description: 球动飞行器能快速转向、原地转向，甚至倒着飞行。在少于一个车身长度的距离内每转向90度，额外消耗5尺移动距离；它能以完整速度向后飞行。
items.expectedDescription: A spheridyne can turn swiftly, turn in place, and even fly backward. Each 90-degree turn made in less than a vehicle length costs 5 extra feet of movement, and it can Fly backward at its full speed.

items.name: 悬浮推进器
items.description: 如果球动飞行器在驾驶员回合结束时位于空中，且本轮未使用飞行动作，它不会坠落，而是悬停在原地。
items.expectedDescription: A spheridyne doesn't fall if it's airborne at the end of the pilot's turn and didn't use a Fly action this round, hovering in place instead.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Though the craft's design is a bit jarring, few can argue with its aerial maneuverability. Using a series of independently rotating, carefully angled discs, a spheridyne offers the ability to turn, stop, and reverse direction in an instant, perfect for the customer with unpredictable needs.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 球动飞行器的设计虽然有些怪异，但其空中机动性几乎无可争议。它利用一系列独立旋转、精心调整角度的圆盘，能够瞬间转向、停止或掉头，特别适合需求难以预料的顾客。

items.name: 回响求救信标
items.description:
该危害在传感器地图上显示为一艘小型星舰，能成为骇入通讯的目标。传感器尖啸R（听觉，情绪，恐惧，心灵，音波）

触发一艘星舰以骇入通讯将该危害作为目标

效果一段受诅咒的录音在触发星舰内部的每个科技设备上播放。所有能听见录音的生物都必须进行@Check[will|dc:18]豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}状态。

失败该生物受到@Damage[3d8[mental]]伤害，并处于惊惧1状态。

大失败该生物受到@Damage[6d8[mental]]伤害，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态。
items.expectedDescription:
This hazard appears as a Small starship on the sensor map and can be targeted with Hack Comms. Sensor Scream R (auditory, emotion, fear, mental, sonic)

Trigger A starship targets the hazard with Hack Comms

Effect A cursed recording plays on every tech device inside the triggering starship. All creatures that can hear it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[3d8[mental]] damage and is frightened 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d8[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Drifting through space, a garbled and eerie audio or holovid recording repeats the painful final moments of a cursed crew's lives on tech devices.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一段混乱而诡异的音频或全息录像漂流在太空中，通过科技装置反复播放一群受诅咒船员生命中最后的痛苦时刻。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:16] (trained) to hack the relay, @Check[occultism|dc:14] (trained) to soothe the spirits, or @Check[religion|dc:14] (trained) to release the spirits
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:16]（受训）以骇入中继器；@Check[occultism|dc:14]（受训）以安抚精魂；或@Check[religion|dc:14]（受训）以释放精魂

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The haunt resets in 24 hours unless the spirits are released.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 除非精魂被释放，否则作祟在24小时后重置。

aLAYt73bHyxzDgxf.name: 腐蚀花蜜喷射 Caustic Nectar Spray

items.name: 花蜜喷射
items.description:
触发一个生物接近花朵周围15尺内

效果花朵对触发生物进行花蜜打击。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature comes within 15 feet of the flower

Effect The flower makes a nectar Strike against the triggering creature.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: An alien flower sprays a stream of caustic nectar.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一朵异星花喷出一股腐蚀性花蜜。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:13] (trained) to lull the flower into a passive state, or @Check[survival|dc:13] (trained) to mislead the flower's senses; @Check[acrobatics|dc:16] to move by the flower without triggering it (this doesn't disable the trap)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:13]（受训）以安抚花朵，使其不再主动反应；或@Check[survival|dc:13]（受训）以误导花朵感官；@Check[acrobatics|dc:16]以经过花朵而不触发它，这不会解除陷阱

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The flower's nectar reserve is refilled after 1 hour.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 花朵的花蜜储备在1小时后补满。

items.name: 巨量货载
items.description: 巨人运输艇能运载至多500负载的货物。
items.expectedDescription: A jotuncraft can carry up to 500 Bulk of cargo.

items.name: 武器挂架
items.description: 巨人运输艇设有一个武器架炮位，能以两个互动动作安装或移除任意远程武器。运输艇的船员能使用以此方式安装的武器进行打击。以这种方式安装且需要电池的武器能直接从引擎供能，因此开火时不消耗任何充能。
items.expectedDescription: A jotuncraft has a weapon mount emplacement, which can have any ranged weapon installed or removed with two Interact actions. The craft's crew can make Strikes with weapons installed this way. Weapons installed this way that require batteries don't consume any charges when fired, as they can draw power directly from the ray's engine.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The immense mass and utilitarian design of these monstrous crafts make them look more like bunkers than flying vehicles while stationary. The fortress-like jotuncraft are usually painted in drab colors and are equipped with massive cargo doors on the back and bottom and a reinforced turret emplacement. Originally designed for use by giants, a burst of unexpected commercial success meant modern models are largely retrofitted for smaller ancestries, leaving an oversized cargo bay perfect for large shipments.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这些巨大飞行器质量庞大、设计实用，静止时更像地堡而非飞行载具。堡垒般的巨人运输艇通常涂着暗淡颜色，后方和底部设有巨大货舱门，并配有强化炮塔座。它最初为巨人设计，却意外获得商业成功，如今大多数型号都改装为适合较小族裔使用，留下超大的货舱，正适合大宗运输。

cnText_system_details_pilotingCheck.text: 驾驶（DC 24）、计算机（DC 26）或工程学识（DC 26）

items.name: 炼狱之握
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入陷阱所在区域

效果陷阱对触发星舰进行炼狱锁链打击。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship enters the trap's zone

Effect The trap makes an infernal chain Strike against the triggering starship. The trap then rolls initiative.

items.name: 炼狱锁链
items.description: 射程4个区域
items.expectedDescription: range 4 zones

items.name: 锁链缠绕
items.description: 炼狱锁链打击成功时，陷阱扣住目标星舰。扣住星舰期间，陷阱随星舰移动，与其处于同一区域。
items.expectedDescription: On a successful infernal chain Strike, the trap latches onto the targeted starship. While latched onto a starship, the trap moves along with it, sharing its zone.

items.name: 升温
items.description: 陷阱向星舰灌注炼狱热浪。操纵作战站位的船员受到@Damage[2d8[fire]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:22|basic]豁免。失败时，他们操纵的作战站位发生故障，直到陷阱被解除或该站位被修复。
items.expectedDescription: The trap floods the starship with infernal heat. Crew members helming a battle station take @Damage[2d8[fire]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:22|basic] save. On a failure, the battle station they're helming becomes malfunctioning until the trap is disabled or the station is repaired.

items.name: 地狱噤声
items.description: 4个区域内的一艘星舰必须进行@Check[will|dc:22]豁免。失败时，星舰上的所有魔法和科技通讯停止运作。通讯装置无法收发数据，星舰无法骇入通讯。在不同房间操纵作战站位的船员无法使用正常的舰内通讯。心灵感应及其他能让生物交流的法术停止运作。通过族裔或群聊等职业能力具有天生心灵感应的生物，其心灵通讯暂时被阻断；位于危害周围4个区域内时，只能收到其他生物模糊的情绪印象。操纵星舰魔法导管的生物可以使用反制魔法来反制地狱噤声（3环；DC 20）。
items.expectedDescription: A starship within 4 zones must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. On a failure, all magic and technological communications on board the starship cease to function. Comm units can't send or receive data, and starships can't Hack Comms. Crew helming battle stations in different rooms can't use normal ship communications. Telepathy and other spells that allow creatures to communicate cease functioning. Creatures with innate telepathy from their ancestry or class features like group chat are temporarily blocked from psychic communication, receiving only vague emotional impressions from other creatures while within 4 zones of the hazard. A creature helming the starship's magic conduit can use Counter Magic to counteract Hell Hush (3rd rank; DC 20).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Massive starmetal jaws blaze with diabolical runes that reek of sulfur and brimstone.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 巨大的星金钳口上，魔鬼符文炽烈燃烧，散发浓烈硫磺气息。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[Legal Lore|dc:25] (expert; scanners) or Religion (expert; magic conduit) to rewrite the trap's diabolical bindings, or Counter Magic (magic conduit; 3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the trap
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[Legal Lore|dc:25]（专家；扫描仪）或宗教（专家；魔法导管），以改写陷阱的魔鬼束约；或反制魔法（魔法导管；3环；反制DC 20）以反制陷阱

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap moves up to 4 zones, then makes an infernal chain Strike against a starship in range. If it's attached to a starship, it spends its final action to Heat Up. Otherwise, it spends its final action to block a target's comms with Hell's Hush to block the target's comms.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱移动至多4个区域，随后对射程内的一艘星舰进行一次炼狱锁链打击。如果已经附着于星舰，它用最后一个动作升温；否则，用最后一个动作施展地狱噤声，阻断目标通讯。

cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.expected: or @Check[religion|dc:22] (expert) to understand the divine magic at play, or Scan for Magic
cnText_system_attributes_stealth_details.text: 或@Check[religion|dc:22]（专家）以理解正在起作用的神术魔法，或扫描魔法

fQMcFKNDjxU9ZME6.name: 硬光超轻型飞行器 Hardlight Ultralight

items.name: 倾侧
items.description: 硬光超轻型飞行器的驾驶员可以为一个驾驶动作添加鲁莽特征；如果它原本已有鲁莽特征，则改为在驾驶检定中承受–1环境减值。如此便能在移动途中的任意时点，将载具向任一侧平移5尺，而不改变航向。
items.expectedDescription: The pilot of a hardlight ultralight can add the reckless trait to a Drive action or attempt the Piloting check with a –1 circumstance penalty if it was already reckless, to shift the vehicle 5 feet to either side at any point during the movement without changing its heading.

items.name: 硬光收纳
items.description: 未使用时，操作者可以通过一个1分钟的活动关闭或重新启动投影器。关闭时，硬光机翼完全收起，超轻型飞行器可以作为2负载的物品携带。
items.expectedDescription: When not in use, an operator can deactivate or reactivate the projector as a 1-minute activity. While deactivated, the hardlight wings collapse entirely, and the ultralight can be carried as an item with 2 Bulk.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Hardlight ultralights are the ultimate convenient, ready-to-go transport. While inactive, these vehicles are contained entirely within a hardlight projector small enough for most people to carry in a backpack. Once activated, the projector unfolds into a large, brightly-color craft with dramatically angled contours and a roughly triangular body.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 硬光超轻型飞行器提供极致便利，随时可以出发。未启用时，载具全部收纳在一台硬光投影仪中，小到多数人都能放进背包。启用后，投影仪展开成色彩鲜艳的大型飞行器，轮廓棱角分明，机身大致呈三角形。

hTinFs4gAlImzS7f.name: 布雷瑟达鳐艇 Brethedan Ray

items.name: 武器挂架

items.expectedDescription: A Brethedan ray has a weapon mount in the nose, which can have any ranged weapon installed or removed with two Interact actions. Weapons installed this way that require batteries don't consume any charges when fired, as they can draw power directly from the ray's engine.

豁免@Check[fortitude|dc:18]

阶段3@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}并沉睡1分钟（1分钟）

cnText_system_details_description.text: 地面内对重量敏感的压力板被触发后，使走廊尽头的孔洞向廊内生物发射镇静飞针。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:18] (trained) or Thievery (trained) to disable the pressure plates
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:18]（受训）或贼活（受训）以解除压力板

items.name: 泄气
items.description:
触发一个或更多生物进入气闸舱

效果气闸外门打开，将可呼吸空气排向外侧的真空或有害大气。该生物开始窒息，并必须进行@Check[reflex|dc:20]豁免。

成功目标不受影响。

失败目标被吸出气闸10尺，并受到@Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。

大失败目标被吸出气闸10尺，并受到@Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger One or more creatures enters the airlock compartment

Effect The outer airlock door opens, venting breathable air out into the vacuum or harmful atmosphere beyond. The creature begins suffocating and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is sucked 10 feet out of the airlock and takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] damage.

Critical Failure The target is sucked 10 feet out of the airlock and takes @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A malfunctioning airlock opens unexpectedly while creatures are inside.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个发生故障的气闸在生物身处其中时意外打开。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained) to repair the airlock, or @Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained) to jam the airlock closed
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训）以修复气闸；或@Check[thievery|dc:17]（受训）以将气闸卡死在关闭状态

jUMdmldBVHb1PmRR.name: 万千现实幻景 Vision of Manifold Realities

items.name: 窥见万千现实
items.description:
触发一个有智能的生物进入区域

效果陷阱对所有能感知这些幻景的有智能生物造成@Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:26|basic]豁免）。大失败的生物还会迷失于幻景中，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{困惑}状态，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An intelligent creature enters the area

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]] damage to all intelligent creatures who can perceive the visions (@Check[will|dc:26|basic] save). Creatures who critically fail additionally lose themself in the visions, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Wisps of reality-warping magic that flit through the room are drawn to intelligent creatures, filling their minds with visions of countless alternate realities.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 房内飘动的一缕缕现实扭曲魔法，被智慧生物吸引，使它们的心智充满无数其他现实的幻象。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:26] (expert) to banish the visions, or @Check[occultism|dc:28] (expert) to exert your will over the visions, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the visions
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:26]（专家）以驱逐幻象；或@Check[occultism|dc:28]（专家）以自身意志压倒幻象；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（4环；反制DC 24）以反制幻象

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: 1 day

items.name: 网缚星舰
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移入或移出陷阱所在的区域

效果陷阱对触发星舰进行牵引钩打击。命中时，该星舰的速度受到–1个区域的环境减值，直到陷阱被解除，或星舰船员移除牵引钩。移除需要在星舰船体外侧工作10分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves in or out of the trap's zone

Effect The trap makes a towing hook Strike against the triggering starship. If it hits, the starship takes a –1-zone circumstance penalty to its Speed until the trap is disabled or the starship's crew removes the towing hook, requiring 10 minutes of work on the exterior of the starship's hull.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Space junk hides a jury-rigged yet ingenious snare.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 太空垃圾中隐藏着一个临时拼装却精巧的陷阱。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained; drone console, pilot's console) or Thievery (trained; drone console) to disable the mechanism
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训；无人机控制台、驾驶控制台）或贼活（受训；无人机控制台），以解除机构

items.name: 倾侧
items.description: 飞行摩托的驾驶员可以为一个驾驶动作添加鲁莽特征；如果它原本已有鲁莽特征，则改为在驾驶检定中承受–1环境减值。如此便能在移动途中的任意时点，将载具向任一侧平移5尺，而不改变航向。
items.expectedDescription: The pilot of an aerobike can add the reckless trait to a Drive action, or attempt the Piloting check with a –1 circumstance penalty if it was already reckless, to shift the vehicle 5 feet to either side at any point during the movement without changing its heading.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A favorite of would-be aerial daredevils for their relatively low price and impressive maneuverability, these wonders of engineering feature a lightweight, hollow frame and two pairs of narrow wings. Amateur aerobike racing leagues have sprouted up across the Pact Worlds in recent years, especially on Castrovel.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这些工程奇迹配有轻质中空框架和两对窄翼，价格相对低廉、机动性出色，深受向往空中冒险者喜爱。近年，业余飞行摩托竞赛联盟在协约世界各地兴起，卡斯卓韦尤为盛行。

l1LNK7i6q1VqJgzH.name: 轨道雷区 Orbital Mine Field

items.name: 引爆
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移入陷阱所在的区域，或有人重新连接空雷线路的检定失败

效果空雷引爆，对触发星舰造成2d8穿刺伤害和@Damage[2d8[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves into the trap's zone or someone fails a check to rewire the mines

Effect The mines detonate, dealing 2d8 piercing and @Damage[2d8[fire]] damage to the triggering starship (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Mines packed with powerful explosives float in a concealed location.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 装满强力炸药的太空雷漂浮在隐蔽地点。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:19] (trained; scanners) or Perception (expert; any battle station) to locate the mines, or @Check[crafting|dc:25] (trained; generator) or Thievery (expert; drone console) to rewire the mines
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:19]（受训；扫描仪）或察觉（专家；任意作战站位），以定位太空雷；或@Check[crafting|dc:25]（受训；发电机）或贼活（专家；无人机控制台），以重新连接太空雷线路

items.name: 辐射泄漏
items.description:
触发一个生物查看反应堆的传感器或控制台

效果反应堆周围60尺内的生物暴露于严酷辐射（@Check[fortitude|dc:32]；第91页）。陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature views the reactor's sensors or console

Effect Creatures within 60 feet of the reactor are exposed to incredible radiation (@Check[fortitude|dc:32]; page 91). The trap rolls initiative.

items.name: 核爆炸
items.description:
触发陷阱完成半径达到100尺的例行行动

效果反应堆爆炸，在500尺半径内造成@Damage[(4d10+20)[fire]]伤害，无视爆炸区域内任何物品的硬度（@Check[fortitude|dc:46|basic]豁免）。区域内的一切都暴露于严酷辐射。核爆炸区域受到辐射污染，持续泄漏严重辐射50年。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The trap completed its routine with a radius of 100 feet

Effect The reactor explodes, dealing @Damage[(4d10+20)[fire]] damage in a 500 foot radius, bypassing the hardness of any items in the blast zone (@Check[fortitude|dc:46|basic] save). Everything in the area is exposed to incredible radiation. The area of the nuclear explosion becomes irradiated, leaking severe radiation for 50 years.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A nuclear reactor overloads, then explodes.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一座核反应堆过载，随后爆炸。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:45] (master) or Crafting (master) to initiate shutdown procedures, or @Check[thievery|dc:47] (master) to vent the reactor; three total successes are required to disable the trap
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:45]（大师）或工艺（大师）以启动关闭程序；或@Check[thievery|dc:47]（大师）以为反应堆排气；解除陷阱总计需要三次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) As the reactor overheats, the trap deals @Damage[(4d10+20)[fire]] damage to creatures within 60 feet (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic] save). All creatures in the area are exposed to incredible radiation. Each time the trap uses this routine, the area increases by 10 feet. When the routine's radius equals 100 feet, resolve the routine. Then, the reactor immediately explodes, using Nuclear Explosion.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）反应堆过热，陷阱对60尺内生物造成@Damage[(4d10+20)[fire]]伤害，目标进行@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic]豁免。区域内所有生物都暴露于严酷辐射。陷阱每次使用此流程，区域都扩大10尺。流程半径达到100尺时，先结算流程，随后反应堆立即爆炸，使用核爆炸。

oqXjUZJ0XiO08oq5.name: 微型黑洞 Micro Black Hole

items.name: 引力异常
items.description:
触发一艘星舰位于该危害周围3个区域内

效果该危害将3个区域内的所有星舰拉近1个区域。这些星舰陷入该危害的引力井。受困星舰不能向远离该危害的方向移动，以这种方式受困期间被摧毁的星舰会被吸入事件视界，无法挽回。然后，该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship is within 3 zones of the hazard

Effect The hazard pulls all starships within 3 zones 1 zone closer. These hazards become trapped in the hazard's gravity well. A trapped starship can't move away from the hazard, and a starship that's destroyed while trapped in this way is drawn irretrievably into the event horizon. The hazard then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A mote of super-compressed matter pulls everything toward it.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一粒极度压缩的物质将一切拉向自身。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[piloting|dc:28] (expert; pilot's console) to avoid the event horizon, @Check[crafting|dc:28] (expert; generator) to divert enough power to the engines to avoid being pulled in, @Check[computers|dc:26] (expert; scanners), Nature (expert; magic conduit), or Physical Science Lore (trained; scanners) to calculate a safe path around the hazard
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[piloting|dc:28]（专家；驾驶控制台）以避开事件视界；@Check[crafting|dc:28]（专家；发电机）以向引擎转移足够能量，避免被吸入；@Check[computers|dc:26]（专家；扫描仪）、自然（专家；魔法导管）或物理科学学识（受训；扫描仪），以计算绕过危害的安全路线

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
(1 action) Each starship within 0 zones of the hazard and each creature on board those starships takes @Damage[(2d10+11)[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save.

Special This hazard draws in any starship within 3 zones every round. It can't be permanently disabled, only escaped, and resets immediately. Effects that would disable it instead make the disabling starship and creatures on board immune to the hazard for 1 round.
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
（1个动作）距离危害0个区域内的每艘星舰，以及这些星舰上的每个生物，都受到@Damage[(2d10+11)[bludgeoning]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic]豁免。

特殊此危害每轮吸引3个区域内的任何星舰。它不能永久解除，只能逃离，并会立即重置。原本会解除危害的效果，改为使解除它的星舰及舰上生物免疫此危害1轮。

otz1rbzsOF0gGSCd.name: 电离气云 Ionized Gas Cloud

items.name: 电离
items.description:
触发一艘星舰移入该危害所在的区域

效果该危害对触发星舰进行闪电打击。命中时，星舰上的所有科技生物和物品陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障3}状态，所有作战站位发生故障；@Check[fortitude|dc:17]豁免成功的生物不受影响，其操纵的任何作战站位以及持有的任何装备也不受影响。这些效应持续1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A starship moves into the hazard's zone

Effect The hazard makes a lightning Strike against the triggering starship. If it hits, all tech creatures and items on board the starship are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 3}, and all battle stations become malfunctioning; creatures that succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:17] save are unaffected, as are any battle stations they're helming and any gear in their possession. These effects last for 1 minute.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A cloud of superheated gas crackles with electricity.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一团过热气体中，电光噼啪作响。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:18] (trained; any battle station) to find a safe route through it, or @Check[piloting|dc:17] (trained; pilot's console) to ride the turbulence safely
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:18]（受训；任意作战站位）以找到安全通路；或@Check[piloting|dc:17]（受训；驾驶控制台）以安全驾驭湍流

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The gas particles ionize again in 1 hour.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 气体粒子在1小时后再次电离。

items.name: 震颤
items.description:
触发一个效应对建筑造成伤害，或建筑周围的地面发生位移

效果建筑震颤并吱嘎作响，预示着即将倒塌。建筑内部变为困难地形。陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An effect damages the building, or the ground around the building shifts

Effect The building shudders and creaks, signaling an imminent collapse. The building's interior becomes difficult terrain. The trap rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A building collapses, harming everyone inside.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一座建筑倒塌，伤害内部所有人。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:38] (expert) or Nature (expert) to magically prop up the building, @Check[crafting|dc:34] (master) or Survival (master) to stabilize the building, @Check[religion|dc:38] (expert) to pray for the collapse to cease; four total successes are required to stop the collapse
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:38]（专家）或自然（专家）以魔法支撑建筑；@Check[crafting|dc:34]（大师）或生存（大师）以稳固建筑；@Check[religion|dc:38]（专家）以祈求坍塌停止；阻止坍塌总计需要四次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The building begins to collapse. All creatures in the building take @Damage[(3d10+18)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:39|basic] save). A creature that critically fails its save is additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）建筑开始坍塌。内部所有生物受到@Damage[(3d10+18)[bludgeoning]]伤害，并进行@Check[reflex|dc:39|basic]豁免。豁免大失败的生物还会被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并受到@Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

items.name: 上传灵魂
items.description:
触发一个未经授权的生物直接或使用工具抓住计算机

效果陷阱试图将触发生物的灵魂上传至计算机。触发生物必须进行@Check[will|dc:40]豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到@Damage[(3d10+15)[spirit]]伤害。

失败该生物的灵魂暂时被拉出身体。它受到@Damage[(6d10+30)[spirit]]伤害，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑3}状态。

大失败该生物的灵魂被拉出身体，并上传至计算机的数据模块。它的身体成为失去灵魂的躯壳，除非灵魂被送回，否则会在1周内逐渐死亡。摧毁计算机会摧毁其灵魂。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An unauthorized creature grasps the computer directly or with a tool

Effect The trap attempts to upload the triggering creature's soul into the computer. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:40] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(3d10+15)[spirit]] damage.

Failure The creature's soul is temporarily pulled from their body. It takes @Damage[(6d10+30)[spirit]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

Critical Failure The creature's soul is pulled from its body and uploaded to a data module on the computer. Its body remains a soulless vessel, which slowly dies over the course of 1 week unless its soul is returned. Destroying the computer destroys its soul.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A computer is protected by a hybrid trap, which uploads the soul of all unauthorized users to an inert data module on the computer.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一台计算机受混合陷阱保护，会将所有未经授权用户的灵魂上传至机内一个未启用的数据模组。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:36] (expert) to drain the computer's magical energy, or @Check[computers|dc:36] (expert) to falsify authorized credentials, or @Check[thievery|dc:40] (expert) to disable the trap, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 34) to counteract the trap
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:36]（专家）以抽干计算机的魔法能量；或@Check[computers|dc:36]（专家）以伪造授权凭据；或@Check[thievery|dc:40]（专家）以解除陷阱；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（7环；反制DC 34）以反制陷阱

items.name: 管道爆裂
items.description:
触发陷阱周围10尺内的一个生物使用站位动作

效果陷阱灼烧周围环境。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within 10 feet of the trap uses a station action

Effect The trap Scorches its surroundings. The trap then rolls initiative.

items.name: 灼烧
items.description: 陷阱周围10尺内的生物受到@Damage[(1d10+6)[fire]]伤害，并进行@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]豁免。受影响区域内的作战站位发生故障。
items.expectedDescription: Creatures within 10 feet of the trap take @Damage[(1d10+6)[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save. Battle stations within the affected area become malfunctioning.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A pipe ruptures in the starship, creating a 5-foot space of scorching hot air on the ground within 10 feet of a battle station.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 星舰内一根管道破裂，在作战站位10尺内的地面上形成一处5尺大小的灼热空气空间。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:16] (trained) to repair the pipe, or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (expert) to patch up the rupture
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:16]（受训）以修复管道；或@Check[thievery|dc:18]（专家）以补住破口

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The trap Scorches its surroundings.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）陷阱灼烧周围环境。

items.name: 磁力防护
items.description: 组成微群载具的微小组件会自动调整位置，将驾驶员移离危险并保护其免受撞击。当驾驶员碾过并撞击一个目标时，微群载具可以对抗自身的碰撞DC进行基础反射豁免，以保护驾驶员免受碰撞伤害。
items.expectedDescription: The tiny components that make up a wealcol automatically reposition to move the pilot out of danger and shield them from impact. When the pilot Runs Over and rams a target, the wealcol can make a basic Reflex save against its own collision DC to protect the pilot from the collision damage.

items.name: 集群形态
items.description: 微群载具的流动特性使它能挤过原本过于狭小的空间。微群载具可以尝试驾驶穿过一个小于其某一边尺寸的开口，为该动作赋予鲁莽特征。如果驾驶员维持对载具的控制，微群载具便会即时变形，能通过任何驾驶员能够通过的开口。
items.expectedDescription: A wealcol's fluid nature allows it to squeeze through spaces that would otherwise be too small for it. A wealcol can attempt to Drive through an opening that's smaller than one of its dimensions, giving the action the reckless trait. If the pilot maintains control of the vehicle, the wealcol changes its shape on the fly and can fit through any opening the pilot could.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A unique, highly specialized single-passenger transport with a fluid design, this vehicle is composed of tens of thousands of autonomous, 1-inch cubic robots working in tandem in a specially designed magnetic field. The wealcol can adapt on the fly, compacting itself to fit through tight spaces and bending to keep its operator away from harm.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这种独特而高度专用的单人载具采用流动式设计，由数以万计的自主机器人构成；每个机器人都是边长1英寸的立方体，在特制磁场中协同工作。微群载具可以随时适应情况，压缩自身穿过狭窄空间，或弯曲形体使操纵者避开伤害。

cnText_system_details_speed.text: 65尺（机动），飞行65尺（机动），游泳65尺（机动）

items.name: 能量过载
items.description:
触发一艘星舰进入危害所在区域
